Job Description: Creative Professional (Domain Expert)

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote – United States or Canada

About the Role

Apply your creative expertise to help train and improve next-generation AI systems. You'll evaluate AI-generated creative work, develop realistic professional scenarios, and provide expert feedback. No prior AI experience is required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate creative briefs, concepts, and finished work using professional experience.
  • Review AI-generated content, designs, scripts, storyboards, and edits for originality, quality, and alignment with briefs.
  • Create realistic work scenarios involving creative briefs, revisions, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Identify weaknesses in AI-generated creative judgment, originality, and collaboration.
  • Document findings and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Contribute to AI training datasets using professional expertise.

Required Qualifications

  • Currently employed full-time in a creative role, such as graphic designer, illustrator, video or audio editor, animator, photographer, writer, editor, or art director.
  • Based in the United States or Canada.
  • At least 2 years of professional experience in the relevant field.
  • A portfolio or body of work demonstrating creative experience.
  • Strong creative judgment and ability to explain decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a studio, publishing house, media company, or in-house creative team.
  • Experience using AI tools in creative workflows.
  • Familiarity with emerging trends in AI, automation, or creative production.

Sie möchten Ihre Erfahrung in der Hauptbuchhaltung in einem modernen Arbeitsumfeld einbringen oder nach einer beruflichen Auszeit wieder ins Rechnungswesen einsteigen?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Unterstützung in unserem Finance-Team in Leingarten.

Ihre Rolle in unserem Team

  • Verantwortung für die Hauptbuchhaltung (General Ledger) sowie für die termingerechte und korrekte Abschlusserstellung
  • Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartalsabschlüssen nach HGB
  • Abstimmung von Haupt- und Nebenbüchern, Kontenklärung sowie Erstellung von Rückstellungen, Abgrenzungen und Bewertungen
  • Unterstützung beim Konzernreporting und Erstellung von Auswertungen und Berichten
  • Vorbereitung und Bereitstellung prüfungsrelevanter Unterlagen sowie Unterstützung bei Jahresabschluss- und Betriebsprüfungen

Ihr Profil

  • Sie haben ein abgeschlossenes betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Rechnungswesen/Finanzen oder kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d)
  • Sie besitzen mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Finanz- und Hauptbuchhaltung sowie mit HGB-Abschlüssen
  • Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse in Buchführung, Bilanzierung und Umsatzsteuer mit und haben idealerweise Erfahrung mit Wirtschaftsprüfern
  • Sie sind sicher im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen (idealerweise SAP S/4HANA) und haben sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse
  • Sie sind strukturiert und sorgfältig, haben eine eigenständige Arbeitsweise, analytisches Denkvermögen, Zahlenaffinität sowie Teamfähigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

Ihr Arbeitsumfeld

Die Körber Supply Chain Automation mit Hauptsitz in Leingarten und weiteren Standorten in Dahn, Rottendorf, Markdorf & Schwarzenbek ist Generalunternehmer für automatisierte Intralogistik-Systeme und dynamische Automatisierungsprojekte. Wir bieten unseren Kunden Beratung, Planung, Softwareentwicklung, Projektrealisierung, Service und Wartung - alles aus einer Hand. Die Bandbreite an Referenzen reicht von einfachen bis zu hochkomplexen Intralogistikprojekten in den unterschiedlichsten Branchen.

Ihre Vorteile

Wir verbinden die Vorteile eines mittelständischen Unternehmens mit den Vorzügen eines Großkonzerns:

  • Gesicherter Arbeitsplatz in einer wachsenden, zukunftsorientierten Branche
  • Steuerfreier Sachbezugswert für den vielfältigen Kauf von Waren oder Dienstleistungen, vergünstigter Mittagstisch
  • Moderne IT-Ausstattung am Arbeitsplatz
  • Monatliche Mitarbeiterangebote über ein Rabattportal
  • Betriebliche Altersversorgung, Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld, Sonderurlaub, Jubiläumszahlungen
  • Ein Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – vertrauliche Beratung und Unterstützung bei gesundheitlichen, beruflichen und persönlichen Herausforderungen
  • Business Bike – auch für ein weiteres Familienmitglied
  • Erhöhter Spesensatz bei Dienstreisen
  • Finanzieller Zuschuss bei Rufbereitschaft

Können Sie sich in diesem Profil wiederfinden? Dann sind Sie bei Körber richtig. Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie kennen zu lernen!

Jetzt bewerben und Teil unseres Teams werden!Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Mit einem Klick auf „Jetzt bewerben“ kann es direkt losgehen! Solange die Position ausgeschrieben ist, ist eine Bewerbung jederzeit möglich.

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/ Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

Mehr zu unserer Kultur gibt es hier zu erfahren Kultur bei Körber - Vorbeischauen lohnt sich!

Wir legen wert auf ein barrierefreies Arbeitsumfeld. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung oder ihnen Gleichgestellten sind uns ausdrücklich willkommen. Wir freuen uns über eine freiwillige Angabe direkt in Deinem Lebenslauf oder Anschreiben, damit wir Dich im Prozess bestmöglich unterstützen können. Hier erfährst Du mehr über die Arbeit unserer Schwerbehindertenvertretung. Sie stehen Dir vorab für vertrauliche Fragen gerne zur Verfügung.

Bei Fragen oder technischen Problemen stehen wir gerne telefonisch unter +49 40 21107 291 oder per E-Mail an zur Verfügung.

Birgitt Nortz ist die zuständige Ansprechperson für diese Position. Wir arbeiten mit festen Partnern zusammen und bitten daher Personalberatungen, von einer Kontaktaufnahme per Mail oder Telefon abzusehen.

raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior CX Platform Engineer, you'll help GitLab's Customer Experience (CX) teams hand real work to artificial intelligence (AI). You'll use Claude Code and GitLab Duo Agent Platform as your default development tools, designing agentic workflows and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with production testing, security, and shared ownership. This is a software engineering role, not ticket-taking internal IT, AI evangelism disconnected from shipped code, or customer-billable Professional Services delivery.

What you'll do

  • Use Claude Code, GitLab Duo, and other coding agents as your primary development environment for planning, implementation, refactoring, testing, reviews, and documentation. Run multiple agents in parallel on well-scoped tasks, critically review their output, and own every line that reaches production.
  • Build and maintain the team's agent harness, including shared AGENTS.md conventions, skills, slash commands, hooks, subagent definitions, and continuous integration checks. Measure and share what works, publish reusable patterns, and retire those that don't.
  • Ship agents and multi-step workflows for account research, success planning, scoping, status reporting, and customer onboarding. Package them as skills and plugins for non-engineers using Claude, Claude in Slack, and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.
  • Build MCP servers and connectors for governed access to GitLab, Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, Thought Industries, Gong, Snowflake, and other enterprise systems. Add evaluations, tracing, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints to keep internal and customer-facing agents measurable, auditable, and safe with customer data.
  • Evolve the CX Application Platform's gateway, Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, including Elastic Container Service (ECS), Relational Database Service (RDS), and Lambda, Terraform configuration, application scaffold, and deployment path. Own applications such as PS Compass, Congregate, and GitLab University and its integrations, documenting build-versus-buy and consolidate-or-sunset decisions.
  • Ship production-quality Python and TypeScript through GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), with tests, observability, security review, and runbooks. Design every application for handoff, with documentation, monitoring, and shared ownership.
  • Prototype with Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training in days, not quarters. Help CX team members bring their own applications to production, and turn field learning into reusable reference implementations, development paths, and enablement.
  • Contribute upstream to GitLab and share product feedback with Product and Engineering. Mentor engineers and non-engineers on agentic development and raise the team's code review bar.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and operating production software, owning multi-quarter work from ambiguity to production, choosing reusable platform solutions over one-off customization where appropriate, and designing for handoff.
  • Daily, hands-on use of coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitLab Duo, or similar on production work. You can show how they've changed what you ship and how you maintain quality.
  • Experience building with large language models (LLMs) beyond chat, including tool use, MCP servers, agent loops, context and retrieval design, prompt and workflow design, and evaluations.
  • Strong Python skills with FastAPI or Flask and TypeScript skills with Vue or React, including application programming interface (API) design, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of customer and business data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS, RDS, and Lambda, Terraform, Docker, and applications running behind single sign-on (SSO), such as Okta.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems through Representational State Transfer (REST) and GraphQL APIs, and fluency with Git, merge requests, and CI/CD.
  • Experience translating non-engineering stakeholders' workflows into technical plans and writing clear asynchronous design documents, decision records, and enablement materials. You align with GitLab's values and are willing to use GitLab for your own work.
  • Optional experience includes agent harness customization; the GitLab Development Kit, Duo Agent Platform custom agents and flows, or AI Catalog publishing; enterprise agent governance and data controls; customer success, professional services, or learning platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, or Thought Industries; professional services economics and customer success metrics; Snowflake or similar warehouses; and technical writing, talks, or open source contributions on agentic development.

We welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; you don't need to meet every nice-to-have to apply.

About the team

CX Platform Engineering builds and runs CX Applications for Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training. We own the CX Application Platform's gateway and infrastructure alongside our application portfolio: GitLab University, the Foundational Onboarding Agent in GitLab Duo Agent Platform, Congregate, PS Compass, and Customer Wins. We build the first version with the people doing the work, turn what we learn into a reusable pattern, then hand it off so it runs without us. We reward leverage, not heroics, and don't leave tools dependent on one person.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

raw.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

​

Job Overview

In the exciting and challenging role of Global Account Manager for TE Sensors, you will lead the development and execution of account strategies for large medical device OEMs and be based in the Northeast United States. The role combines the hands-on customer ownership and opportunity development responsibilities of a Key Account Manager with the global coordination, executive engagement, and strategic planning responsibilities of a Global Account Manager.
You will establish and maintain strong business relationships, manage complex sales pipelines, generate demand through design wins, and deliver profitable revenue growth and customer satisfaction. As the primary commercial leader for assigned accounts, you will coordinate regional and global teams, align TE Connectivity business units, and develop relationships across customer engineering, procurement, operations, and executive leadership. You will elevate the TE Sensors brand and expand our position within strategic medical device OEMs, regional key accounts, and their global design, manufacturing, and supply-chain organizations.

Strategic Account Management and Business Development

  • Develop, continually refine, and lead the execution of multi-year global account plans for assigned large medical device OEMs.
    • Serve as the primary commercial point of contact for key customer stakeholders and coordinate engagement across customer locations, functions, and regions.
    • Build and maintain long-term credibility and relationships across engineering, procurement, operations, supply chain, and executive leadership.
    • Develop and lead senior-level customer relationships, executive business reviews, and strategic planning discussions.
    • Coordinate regional account priorities and global opportunities to ensure consistent strategy, communication, and execution.
    • Identify new business opportunities, strategies, and partnerships that expand TE Sensors content across customer platforms and applications.
    • Stay current on medical device industry trends, competitive products, emerging sensing technologies, regulatory requirements, material durability requirements, and application-specific needs.
    • Monitor competitive threats and market positioning across regions and adjust account strategies accordingly.

Job Responsibilities

Customer Engagement

  • Maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships by understanding customers’ business objectives, technical requirements, product roadmaps, and global operating models.
    • Enhance customer satisfaction and retention through superior service, support, and consistent execution across regions.
    • Engage with customers and medical-device ecosystem partners to identify market trends and application needs that can accelerate growth for the Sensors business.
    • Identify and respond to key customer needs, converting the sales funnel into design wins and realized revenue.
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for customer needs and know when to escalate within the TE Sensors organization.
    • Coordinate internal resources to provide quotations, resolve lead-time issues, support complaint resolution, coordinate logistics, negotiate commercial and legal agreements, and transfer technical information.
    • Foster a customer-centric approach with Field Application Engineers, Product Management, Engineering, System Architecture, Customer Care,

Manufacturing/Operations, Quality, and Marketing.

  • Coordinate global customer activities and multi-site projects to provide a consistent customer experience.

Delivering Revenue Target

  • Achieve and exceed annual global and regional sales targets within assigned accounts.
    • Develop a robust sales pipeline, forecast sales, and track key account metrics across customer regions and business units.
    • Own and convert opportunities into tangible results that deliver profitable growth for Sensors.
    • Expand TE Sensors content, revenue, and market share within existing accounts while identifying new divisions, platforms, applications, and customer locations.
    • Balance near-term revenue delivery with development of strategic opportunities that may involve long qualification and medical-device product development cycles.

Leadership

  • Develop account-specific global strategies and spearhead alignment across regional sales, Field Application Engineering, Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and other supporting functions.
    • Lead account teams through influence, clear priorities, defined ownership, and consistent follow-through.
    • Establish a common global account direction while accommodating regional customer requirements and business practices.
    • Provide executive-level visibility into account performance, strategic opportunities, competitive threats, resource requirements, and execution risks.

More Responsibilities

Collaboration

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Product Management, Engineering, System Architecture, Quality, Operations, and Customer Service, to ensure a cohesive and effective account strategy. Evening virtual meetings with colleagues in Asia may be required at times.
    • Collaborate extensively with Global Account Managers and commercial leaders from other TE Connectivity business units to align strategies, coordinate customer engagement, support multi-business-unit opportunities, and reinforce a “One TE” perception within the customer base.
    • Coordinate with regional sales teams to ensure global account priorities are translated into clear local actions and customer coverage.
    • Align internal technical resources with the highest-value customer programs while managing engineering capacity and customer expectations.

Pipeline Management & Reporting

  • Utilize Salesforce CRM to track opportunities, customer interactions, design-win progression, and pipeline conversion.
    • Leverage additional information systems, including SAP, for forecasting, account reporting, and performance analysis.
    • Maintain high accuracy and cadence in CRM entries to support organizational visibility and decision making.
    • Consolidate regional opportunity and revenue information into a clear global account view.
    • Track account health, opportunity quality, project milestones, customer engagement, and risks across assigned accounts.

Key Goals & Performance Metrics

  • Formulate specific, actionable global account strategies and drive execution.
    • Deliver profitable revenue growth within assigned medical device accounts.
    • Develop and convert a high-quality pipeline, with emphasis on self-generated opportunities and conversion to design wins.
    • Expand TE Sensors content across customer platforms, applications, divisions, and global locations.
    • Strengthen senior-level customer relationships and improve TE Sensor’s strategic position within assigned accounts.
    • Maintain effective cross-regional coordination, clear ownership, and consistent execution of global account priorities.
    • Track customer engagement activity, including calls, visits, demonstrations, project meetings, and executive reviews, through Salesforce CRM.

What your background should look like

  • 7+ years of sales or strategic account management experience with large corporate customers.
    • Demonstrated success managing key, strategic, or global accounts with complex organizational structures.
    • Experience selling technical components, sensors, or engineered solutions to medical device OEMs.
    • Strong understanding of medical device product development cycles and the FDA and CE regulatory environment.
    • Demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding sales targets and delivering profitable revenue growth.
    • Experience navigating complex, long-cycle sales opportunities involving multiple customer functions and geographic regions.
    • Track record of building strategic opportunities, negotiating, and closing large technology-oriented agreements.
    • Ability to understand the big picture, uncover customer business and technical needs, and translate those needs into selling opportunities.
    • Experience negotiating commercial and legal agreements to achieve desired business results.
    • Demonstrated strong business instincts, market awareness, and competitive positioning skills.
    • Ability to develop and execute multi-year global account plans.
    • Ability to lead cross-functional and cross-regional teams through influence rather than direct authority.
    • Skilled at communicating and leveraging value propositions externally and internally with global, cross-cultural, and cross-functional teams.
    • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills, both virtually and in person.
    • Strong familiarity with CRM tools and systems, including Salesforce.
    • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field. Technical aptitude and the ability to engage credibly with customer engineering teams are required.
    • Ability to travel domestically an average of 40%-60%, with potential international travel.

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a 'U.S. Person' as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.62 (U.S. Citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)

ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat,Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

COMPENSATION
• Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $144, 100- $ 216,000 (subject to change dependent on physical location)
• Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity.
• Total Compensation = Base Salary + Incentive(s) + Benefits

BENEFITS
• A comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), disability, life insurance, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and voluntary benefits.

EOE, Including Disability/Vets

IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD
TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity never requests payment or fees from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.

raw.description:
About Lyra Health

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

About The Role

We are seeking a driven, systems-minded Manager, Operations - HPHS to lead and elevate our front-door care team. This team is the critical first touchpoint for our members, converting interest into booked appointments through fast outbound outreach and reliable inbound queue coverage.

Our current team possesses incredible empathy, strong dedication to our members, and a deep desire to help. As we prepare to scale this function over the next year, we are maturing our operations to support this rapid growth. We need a leader to guide the team's evolution into a rigorous, metrics-driven inbound/outbound enrollment engine.

You won’t just manage the people; you will optimize the machine. We need a leader who can get in the weeds of our tech stack (specifically Salesforce), identify opportunities to streamline patient profiles and workflows, and advocate cross-functionally to make our systems better, faster, and stronger.

What You'll Do:

  • Operational Rigor & Team Scaling: Guide the team's transition into a highly structured, queue-based enrollment model. Establish clear KPIs around enrollment conversion, schedule adherence, and capacity utilization. Level-set expectations and build a foundation of high performance, reliability, and trust.

  • Tech & Systems Optimization: Act as the operational subject matter expert for our CRM. Proactively identify missing Salesforce fields, clunky workflows, and routing inefficiencies. Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and cross-functional teams to design and implement solutions that reduce friction and extend our tech stack.

  • Real-Time Queue Management: Own daily frontline service delivery. Ensure outreach occurs within one business day and the inbound front door is consistently covered during operating hours. Monitor answer rates, SLA adherence, and daily staffing logistics to consistently hit volume targets.

  • Data Advocacy & Consumption: Analyze existing reports to identify daily trends, and confidently advocate to Data/Analytics teams for the specific reporting metrics you need to monitor queue health and individual enrollment success.

  • 90-Day Vision & Execution: Within your first 90 days, successfully transition the team's workflows to support active queue management, establish baseline performance metrics, and build a repeatable training/onboarding playbook to prepare for headcount growth.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 3+ Years of Frontline Management: Direct experience managing a contact center, queue-based operations team, or inside sales team with strict accountability for KPIs, schedule adherence, and conversion metrics.

Overview

Join our team as a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer and support the Naval Postgraduate School’s Global ECCO program by building and maintaining cloud-hosted strategic exercise applications. You will develop Java and Node.js applications on AWS, automate cloud infrastructure, and deliver an offline, field-deployable version of the exercise system, ensure security professionals around the world can train and collaborate through reliable, engaging online exercises.

FWI is expanding rapidly and has been recognized as a 2024, 2025 and 2026 Top Workplace, offering excellent growth opportunities in a collaborative environment.

**Position is contingent upon contract award**

Work Schedule and Location:

Remote: This full-time remote position will work Monday through Friday, 8am to 4:30pm pacific time.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, enhance, and maintain the Global ECCO online strategic exercise application and the exercise coordination software, both currently in production.
  • Manage and automate the AWS infrastructure that hosts the exercise system.
  • Build and maintain server-side applications, and help outside developers integrate new or reskinned exercises into the platform.
  • Support live exercise events by scaling services to fit each event’s size, creating temporary user accounts, and resolving technical-check issues before go-time.
  • Design and deliver a functional offline version of the exercise system that can be deployed in the field without internet access.
  • Troubleshoot issues with end users, and respond to reported problems within one business day.
  • Document your work, train Global ECCO team members on new features, and keep source code in the NPS GitLab repository.
  • Give status updates in weekly and bi-weekly team meetings, and write a monthly progress report.

Qualifications

Required:

  • A Master of Science (MS) degree in a technical field, such as Computer Science, Engineering, or a mathematics-related discipline.
  • 5+ years integrating internet applications within AWS using the AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK).
  • 5+ years of application development with Java technologies.
  • 5+ years of experience with Node.js technologies.
  • 5+ years automating AWS services.
  • A demonstrated ability to work with other developers so that new work runs smoothly with existing infrastructure.
  • S. citizenship.
  • The ability to successfully complete a DoD background investigation, obtain a CAC if required, and complete the required DoD security awareness training.

Desired:

  • Experience well beyond the 5-year minimums in AWS CDK, Java, Node.js, and AWS automation.
  • Experience building multi-user, interactive web applications, especially simulation, wargaming, training, or e-learning platforms.
  • Experience packaging applications for offline or disconnected deployment, such as containerized or self-contained builds.
  • Experience scaling cloud services up and down for event-driven usage spikes.
  • GitLab workflows, technical documentation, and end-user training experience.
  • Experience supporting DoD, academic, or federal education programs.

Why Join Our Team

At FWI, we place the highest importance on creating an exceptional employee experience. You'll have opportunities to achieve your career aspirations through internal promotions, professional development, and other recognition and rewards programs. Join our team and take advantage of the many benefits we offer, including:

  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Long-term and Short-term Disability Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • 401(k) Plan
  • Holiday Pay
  • Paid Time Off

FWI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/vets.

Negotiable

raw.description:
Marketing and Communications Manager

Location: Remote, US Based, EST

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role, not a marketing strategy role. We are looking for someone with approximately four years of marketing experience who wants to roll up their sleeves and do the work: write the content, build the campaign, update the website, manage the calendar, chase the follow-ups, coordinate the event, and keep things moving. If you have spent 10 or 20 years leading marketing strategy and teams, this is not the role we are hiring for.

Over the past year, Underscore has built the foundation for a stronger marketing and new business engine, including a refreshed brand and positioning, a redesigned website, a defined ideal client profile, HubSpot infrastructure, an earned media program, and a growing portfolio of events designed to connect us with leaders across biopharma.

Now we’re looking for a Marketing and Communications Manager who can execute on that foundation, consistently.

This is an execution role. The Marketing and Communications Manager will own the day-to-day work of Underscore’s marketing: content for prospect outreach, case studies, our quarterly Rare Company newsletter, website and sales collateral updates, lead follow-up, events, and PR support. You will work closely with our leadership, subject matter experts, Sales Enablement, and our PR agency to make sure great ideas become great content and, ultimately, business opportunities.

You will also help execute our events. This includes our Rare Company Dinner series, which will be held at least four times in 2027. You will work on invitations, follow-ups, and venue management, and help make sure we deliver a valuable experience for senior leaders in biopharma. You will support internal efforts as well, such as our Town Hall and Gratitude events.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable keeping a content calendar on track, interviewing a media expert for a case study, working with Sales Enablement on a HubSpot campaign, and supporting an industry event.

What You’ll Do

Content

  • Create content at scale for prospect outreach. It has to be highly relevant to biopharma leaders and build on Underscore’s recognition and reputation.
  • Own and execute Underscore’s editorial calendar across the website, LinkedIn, email, and other marketing channels.
  • Own the quarterly Rare Company newsletter, an opt-in publication that gives prospects, and potentially clients, new news and new perspectives relevant to biopharma. Underscore’s subject matter experts are the source of the information.
  • Reuse everything. Take the expertise that already exists across Underscore (an award, a partner meeting, a conference takeaway, a dinner theme) and turn each one into a LinkedIn post, a newsletter item, a web update, and a line in the deck.
  • Maintain Underscore’s voice across everything we publish.

Case Studies

  • Publish case studies and maintain a strong library of them, with a goal of approximately two new case studies per quarter.
  • Partner with account leads, media teams, analytics, and other subject matter experts to identify compelling stories and results.
  • Own the case study process from beginning to end, including interviews, results gathering, writing, internal review, client approval, publishing, and inclusion in the sales library.
  • Work within client confidentiality requirements to develop compelling blinded case studies.

Website and Sales Collateral

  • Keep the Underscore website current on a monthly cycle: new team members, company news, articles, events, and awards.
  • Keep our capabilities decks, credentials, team bios, case studies, RFP content, and other sales materials current and easy to access.

Lead Follow-Up and Sales Enablement

  • Make sure every lead gets a follow-up within 48 hours, whether it comes from a conference, an event, a campaign, the website, or a Rare Company Dinner. Your job is to make lead routing and follow-up a standing process with clear owners.
  • Serve as the day-to-day marketing partner to Sales Enablement on the coordination and execution of prospect management in HubSpot.
  • Supply the content for tailored communications to different prospect audiences. This will be structured by audience so we can test and learn what works, and what doesn’t.

Events, PR and Awards

  • Help execute Underscore’s events, including the Rare Company Dinner series and major industry moments such as Fierce Pharma Week.
  • Support internal efforts such as Town Hall and Gratitude.
  • Serve as the execution partner to our PR agency, providing the company information, executive bios, subject matter expertise, quotes, images, and approvals needed to support earned media.
  • Own the annual marketing calendar (events, awards, etc) and coordinate awaard submissions from initial opportunity through final deadline.

Planning

  • Maintain the master marketing and new business calendar that our CEO and executive leadership team work from.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 4 years marketing experience
  • Excellent writing and storytelling. You write clear, jargon-free content that is engaging, from LinkedIn posts to case studies. You can interview a subject matter expert and turn the conversation into something a senior biopharma marketer would want to read.
  • Some familiarity with HubSpot or another CRM platform.
  • Working knowledge of PowerPoint.
  • 1 to 2 years of event experience.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to keep a calendar and several projects moving at once.

Preferred

  • Three years b2b experience for healthcare, pharma, or a healthcare agency.
  • Agency-side experience, ideally in media or digital, so you can talk with the people who build media plans.
  • Exposure to rare disease, oncology, or specialty pharma.
  • Enough design literacy to make a one-pager in a template, and to know when you need a designer.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first year, success in this role will mean:

  • Underscore has a consistent editorial calendar that is being executed across channels.
  • The Rare Company newsletter goes out every quarter and has become a recognizable and valuable read for our target audience.
  • New case studies are being developed and added to our credentials library each quarter.
  • Every lead from events, campaigns, and the website has a clear owner and a follow-up within 48 hours.
  • The website and sales materials are updated monthly rather than reactively.
  • Strong ideas and insights from across Underscore are consistently turned into useful, market-facing content, and reused across channels.
  • Our CEO and executive leadership team work from one current marketing and new business calendar.

Who Will Thrive Here

You’re a doer.

You like taking something from idea to finished product. You know how to pull a good story out of people who may not think of themselves as storytellers. You care about the quality of the writing, but you also care whether someone opened it, responded to it, or wanted to have a conversation because of it.

You’re comfortable working in an environment where there are plenty of ideas and opportunities, and part of your value is bringing the structure, discipline, and follow-through that turns those ideas into a real marketing program.

At Underscore, you’ll have access to deep expertise across media, analytics, strategy, and healthcare. Your job is to help make sure the market sees it

Interested?
Apply by submitting your resume and a brief note outlining your healthcare or media experience.

 Underscore Marketing is a woman-owned, independent agency specializing in life sciences. Since 2002, we've helped clients gain a competitive edge through bold, data-driven promotional strategies that deliver measurable results.  

Our team comprises media, strategy, and omnichannel analytics experts who thrive on collaboration, innovation, and results. When you join Underscore, you become part of a dynamic environment where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work helps elevate brands in a competitive healthcare landscape.  

If you're passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a team that values integrity, creativity, and results, if that sounds like you, we invite you to share.  

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement 
Underscore is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We believe that diversity drives innovation and success, and we welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Talent Acquisition Specialist (Fixed term contract 12 months) - Based in Germany

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring a wide range of talented experts together across a wide range of business-critical services that support our business. Every role within Corporate is vital to furthering our vision of Shortening the Distance from Lab to Life®.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know.

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

Syneos Health is recruiting a Talent Acquisition in Germany from a fixed term contract for 12 months - Start date January 2027


As the Talent Acquisition Specialist II you will serve as a strategic business partner to your customers while executing the full cycle recruitment for your assigned positions. You will partner closely with Hiring Managers to manage the recruiting process from end-to-end, developing strategies and implementing

action plans related to both candidate sourcing identification and recruitment process execution. This includes but is not limited to: Educating and advising hiring managers to enable an effective and efficient

recruiting process, identifying and sharing recruitment best practices across the business and industry, maintaining current market knowledge, legal and recruitment trends, and developing sourcing methodologies and strategies to target and identify qualified candidates.

The successful candidate will be passionate about Syneos Health’s mission and culture, thrive in a fast paced environment, be proactive, resourceful and efficient. This person must be well organized, flexible, and enjoy the challenges of supporting a growing company.


• In conjunction with all of Talent Acquisition, creates a deep and diverse talent pool to service resourcing requirements across multiple business units.

• Collaborates directly with hiring managers to understand business and skill set requirements to build a comprehensive strategic hiring plan by setting the vision, strategy, and goals to ensure current and future resource demands are met.

• As a strategic partner to your hiring managers, provide expertise in market insights, talent landscape, and an understanding of talent needs to establish expectations and build a collaborative approach with your customers to meet demands.

• Ensure customer satisfaction by providing regular updates to hiring managers and setting expectations on the hiring process per requisition or department, or both, as required.

• Utilize appropriate sourcing channels (including applicant tracking system, candidate relationship management system, job boards, advertising, networking, employee referral program) to identify qualified candidates.

• Monitor recruitment sourcing methods and provide recommendations to improve applicant attraction.

• Suggests innovative solutions to sourcing challenges and competitive intelligence from those efforts.

• Offers creative solutions to sourcing hard to fill requisitions in collaboration with the business.

• Responsible to manage full cycle recruiting process to include but not limited to: complete initial screening interview of potential candidates and reject non-relevant applications, prepare candidate profile for hiring manager following interview screen, submit short listed candidates to hiring managers for review, conducts candidate debrief session after interviews are completed and extends verbal offers of employment to successful candidates.

• Ensures data accuracy within Applicant Tracking System.

• Initiates and maintains open communication with hiring managers and Human Resources (HR) colleagues in meeting recruiting needs.

• May create collateral HR materials for trade shows, professional organization meetings, and career fairs. May attend trade shows, professional organization meetings and career fairs.

• May provide training and coaching activities for Talent Acquisition Specialists.

• Performs other job-related duties as assigned


Qualifications:


• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

• Experience as a Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter in a corporate or agency environment

• Proven track record in direct sourcing and managing an end-to-end recruiting process required

• Demonstrated leadership skills

• Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to think and influence strategically

• Proven track record in utilizing creative recruitment techniques and measurement of results

• Ability to work well with multi-functional team and with all levels within organization

• Strong problem solving, influencing, negotiating, facilitating and partnership skills required

• Ability to effectively engage and build relationships with line management, employees, and HR team at all levels

• Excellent organizational skills and ability to effectively manage multiple demands without missing deadlines

• Strong time management skills and able to work independently

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

• Strong written and oral communication skills

• Strong customer services skills

• Strong attention to detail and an ability to maintain confidentiality

We are always excited to connect with great talent. This posting is intended for a [possible] upcoming opportunity rather than a live role. By expressing your interest, you'll be added to our talent pipeline and considered should this role become available.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

raw.description:
About Pacaso

Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We've reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle.

Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than $1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees across 40+ destinations in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. We've raised over $300 million in cumulative equity funding, closed the largest real estate Regulation A+ offering of 2025, and reserved the Nasdaq ticker PCSO as we build toward a public listing.

Our work has been featured in The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, Fortune, Forbes, CNBC, Bloomberg, and others.

Recognition

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for both our culture and our category-defining work:

  • No. 5, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers (2026) — our second consecutive Top 10 ranking
  • Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2025)
  • Winner, 2025 Inman Best of Proptech Awards — Consumer Experience & Marketplace Innovation
  • Fortune & Great Place To Work Best Workplaces in Real Estate (2024)
  • Best Workplace in the Bay Area™ (2023)
  • LinkedIn Top Startup (2022) · Glassdoor Best Places to Work, #6 (2022)

In-House Counsel, Securities & Generalist

About the role

Pacaso is hiring an In-House Counsel to lead our SEC reporting and securities compliance, and to be a trusted generalist partner across the business. You will own the legal side of our periodic filings and disclosure process. You will also support the business on a wide range of other legal matters as they come up.

Roughly half your time will go to securities and governance. The other half will be whatever the business needs, from commercial agreements and real estate to employment, marketing and privacy.

This role suits a lawyer with 3 to 5+ years of law firm or in-house experience in securities or capital markets work who now wants breadth, direct business impact and a seat close to decision-makers. You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Investor Relations, Operations and executive leadership.

What you'll do

SEC reporting and securities

  • Own the preparation and review of the company's SEC filings, including annual, quarterly and current reports, proxy statements and offering materials.
  • Lead the disclosure process with Finance and Accounting.
  • Advise on securities law compliance, including offerings, equity issuances and insider trading.
  • Stay current on SEC rules and guidance, and update policies and processes as needed.

Public company governance and compliance

  • Serve as a primary legal advisor on the company's obligations as an SEC reporting company.
  • Support the board and its committees, including meeting materials, minutes and written consents.
  • Maintain governance documents and company policies.
  • Partner with Finance on disclosure controls and related processes.
  • Maintain entity records and good standing across subsidiaries.

Business and general legal support

You will be a true generalist and a day-to-day legal partner to teams across the company, from the front line to the executive team. We need someone who is excited by variety, comfortable learning new areas quickly, and ready to build legal processes as the company grows.

  • Draft, negotiate and manage agreements, including vendor, partnership, technology and services contracts.
  • Support real estate and property-related matters, including entity structuring, transactions and state-by-state regulatory questions.
  • Partner with People on employment matters such as policies, offer and separation agreements, leave and accommodation questions, and wage-and-hour compliance.
  • Advise Marketing and Sales on advertising, promotions, disclosures and licensing requirements.
  • Support privacy and data protection, including policies, vendor data processing agreements and responses to individual requests.
  • Help manage intellectual property, including trademarks, brand protection and software licensing.
  • Coordinate with outside counsel on litigation, disputes and regulatory inquiries, and manage their budgets and scope.
  • Build scalable legal processes, such as contract templates, intake and approval workflows and playbooks, so the business can move faster with fewer one-off requests.

What you bring

Required

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active bar membership in good standing.
  • 3 to 5+ years of experience at a well-regarded law firm or in-house legal team, with substantial securities or capital markets work.
  • Hands-on experience drafting or reviewing SEC periodic reports and disclosure documents.
  • Working knowledge of federal securities laws and SEC reporting requirements.
  • Experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts, at a law firm or in-house.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar areas of law quickly, and to recognize when to escalate or engage outside counsel.
  • Sound judgment, clear writing, and the ability to explain legal risk in plain terms to non-lawyers.
  • Comfort managing many matters at once with limited supervision.

Preferred

  • In-house or secondment experience at a startup or high-growth company.
  • Exposure to real estate, employment, privacy or intellectual property matters.
  • Experience building templates, playbooks or legal operations processes.
  • Comfort working with non-legal teams as a day-to-day business partner.

Compensation

  • Around $190,000- we will consider experience and location as variables
  • RSU grant

Why You'll Love Working Here

We invest in our Crew the way we invest in our homes — thoughtfully, generously, and with care.

  • Competitive base salary and meaningful equity — every Crew member shares in what we're building
  • Discretionary time off — take the rest you need, when you need it
  • Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Sponsored memberships to One Medical, Peloton, and WellHub for whole-person, modern healthcare
  • 401(k) to help you build long-term security

At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

The Solutions Engineer II plays a critical role in helping customers fully leverage Kpler’s maritime and commodity intelligence solutions to advance their missions. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping clients operationalize our data platforms and APIs, optimize integration workflows, and translate complex maritime and trade data into actionable intelligence.

You will collaborate closely with product, data, and engineering teams to ensure users derive maximum value from Kpler’s AIS data, cargo tracking models, and analytics platforms. From configuring API integrations and supporting analytical workflows, to delivering user training and shaping data solutions for mission use cases, you’ll be at the front lines of helping customers harness Kpler’s technology to achieve impact.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a strategic technical advisor, helping analysts, investigators, and operators utilize Kpler’s maritime and commodity data to support customer missions.
  • Enable customer success by helping them integrate Kpler data feeds and APIs into analytic environments and ensuring seamless technical performance.
  • Lead customer onboarding and training, ensuring analysts and program teams are fluent in Kpler’s data structures, visualization tools, and data delivery capabilities.
  • Diagnose and resolve data or integration issues, coordinating with Kpler’s engineering and customer success teams to deliver rapid, high-quality technical resolutions.
  • Serve as the “voice of the user” by translating customer feedback into actionable product improvements, helping shape the evolution of Kpler’s data solutions.
  • Monitor product adoption and data usage trends, identifying opportunities to expand impact, improve workflows, or develop new analytical capabilities.
  • Contribute to thought leadership and best practices, helping customers apply Kpler data to emerging mission areas — from precursor chemical tracking to trade analysis.

Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in technical consulting, data integration, or solutions engineering
  • Strong technical skills, including experience with APIs (REST/GraphQL), familiar with SQL, RDMS or Big data, data processing (batch/streaming) for ETL and integration (Python, Airflow, Kafka,...), understanding of the cloud constraints.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to translate complex technical concepts into operationally relevant insights for diverse stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative mindset and a passion for solving challenging problems at the intersection of data and technology.
  • Understanding of maritime and trade data, including AIS vessel tracking, port operations, commodities, or customs/supply chain intelligence is a plus.

raw.description:
Are you looking to make an impact and be part of shaping the future of healthcare?

At Semble, we’re looking for an Implementation Manager who can take end-to-end ownership of a portfolio of concurrent customer implementations, including complex, multi-stakeholder projects. You’ll bring structure, sound judgement and a proactive approach to deliver projects through to successful go-live and handover. You will work with a high degree of autonomy, while maintaining clear communication with the Implementation Lead on progress, risks, priorities and decisions.

About Semble

Semble is on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people with a best-in-class cloud-based clinical system that is trusted by thousands of clinicians, empowering them to provide better care, streamline operations, and save costs:

  • 8 million patients in the UK have been treated by clinicians using Semble.
  • We’re the market leader in private primary care and the fastest-growing practice management software in the UK.
  • On the back of our recent Series B funding from Mercia Ventures, Octopus Ventures, Triple Point, and Smedvig Ventures, we’re poised to further accelerate our growth trajectory.

At Semble, our team is proud to unite under strong cultural drivers:

  • Impact – We do work that matters.
  • Collaboration – We are in it together.
  • Human touch – We care deeply.

Location

This role can be fully remote in the UK and EU (with occasional travel to our London office) within +/- 2 hours of the GMT time zone. We are unfortunately not able to consider candidates located outside these locations and time zones at this stage.

What you’ll be doing

Reporting to our Implementation Lead, you will own the full project lifecycle for major customer implementations, planning, governance, execution, and handover, working closely with the Implementation Associates, Customer Success, Sales, Migrations, Technical Solutions and Product teams.

You will:

Own end-to-end delivery

  • Take accountability for delivery across the full implementation lifecycle, from discovery and workflow mapping through configuration, testing, training, go-live and handover.
  • Own delivery across the full implementation lifecycle, proactively driving actions to completion and remaining accountable for delivery quality, including work delegated to others.

Be the trusted client contact

  • Lead relationships with senior clinical, operational and executive stakeholders.
  • Build confidence through clear recommendations, reliable follow-through and a thorough understanding of the client’s workflows, constructively challenging assumptions and requests where needed to support successful delivery.

Shape and deliver the client solution

  • Lead discovery and workflow mapping, translating client requirements into agreed workflow and configuration decisions.
  • Develop strong Semble product expertise and be responsible for configuration, troubleshooting, testing and training, drawing on specialist support where needed.
  • Design training and rollout approaches appropriate to the client’s size, complexity and readiness, including train-the-trainer approaches for larger organisations.

Collaborate cross-functionally

  • Work effectively across CS, Product, Sales, Support, and Migrations teams.
  • Build strong internal relationships and proactively share knowledge.
  • Share knowledge proactively, contribute to team documentation and best practices, and help create an environment where the whole team learns and improves together.

Drive continuous improvement

  • Identify process inefficiencies, contribute to documentation and refinement, and share lessons learnt to improve team practices.

What we’re looking for

  • Proven experience as a Project Manager delivering customer-facing software implementations (ideally in a start-up, healthcare SaaS or another regulated domain).
  • Strong project management fundamentals: scope, schedule, budget, quality, RAID, change control, governance, and stakeholder management.
  • Track record of leading cross-functional teams to outcomes in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of complex implementations, combining independent decision-making with proactive reporting, collaboration and timely escalation.
  • A proven track record of successfully managing multiple customer implementations simultaneously, with examples of balancing competing deadlines, managing dependencies and maintaining delivery quality.
  • Understanding of change management principles and experience supporting clients through adoption challenges.
  • Solid understanding of healthcare workflows and practice management operations (or strong appetite to develop this quickly).
  • Experience mentoring project or implementation colleagues, helping them develop their delivery skills and judgement.
  • Deep product knowledge mindset, comfortable troubleshooting independently and advising clients on best-practice workflows.
  • Tools: confident with common project management and collaboration tooling (e.g., Jira/Confluence, Asana or MS Project, or equivalents).

How we’ll measure success

  • On-time, on-scope delivery for strategic implementations.
  • Time-to-value and adoption targets met post go-live.
  • Quality and timeliness of project documentation.
  • Customer CSAT/NPS and stakeholder feedback.
  • Reduction in post-go-live defects and rework.
  • Clear, consistent reporting to leadership, internal stakeholders and customers.
  • Reliable delivery across the assigned portfolio.

What you’ll get in return

  • The great feeling coming with knowing you do something that matters: shaping the future of healthcare!
  • Up to £75k package (based on your experience and the value you can bring).
  • 36 days off: 25 holidays + bank holidays + 3 extra days (birthday and ‘feel good’ days) – that we will expect you to take so you can recharge and rest.
  • Private Health Insurance – covering physical and mental health, as well as dental and optical!
  • Hybrid & flexible work environment – work from anywhere in the UK, with also some flexibility to work across Europe. You decide how much or how little you go to the office.
  • Get the tech you need – You will get the latest MacBook and take your pick across a wide range of equipment to set up your home office ergonomically.
  • Work alongside an inspiring team – our two founders have started Semble after a successful startup exit, and your future colleagues are all knowledgeable and innovators in their field.
  • Fantastic office space in Central London, right outside Monument – with a roof terrace, weekly animations, loads of natural light, and cute doggies!
  • The usual free bits coming with nice offices (barista coffee, tea, fruits, happy hours and activities...).

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and all walks of life, including any typically underrepresented groups in the technology industry. We also encourage applications from disabled and neurodiverse candidates, so if there are any adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process, please do let us know.

Salary: £65,000 - £75,000

Director, Client Experience (Director, CX)

About the Role

The Director, Client Experience (Director, CX) leads 4-6 Client Experience Managers (CXMs), ensuring high-quality account management and strategic client engagement. This role focuses on driving client satisfaction, retention, and revenue growth through effective portfolio management and team leadership. The Director, CX collaborates with the other Director, CX and leadership team members to align client experience initiatives with company objectives while addressing critical gaps in value communication, automation adoption, and internal knowledge sharing. Director, CX reports to the CEO.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of CXMs to deliver exceptional client experiences and achieve business goals
  • Provide mentorship and career development opportunities to CXM team members
  • Hold teammates accountable to established KPIs and maintain high standards of performance
  • Develop systems to enhance team scalability and manage larger client portfolios effectively

Value Communication & ROI Demonstration

  • Lead initiatives to improve the team's ability to communicate clear ROI and value metrics to clients beyond traditional performance indicators
  • Develop standardized frameworks for conveying campaign impact, cost savings, and business growth outcomes
  • Train CXMs on utilizing comprehensive metrics to demonstrate value through data-driven insights and client-specific success stories
  • Create client-facing materials that effectively translate complex digital marketing results into tangible business value

Portfolio Oversight & Strategic Growth

  • Monitor the health of CXM-managed client portfolios (20-40 clients each), ensuring client satisfaction and retention
  • Drive upsell opportunities and ensure contract renewals, contributing to overall revenue growth
  • Track performance metrics including client NPS (Net Promoter Score), retention rates, and portfolio growth across all CXM-managed accounts
  • Optimize client acquisition costs by improving the ROI of client experience efforts

Automation & AI Integration

  • Champion the adoption of innovative automation tools and AI-driven solutions within the CXM team
  • Lead efforts to implement meaningful AI applications beyond basic reporting, including predictive analytics, automated client communications, and performance optimization
  • Drive the integration of automation frameworks to streamline client management processes and improve team efficiency
  • Ensure CXMs are equipped with cutting-edge tools to enhance client service delivery and reduce manual workloads

Internal Knowledge Base & Self-Sufficiency

  • Spearhead the rollout and adoption of internal knowledge base (IKB) systems to reduce dependency on other departments for routine questions
  • Develop comprehensive training programs that empower CXMs to find answers independently and become subject matter experts
  • Create processes that instill a proactive mindset, encouraging team members to solve problems internally before seeking external assistance
  • Establish clear escalation paths while promoting self-reliance and continuous learning within the team

Client Engagement & Collaboration

  • Act as an escalation point for client concerns, resolving issues promptly and effectively
  • Work closely with the Director, Client Experience and Client Success Lead to streamline collaboration between CSMs and CXMs, ensuring cohesive client support
  • Address client feedback and implement strategies to improve satisfaction and retention
  • Ensure deliverables align with client-specific goals and quality standards

Performance Tracking & Reporting

  • Establish and track key performance metrics for the CXM team, ensuring alignment with organizational goals
  • Monitor and analyze KPIs such as client satisfaction scores, retention rates, and team utilization
  • Review and approve client reports to ensure accuracy and actionable insights

Professional Development & Industry Engagement

  • Encourage and facilitate CXM attendance at client events and industry conferences to strengthen client relationships and represent the company

  • Develop resources and training programs to ensure CXMs are equipped with the tools and skills needed to succeed
  • Stay current with digital marketing trends and agency best practices to guide team development

Requirements

  • Agency Experience Required: Minimum 5-7 years of experience in digital marketing agency environment with proven track record in client relationship management
  • Digital Marketing Strategy Expertise: Comprehensive understanding of digital marketing strategies, campaign optimization, and performance measurement
  • Professional Services Experience Preferred: Experience working with professional services clients, particularly legal, dental, and medical practices is a significant plus
  • Leadership Experience: Proven ability to manage, develop, and scale high-performing teams
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to present complex information in clear, compelling formats to diverse audiences
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong data analysis capabilities with experience in performance tracking and ROI optimization
  • Technology Proficiency: Experience with CRM systems, especially hubspot, automation tools, and emerging AI technologies in marketing applications

Compensation

  • Base Salary: $90,000 - $110,000
  • PTO: Executive Level 2.75 weeks of PTO
  • Sick Time: 40 hours of sick time per year
  • Mental Health Day: 8 hours of mental health time per quarter
  • Bonus: Performance-contingent bonus structure

Location

  • New Jersey

Our Core Values

The Role

This is not a brand role, and it's not a role where an agency does the hands-on work while you manage a calendar. It's for a hands-on generalist with strong data skills who wants to build, ship and measure personally.

Two big surfaces drive our growth: search (hundreds of connector and integration pages like "Facebook Ads to BigQuery" form a huge long-tail opportunity) and AI discovery (when someone asks an AI about marketing data, we want to be the answer). You'll own both, plus the self-serve funnel that turns visitors into paying customers.

What You'll Own:

  • SEO & Content: Keyword research, on-page and programmatic SEO across our connector and integration library. You'll write tutorials and how-tos yourself, not just brief them.

  • GEO / LLM Visibility: Get cited in ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity answers. Understand which sources, directories and citations AI models rely on, and make sure we're in them.

  • Product-Led Growth: Improve free-to-paid conversion with onboarding emails, lifecycle campaigns and in-funnel experiments. Plans start low and there's a free tier, so every step of the funnel counts.

  • Analytics & Reporting: Build your own reports (ideally with Windsor itself), read the funnel from trial to paid, and judge every channel on CAC and payback, not vanity metrics.

  • AI-Powered Execution: Use AI-assisted workflows to research, plan, brief and create faster than anyone else.

Who You Are

You thrive on independence. You write clearly, set your own priorities, and ship without someone checking in. You'd rather see your work show up in the signup numbers than in a slide deck.

  • 3–6 years in B2B SaaS growth, ideally in data, analytics or martech, with real numbers to show for it.

  • Data & martech fluency: You know how GA4, Google Ads, Meta, HubSpot, BigQuery, Looker Studio and Power BI fit together, and what ETL, connectors and attribution mean. You can read a product doc about API integrations, data pipelines or dashboards and turn it into content a marketer or analyst actually wants to read.

  • SEO and content as core skills: Hands-on keyword research, on-page and programmatic SEO, and content-led organic growth.

  • GEO / AI search know-how: You understand how brands get cited in LLM answers and have tried to make it happen.

  • Self-serve SaaS experience: Free-to-paid conversion, onboarding and lifecycle marketing for low-cost, product-led products not enterprise ABM.

  • Analytical self-sufficiency: You build your own dashboards and don't wait for an analyst to tell you what worked.

  • Async, remote execution and excellent written English (our core markets are the US and Europe).

Bonus Points:

  • Paid acquisition on Google and LinkedIn at modest budgets.

  • Video/YouTube tutorials, or working with affiliates and creators (our creator network earns a 30% lifetime revenue share).

  • Basic SQL, or a background as a marketing analyst or at an agency.

  • Partner co-marketing with BI and data-warehouse vendors.

  • Experience marketing to the audiences of tools like Supermetrics, Funnel or Fivetran.

The Offer

We believe in rewarding performance.

  • Competitive Pay: A competitive package with upside tied to growth performance.

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere.

  • Real Ownership: No micromanagement. You own the outcome and the credit.

Want to stand out? Share one growth result you personally drove (the channel, what you did, and the numbers) plus two links to content you wrote or SEO work you shipped.
