Protect yourself and your family with the benefits of working for a world-class employer. When you join Leidos, you join a Fortune 500 company and one of Ethisphere Institute’s “World's Most Ethical Companies”.


We are looking for a GIS Tech in the Orlando, FL area (within a reasonable driving distance to our Orlando, FL office). The position is a "work-from-home" role, but 5-10% travel may be required for storm support and occasional visits to the office as needed.


***The targeted start date for this position will be mid-January 2027.***


***This position requires the selected candidate to work through a temp agency for 6 months before potential conversion to a direct Leidos employee.***


The salary range for this opening is $42,640 - $45,760.


The successful GIS Tech candidate will support some or all of the following activities:

  • Use GIS/CAD software to support electric distribution projects and data maintenance for higher complexity and priority projects.
  • Reference as-builts, work management logs, & other documentation to update GIS data to reflect electric distribution construction completed in the field
  • Identify data inconsistencies and communicate with the appropriate resources to provide accurate data updates to client systems
  • Obtain and manipulate GIS data at state and municipality level
  • Ability to work in an Agile team environment where collaboration and receptiveness to feedback are essential to producing high quality work to meet Leidos & clients’ standards.

GIS Tech Basic Qualifications:

  • Requires 30 credit hours completed in GIS-related program at an accredited university, OR a bachelor's of science degree plus enrollment in a GIS certification program, OR high school diploma plus 2 years of applicable work experience in a GIS-related field.
  • Knowledge of Client Standards preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills
  • Willingness to perform both field and office work. Overnight travel may be required (10-20% travel)
  • Ability to work in outdoor environments
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Visio, Outlook, etc.

GIS Tech Software Experience in one or more programs required:

  • GIS Software such as Small World, Esri Suite (ArcMap, ArcGIS, ArcSDE, ArcIMS, ArcWeb services and ArcGIS Server), QGIS
  • CAD Software such as Bentley Systems (MicroStation), Autodesk (AutoCAD, Maya, Civil 3D)
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Visio, Outlook, etc.) required

Successful candidates can look forward to a fast paced, diverse work environment and flexible work hours/work arrangements as well as managers who will encourage career development and growth including:

  • Technical & Non-Technical Training Opportunities
  • Leadership Opportunities
  • Mentorship & Training Opportunities
  • Opportunity to Lead, Grow, and Inspire a Dynamic Team

In this role, you can also expect to:

  • Interface with local clients
  • Interact with other disciplines (Substation, Protection & Controls, and Civil Structural)
  • Partner with a Variety of Utility Clients Nationwide

Leidos is a trusted and future-focused solutions provider. Utilities consistently come to Leidos for reliable power expertise, as reflected through our work with more than 50 investor-owned utilities and more than 160 municipals/cooperatives across the country as well as a growing number of local utility providers and private developers. Our project portfolio includes large energy projects for electric utilities, power generation owners, and industrial clients. In addition, Leidos works with an established group of industry-leading construction partners delivering meaningful energy delivery solutions. Our recognition as an industry leader is confirmed by the latest national rankings by Engineering News-Record (ENR) ranking Leidos within: the Top 10 T&D Firms, Top 10 Program Management Firms, and Top 20 Power Firms.


PDSDLINE

PowerDelivery

Job Title: Social Work & Community Services Professional (Domain Expert)

Job Type: Contract

Location: Remote (United States or Canada)

Required Skills:

  • Case management

  • Confidentiality

  • Critical thinking

  • Written communication

  • Verbal communication

Job Summary: In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required. Your professional experience in helping people is what matters.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Draw on your experience in social and community services to evaluate real-world case notes, resource guidance, and support communications.

  • Review AI-generated outputs (intake summaries, referral suggestions, care-plan language, responses to people in difficult situations) for accuracy, empathy, appropriate boundaries, and safety.

  • Create realistic but fully anonymized scenarios based on your field experience. Never include real names, case details, or identifying information.

  • Identify risks and gaps in how AI handles sensitive and emotionally difficult situations, and provide detailed feedback.

  • Document findings clearly and offer actionable recommendations to our customer’s team.

  • Contribute to the development of AI training datasets using your professional expertise.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Currently employed full time in a direct-service role, such as social worker, case worker, community health worker, family or youth services worker, or counselor.

  • Based in the United States or Canada.

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in the field.

  • Strong judgment on sensitive topics, with a clear understanding of confidentiality.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on clarity and thoroughness.

  • Ability to explain your reasoning.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • BSW, MSW, or an equivalent degree or license.

  • Experience in child welfare, health care, housing, or schools.

  • Familiarity with emerging trends in AI, automation, or digital tools in human services.

Project Description

We are looking for native Norwegian speakers currently to participate in a voice recording project. Participants will record a set of short wake-up phrases using a designated mobile application. The goal is to collect clear and natural voice recordings for a language data project.

Requirements

  • Native speaker of Norwegian.
  • Both male and female participants are needed.
  • Able to record clear audio in a quiet environment.
  • Comfortable using a mobile application to complete recordings.
  • Willing to provide accurate personal information and sign a consent form before participating.
  • Each participant may take part in the project only once.

Task Details

  • Record 90 short voice samples in total.
  • Record 3 wake-up phrases, repeating each phrase 30 times.
  • Follow the provided recording instructions and guidelines.
  • Complete the recordings using the designated mobile application.
  • Re-record any samples that do not meet quality requirements, if requested.

Additional Information

  • This is a short-term voice recording assignment.
  • No professional voice recording experience is required.
  • Participation is subject to completing the consent process and meeting the project requirements.

raw.title: Full Stack Marketer
raw.excerpt: The Role This is not a brand role, and it's not a role where an agency does the hands-on work while you manage a calendar.
raw.description:
The Role

This is not a brand role, and it's not a role where an agency does the hands-on work while you manage a calendar. It's for a hands-on generalist with strong data skills who wants to build, ship and measure personally.

Two big surfaces drive our growth: search (hundreds of connector and integration pages like "Facebook Ads to BigQuery" form a huge long-tail opportunity) and AI discovery (when someone asks an AI about marketing data, we want to be the answer). You'll own both, plus the self-serve funnel that turns visitors into paying customers.

What You'll Own:

  • SEO & Content: Keyword research, on-page and programmatic SEO across our connector and integration library. You'll write tutorials and how-tos yourself, not just brief them.

  • GEO / LLM Visibility: Get cited in ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity answers. Understand which sources, directories and citations AI models rely on, and make sure we're in them.

  • Product-Led Growth: Improve free-to-paid conversion with onboarding emails, lifecycle campaigns and in-funnel experiments. Plans start low and there's a free tier, so every step of the funnel counts.

  • Analytics & Reporting: Build your own reports (ideally with Windsor itself), read the funnel from trial to paid, and judge every channel on CAC and payback, not vanity metrics.

  • AI-Powered Execution: Use AI-assisted workflows to research, plan, brief and create faster than anyone else.

Who You Are

You thrive on independence. You write clearly, set your own priorities, and ship without someone checking in. You'd rather see your work show up in the signup numbers than in a slide deck.

  • 3–6 years in B2B SaaS growth, ideally in data, analytics or martech, with real numbers to show for it.

  • Data & martech fluency: You know how GA4, Google Ads, Meta, HubSpot, BigQuery, Looker Studio and Power BI fit together, and what ETL, connectors and attribution mean. You can read a product doc about API integrations, data pipelines or dashboards and turn it into content a marketer or analyst actually wants to read.

  • SEO and content as core skills: Hands-on keyword research, on-page and programmatic SEO, and content-led organic growth.

  • GEO / AI search know-how: You understand how brands get cited in LLM answers and have tried to make it happen.

  • Self-serve SaaS experience: Free-to-paid conversion, onboarding and lifecycle marketing for low-cost, product-led products not enterprise ABM.

  • Analytical self-sufficiency: You build your own dashboards and don't wait for an analyst to tell you what worked.

  • Async, remote execution and excellent written English (our core markets are the US and Europe).

Bonus Points:

  • Paid acquisition on Google and LinkedIn at modest budgets.

  • Video/YouTube tutorials, or working with affiliates and creators (our creator network earns a 30% lifetime revenue share).

  • Basic SQL, or a background as a marketing analyst or at an agency.

  • Partner co-marketing with BI and data-warehouse vendors.

  • Experience marketing to the audiences of tools like Supermetrics, Funnel or Fivetran.

The Offer

We believe in rewarding performance.

  • Competitive Pay: A competitive package with upside tied to growth performance.

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere.

  • Real Ownership: No micromanagement. You own the outcome and the credit.

Want to stand out? Share one growth result you personally drove (the channel, what you did, and the numbers) plus two links to content you wrote or SEO work you shipped.

raw.title: Principal Consultant
raw.excerpt: Position Summary Prometheus Federal Services (PFS) is a trusted partner to federal health agencies.
raw.description:
Position Summary
Prometheus Federal Services (PFS) is a trusted partner to federal health agencies. We are seeking a Principal Consultant to lead strategic growth and client engagement across the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), with a focus on the Veterans Health Administration (VHA). This candidate will work closely with internal teams and VA clients to develop integrated program solutions and oversee project execution across multiple capability areas.
This role is responsible for driving business development, managing relationships with key stakeholders, and expanding existing contracts. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in VA operations and Program Management Office (PMO) support, and a strong track record of leading cross-functional teams, winning new awards and recompetes, and delivering strategic solutions.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Client Leadership & Delivery
  • Own and manage senior-level federal client relationships, serving as a trusted strategic advisor
  • Lead project planning and execution across complex, multi-task-order engagements, ensuring alignment with contract requirements and client expectations
  • Anticipate client needs and deliver innovative, actionable solutions that create measurable value
  • Oversee project risk management, issue resolution, subcontractor performance, and delivery quality across multidisciplinary teams
Financial & Portfolio Management
  • Manage a portfolio of federal engagements, including firm-fixed-price and time-and-materials contracts, with accountability for revenue performance, utilization, and profitability
  • Oversee staffing plans, recruiting and retention, resource allocation, and financial management for contracts
  • Ensure delivery aligns with contractual requirements, company expectations, and profitability targets
Growth & Business Development
  • Assess new opportunities and support pursuit decisions based on strategic fit and viability
  • Lead and participate in capture activities for active bids, including color team reviews and capture planning
  • Contribute to proposal development, including technical approach, past performance, and staffing strategies
  • Support new, add-on, recompete, and follow-on sales efforts with existing client accounts
People Leadership & Culture
  • Lead and develop high-performing teams through coaching, mentorship, and stretch assignments
  • Identify and develop a diverse pipeline of high-potential consultants and future leaders
  • Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Contribute to firm-wide initiatives that strengthen organizational culture, improve operations and governance, and reinforce delivery excellence
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree required. A Master’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, or a related field is preferred; candidates without a Master’s degree must have sixteen (16) or more years of relevant experience
  • Minimum of twelve (12) years of relevant experience in federal healthcare, government consulting, or program/project management
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex federal engagements and managing multidisciplinary teams
  • Experience overseeing project financials, staffing models, and delivery performance
  • Active PMP certification
  • Proven ability to mentor staff and build high-performing teams
  • Experience leading or supporting business development activities, including capture and proposal efforts
  • Familiarity with VA programs and operations, including VHA, the Veterans Benefits Administration (VBA), the National Cemetery Administration (NCA), or VA enterprise offices
  • Strong judgment, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
  • Proficiency in the Microsoft 365 / Office suite (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Planner)
  • Ability to work in the U.S. indefinitely without sponsorship
  • Ability to obtain a public trust
Preferred Qualifications
  • Master’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, or a related field
  • Direct experience supporting VHA or other federal health agencies
  • Experience leading capture for recompetes or new awards valued at $100M or more
  • SAFe, agile, or related delivery certification
  • Experience with pipeline and work-management tools such as Salesforce or Jira
  • Experience contributing to CMMI or similar process-maturity initiatives

Compensation & Benefits

PFS offers a benefits package that may include health, dental, and vision coverage; flexible spending accounts; disability and life insurance; a retirement plan; paid time off; and other programs to support employees and their families. Learn more about PFS Benefits.

The posted salary range represents PFS's good-faith estimate for this role. Actual compensation offered will be determined by a combination of factors, including but not limited to: the candidate's education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience;internal equity; geographic location; and contract and organizational requirements. PFS is committed to fair, consistent, and equitable compensation practices across the organization, and offers are calibrated to maintain internal pay equity while remaining competitive in the external market.

Salary Range: $ - $

Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, political affiliation, military service, or other status protected by law.

Accommodations

PFS is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at . Reasonable accommodations are available to ensure applicants with disabilities have equal access to the hiring process, in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable laws.

Workplace Health, Safety, and Compliance

This position may be subject to client‑specific or government‑mandated vaccination, health, or safety requirements, which may change over time.

Texting Privacy Policy and Information:

  • Message type: Informational; you will receive text messages regarding your application and potentially regarding interview scheduling.
  • No mobile information will be shared with third parties/affiliates for marketing/promotional purposes.
  • Message frequency will vary depending on the application process.
  • Msg & data rates may apply.
  • Opt out at any time by texting "stop".

Allego is a rapidly growing SaaS technology company in the Boston area and creator of the market-leading Revenue Enablement Platform. Our technology helps Go-To-Market teams build the skills and access the knowledge they need to succeed in every selling situation.

Allego is the only revenue enablement platform to be named a Leader in both the Forrester Wave™ and the inaugural Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Revenue Enablement Platforms.

Not only are we growing quickly, but we’ve also been recognized as a top place to work by The Boston Business Journal, The Boston Globe, and Inc. Magazine. In addition, Selling Power named Allego one of the 50 Best Companies to Sell For in both 2025 and 2026.

What You'll Do at Allego:

We are seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer to join our growing Development team, offering the chance to work in a collaborative environment as well as the opportunity to work with colleagues across the Atlantic and around the world.

You will be responsible for testing new features, product enhancements and fixes relating to the Allego platform and all associated products.

Our ambitious roadmap is leveraging some of the latest technologies in order to create exciting new features. As part of an Agile team, from sprint kickoff through to reporting bugs (and everything in between) you will be fully engaged in the development process and be able to make a real difference to the ongoing success of the team.

  • Work with a distributed Engineering team including development of web applications, server components, integrations and native iOS and Android mobile applications.
  • Actively participate in team standups, refining, estimating and retrospective sessions.
  • Create well structured test cases which comprehensively cover specification and ensure high quality outcomes.
  • Test complex distributed systems across microservices, web applications, mobile platforms, and third-party integrations.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts to continuously expand test coverage and streamline regression testing.
  • Raise and report quality issues clearly and concisely.
  • Follow through with Development and Product to ensure timely and accurate bug fixes.
  • Ensure quality of cross-browser, non-functional and accessibility requirements.
  • Ensure quality of existing features and help maintain and execute regression pack.
  • Support and undertake tasks delegated by the QA Lead or QA Manager.
  • Delegate tasks to other team members as needed to ensure testing is completed within defined timelines.

About You

You're curious and proactive - when something looks off, you dig in rather than wait to be told. You design test strategies independently, pick up new tools and frameworks quickly, and know when to collaborate versus driving technical solutions autonomously.

You take ownership: complex edge cases and escaped bugs get thoroughly analyzed and resolved, not left behind. You manage your workload efficiently, champion quality best practices, and assist in mentoring team members, and view every feature as an opportunity to raise the bar for platform reliability.

Experience You'll Bring to Allego:

    • 3+ years of Quality Assurance experience testing complex distributed systems, preferably in a SaaS environment.
    • Ability to create and manage all testware (test cases, cycles, data).
    • Familiarity with Agile frameworks (SCRUM, Kanban).
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
    • Ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical teams.
    • Experience with Jira / Test Management Systems / Google Workspace.
    • Experience with manual testing web and mobile applications preferred.
    • Solid understanding of security best practices, secure coding principles, and non-functional testing for SaaS applications.
    • Knowledge of CRM systems (Salesforce / MS Dynamics) is beneficial.
    • Hands-on experience building, executing, and maintaining automated test scripts using frameworks such as WebdriverIO, Cypress, or Selenium is beneficial.
    • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and using tools like BrowserStack is beneficial.
    • Motivation and confidence to suggest improvements to strengthen test effectiveness.
    • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related field, or related experience required.

Compensation & Benefits:

£40,000 - £51,000 + equity

  • Private Healthcare Plan
  • Holiday & Sick Time
  • Pension Scheme

Operating Principles

Allego’s Operating Principles are at the heart of our business. They are the fabric of our culture and central to our approach to work, our customers and each other. Interested in learning more? Read more here!

Allego collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. If you are a European Job Applicant see the privacy notice for further details.

Allego does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits. raw.excerpt: Company Overview: Arctiq is a leader in professional IT services and managed services across three core Centers of Excellence: Enterprise Security, Modern Infrastructure, and Platform Engineering.
raw.description:
Company Overview:

Arctiq is a leader in professional IT services and managed services across three core Centers of Excellence: Enterprise Security, Modern Infrastructure, and Platform Engineering. Renowned for our ability to architect intelligence, we connect, protect, and transform organizations, empowering them to thrive in today's digital landscape. Arctiq builds on decades of industry expertise and a customer-centric ethos to deliver exceptional value to clients across diverse industries.

Position Overview:

We are looking for a Dynatrace Senior Consultant with a network engineering background to deliver observability engagements for Arctiq customers. Working under the direction of our Delivery Architects, you will bring network visibility into Dynatrace and help customers retire legacy network monitoring tools, including SolarWinds, in favor of a unified platform. You understand how networks fail and know how to turn network signals into insight that application and operations teams can use.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver Dynatrace implementations for SaaS and Managed environments, following designs set by the Delivery Architect.
  • Implement network monitoring in Dynatrace, including SNMP, flow data, network device metrics, and synthetic network and availability monitoring.
  • Execute SolarWinds takeout projects, including inventorying monitored devices, mapping existing polling, alerts, and dashboards to Dynatrace equivalents, validating parity, and decommissioning the legacy tool.
  • Build and deploy Dynatrace extensions for network devices and vendors (such as Cisco, Palo Alto, F5, and Juniper), and configure ActiveGates for network monitoring.
  • Correlate network signals with application and infrastructure telemetry so teams can identify network-related root causes.
  • Configure observability for cloud networking, including VPCs and VNets, load balancers, DNS, and connectivity paths in AWS and Azure.
  • Implement OpenTelemetry-based pipelines that route network and infrastructure telemetry into Dynatrace.
  • Implement configuration as code for Dynatrace using Terraform and the Dynatrace Configuration APIs and tooling.
  • Configure core observability capabilities such as tagging, synthetics, RUM, logging, and dashboards.
  • Support Gen2 to Gen3 migration workstreams, including network dashboards and alerting.
  • Document solutions and run knowledge-transfer sessions so customer teams can operate independently.
  • Keep delivery work on scope, schedule, and budget, and flag risks early to the Delivery Architect and engagement lead.
  • Travel up to 25% for project kick-offs, workshops, and close-outs.
  • Pursue continued education through training and industry certifications.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in network engineering, network operations, or network monitoring, including 2+ years delivering on the Dynatrace platform or a comparable observability tool.
  • Strong understanding of network protocols and signals (TCP/IP, DNS, BGP, SNMP, NetFlow/IPFIX, syslog, and streaming telemetry).
  • Hands-on experience with SolarWinds or a comparable network monitoring platform, ideally in a migration or replacement project.
  • Working knowledge of Dynatrace Managed and SaaS deployments.
  • Familiarity with core observability practices: tagging, synthetics, RUM, logging, and dashboards.
  • Active Dynatrace Associate certification, or willingness to obtain it within the first 90 days.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work directly with customer network and operations teams.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.

Technical Requirements:

  • Experience with AWS or Azure networking.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and Git-based workflows.
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes networking.
  • Scripting proficiency (Python, Bash, or PowerShell).
  • Exposure to OpenTelemetry (OTel) and observability pipelines.

Nice to have:

  • Network certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent.
  • Experience building or customizing Dynatrace extensions.
  • Exposure to Gen2 to Gen3 Dynatrace migration.
  • Active higher-level Dynatrace certification, such as Dynatrace Implementation or Dynatrace Professional.
  • Experience with other network monitoring platforms such as Kentik, ThousandEyes, and Splunk.

Arctiq is an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations or adjustments throughout the interview process and beyond, please let us know. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply.

We thank you for your interest in joining the Arctiq team! While we welcome all applicants, only those who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

raw.description:
Remote-based in the US

Overview

GoodPower is a global organization working to unlock the economic potential of decarbonization through research, innovation, strategic communications, and disruptive technology. We focus on advancing more affordable and reliable energy, expanding economic opportunity, strengthening energy security, supporting healthier and more resilient communities, and accelerating the transition to a predictable, secure, modern low-carbon economy.

Operating at the intersection of data, digital media, emerging technology, behavioral research, and public engagement, GoodPower develops and deploys scalable strategies designed to accelerate the adoption of decarbonized technologies and infrastructure—including renewable energy, regenerative agriculture, energy storage, and electric transportation. Our work combines rigorous research and experimentation with advanced communications and innovation capabilities to better understand public attitudes, test effective interventions, and help build the social, economic, and market conditions necessary for large-scale transformation.

GoodPower is at a pivotal stage of organizational growth as we approach completion of the first year of our 2030 Strategic Plan. Over the next five years, we intend to significantly expand our reach, capabilities, and impact—investing deeply in innovation, AI-enabled systems, data and analytics, research and development, and next-generation communications infrastructure to help accelerate the global energy transition and the economic opportunities it creates.

Job Summary

The Director of Client Services will play a central role in advancing GoodPower’s mission by building and leading high-impact partnerships with the organizations, campaigns, and communities we serve. This leader will oversee the full client lifecycle, from onboarding through ongoing engagement and expansion, ensuring every partner experiences the depth of GoodPower’s expertise and the transformative potential of our work.

The Director of Client Services will serve as a strategic connector between GoodPower’s internal teams and its external partners, ensuring campaigns are delivered with excellence, relationships are nurtured with care, and outcomes are measured and communicated with clarity. This role is a key driver of GoodPower’s growth trajectory as we scale to meet the demands of an accelerating energy transition. As GoodPower grows, this role is expected to build and lead a client services team.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States and reporting to the Chief Growth Officer. The Director of Client Services will work from home, meet daily by video chat with GoodPower team members and partners, and conduct most work online, with in-person meetings as needed. The Director of Client Services must be available for travel within the United States and potentially abroad, and to participate in staff retreats, client meetings, and conferences.

Key Responsibilities

Lead client relationships

  • Serve as the senior strategic point of contact for a portfolio of key client accounts, building trusted, long-term relationships with partner organizations, advocates, and campaigns.
  • Lead client onboarding so partners begin with clear expectations, defined success metrics, and a solid understanding of GoodPower’s capabilities.
  • Present regular performance reports and strategic recommendations to clients, translating campaign data into actionable insights.
  • Identify opportunities to deepen and expand client engagements, working with leadership to develop proposals, scope new work, and meet revenue or partnership goals.

Connect clients and internal teams

  • Partner with GoodPower’s programs, paid media, social, creator, creative, lifecycle, and data teams to deliver client programs on time, within scope, and to a high standard.
  • Bring client feedback back to leadership and delivery teams to improve GoodPower’s offerings and processes.
  • Stay current on the policy landscape, advocacy ecosystem, and clean energy sector so client conversations and campaign planning have relevant context.
  • Represent GoodPower at external events, partner convenings, and industry conferences.

Lead the client services function

  • Document and improve GoodPower’s client services processes (onboarding, scoping, status reporting, renewal, and offboarding) within our existing Jira and Confluence environment, so the work is consistent, visible, and repeatable.
  • Update Jira workflows, boards, and dashboards for client services, and update Confluence documents as the team’s source of truth for playbooks, client documentation, and templates.
  • Establish standards for client communication, performance reporting, and service quality, along with the metrics used to track client health and retention.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in client services or account management including at least five years in a senior or leadership role.
  • Client services experience in marketing, digital or advertising is required for this role.
  • Experience in climate, clean energy, or decarbonization, and working with private sector clients in one of these sectors is required for this role.
  • Proven experience building or scaling a client services or account management function, including designing processes, playbooks, and reporting standards that others can follow.
  • Proven track record of growing client accounts and contributing to revenue or partnership development goals concretely.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex client relationships at once, with strong organizational skills and the judgment to prioritize without close supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting complex information clearly to clients and senior leadership.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience turning campaign performance data into strategic recommendations.
  • Proficiency with project management and documentation platforms such as Jira, Confluence, Asana, or similar, as well as required proficiency in Google Workspace and Slack.
  • Comfort and experience working in a startup or high-growth organization that moves at a fast and dynamic pace.
  • Experience hiring, managing, and developing staff with clear evidence of readiness to build and lead a team.

Desired Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Jira workflows and maintaining Confluence spaces for a client-facing team.
  • Experience using AI tools or agentic AI workflows to improve client delivery and client management operations.

This description reflects GoodPower’s assignment of essential functions; it does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. GoodPower retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time. Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship. GoodPower has a zero-tolerance standard for abuse and inappropriate behavior by staff members.

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks

  • Annual salary range: $125,000 - 135,000, commensurate with experience
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance with employee and dependent premiums paid at 95-100% by GoodPower.
  • 2-4 weeks of paid vacation annually, depending on seniority
  • 13 paid holidays and 2 floating holidays
  • 2 weeks of US office closure
  • 10 days of paid sick leave annually.
  • 403(b) with 3% employer contribution/match.
  • Charitable giving: 1:1 match for charitable contributions ($250 per year), plus 2 paid days off for volunteering.
  • Education reimbursement up to $1,500 per year.
  • Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings options
  • Stipend of $200/month (for cell phone, wellness expenses, etc.)
  • 8 weeks of paid sabbatical after 5 years of employment
  • 8 weeks of paid parental leave

GoodPower offers competitive compensation and benefits packages to employees around the world. Because we operate in multiple countries, benefits will vary based on local laws, regulations, customary practices, and organizational policies applicable in each location.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Statement

GoodPower is an equal-opportunity employer that highly values diversity, equity, and inclusion and views the climate crisis as a social justice crisis.

People who identify as Black, Indigenous, and People of Color (BIPOC), people who experience gender oppression, people with disabilities, and people who identify as members of the LGBTQIA+ community are particularly encouraged to apply.

GoodPower is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities. Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, GoodPower will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities who need an accommodation to perform the essential functions of the position. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or employment process, please contact

Automated Application Review Disclosure

To help us process high volumes of applications fairly and efficiently, GoodPower utilizes Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDTs). These tools scan, evaluate, and rank candidate resumes based on how closely their skills, experience, and qualifications match the core requirements of this job posting.

  • Data Privacy: Your resume data will only be processed for this specific application and will be handled securely in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
  • Human Oversight: Final hiring decisions are always made by a human recruiter or hiring manager.

By submitting an application, you consent to the use of automated tools to review and assess your application materials for this position.

raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

raw.description:
The Rapid7 Incident Responder is a hands-on, technical role focused on digital forensics and incident response that offers various customer-facing and consulting opportunities. Rapid7 Incident Responders split their time between reactive breach response cases—supporting Rapid7 customers in their greatest time of need—and proactive customer engagements, delivering threat hunting and detection and response exercises with dedicated internal security teams. Rapid7 aims to provide sustainable work-life balance that allows talented Detection & Response experts to thrive in a reactive Incident Response setting.


About the Team

The Rapid7 Incident Response team is the tip of the spear within Rapid7's Detection & Response practice, ensuring 24/7 breach response coverage for MDR and retainer customers. Delivering services through Rapid7's portfolio—including InsightIDR and Velociraptor—the team's frontline experiences directly inform Rapid7's Product organization to drive continuous improvement across both managed and standalone solutions.


About the Role

As an Incident Responder, your primary responsibility will be to manage major incident response engagements embedded within Rapid7 MDR SOC pods, with oversight from Senior Incident Responders, while dedicating time to ongoing research and service enablement. Specifically, your focus will be to:

  • Deliver end-to-end incident response services, managing customer engagements from initial scoping to final reporting across the entire IR lifecycle.
  • Coordinate and guide SOC Analysts during major investigations and provide mentorship on minor incident investigations.
  • Conduct forensic investigations using real-time telemetry from the InsightIDR platform and endpoint artifacts from Velociraptor.
  • Lead proactive threat hunting through Rapid7’s Compromise Assessment offering utilizing Velociraptor and other EDR technologies.
  • Execute threat emulation activities as part of Rapid7’s Detection & Response Workshop, helping clients assess their readiness against major threats using existing tools.
  • Advise clients on security best practices and mitigation strategies through enterprise security controls.
  • Research and apply knowledge of emerging attacker methodologies to enhance internal methodologies, procedures, and response efforts.
  • Contribute to public blogs and webinars by sharing actionable insights on the latest attacker techniques uncovered during investigations.

The skills and qualities you'll bring include

  • Bring 2-3 years of hands-on incident response experience, including technical investigations, forensic analysis, and analyzing Windows, Mac, or Linux artifacts to assess threat actor activity.
  • Apply deep knowledge of enterprise security, integrating technologies such as EDR, SIEM, Velociraptor, and OSQuery to enhance threat detection and streamline response.
  • Demonstrate strong technical expertise in at least two specialized areas, including host forensics (Windows, Mac, Linux), network traffic analysis, log review, malware triage, or cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Communicate complex investigation findings and remediation steps in a clear, structured manner that conveys objectives and rationale to both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, including executives and legal teams.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across internal SOC pods and external customer teams to understand business needs, align on response strategies, and deliver measurable value.
  • Hold yourself and others responsible for driving end-to-end investigation outcomes, meeting strict timelines, and maintaining high standards of delivery across competing priorities and an on-call rotation (including evening and weekend shifts).
  • Navigate evolving threat landscapes and shifting incident priorities with agility, remaining forward-focused while adapting investigation approaches in high-pressure, ambiguous environments.
  • Hold relevant industry certifications such as GCIA, GCIH, GDAT, GCFE, GFCA, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success.

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That’s because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don’t be shy - apply today.


About Rapid7

At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.


Protecting 11,500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.


Rapid7, Inc. is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. We evaluate compensation decisions on a case-by-case basis, and it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the very top of the salary range.

This position is responsible for creating the business strategy aimed at obtaining new growth opportunities for new and existing accounts within the Medicaid (State Agency, MCO plans) and Medicare Advantage markets, as well as strategic exploration into new opportunities. This includes managing the sales, proposals, and marketing teams to drive successful growth opportunities.

raw.excerpt: Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together Our Meaningful Mission At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates.
raw.description:
Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together
Our Meaningful Mission

At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech. Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognises and supports global connections.

Who You'll Be Joining
We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners, always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners, treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

Our Core Commitments — What We Live By
Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:
  • Integrity:We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
  • Outcomes:We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
  • Velocity: We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

Perks of Joining Our Team
We are embarking on an exciting journey to build out our global Marketing analytics capability. Our culture is built on high trust, which empowers colleagues and fosters the high ownership necessary to meet our shared expectations and deliver high performance. As a remote-first company, you have the flexibility to work wherever you feel most focused and productive within your employing country. This freedom comes with wonderful, tailored, location-specific perks designed to support your whole life, not just your work. These benefits include unlimited annual leave, great healthcare, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact, and in turn, we expect high ownership and commitment. This is a place where trust and high performance are valued, and we provide the environment and support you need to excel. We prioritise an environment where we openly share ideas, embrace our mistakes, and learn from them—collaboration is key to everything we do!

About the role
As a Senior Data Scientist, you will champion data science within our FinCrime-Fraud-AI-ML team. You will design, build and own the machine learning models that stop bad actors, while improving the experience for our legitimate customers. You'll start by finding the quick wins, then lead more ambitious, innovative work.
You'll join a highly collaborative FinCrime squad of Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers and Backend Engineers, and partner closely with fraud analysts, operations and product. Your initial focus is fraud detection; as the role evolves, you'll have the chance to extend your impact into areas such as risk and credit rating.

What you'll do
  • Model lifecycle: own fraud detection models end to end, from problem framing and feature engineering to training, evaluation and deployment. Automate training and deployment so models are scalable, documented, tested and monitored for drift.
  • Fraud detection: build models that score transactions, accounts and customer behaviour in real time, covering threats such as account takeover, stolen payment credentials, first-party fraud, scams and mule activity.
  • Data and features:work with Data and Analytical Engineering to bring new data sources into our models using dbt best practices, including transactional, device, behavioural and identity signals.
  • Experimentation: design and run experiments to measure the impact of new models, third-party data sources and emerging tools on fraud losses, approval rates and customer experience.
  • Commercial translation:turn complex business needs into solvable data science projects, and set thresholds that balance fraud losses against friction for legitimate customers.
  • Continuous improvement:keep scrutinising our methods to improve model accuracy and the quality of data inputs, and respond quickly as fraud patterns change.
  • Empowerment:build tools and strategies that help non-technical stakeholders understand and act on model results.
  • Leadership: mentor other data scientists, review their work and help set technical standards for the team.
What you'll bring
  • 6+ years' in the Data Science space, including but not limited to, hands on experience with regression analysis, clustering methods, boosting algorithms, feature/model selection, training and deploying models that deliver measurable value
  • Results Driven: Excels at driving technical results in a business oriented framework.
  • Experience in fraud, financial crime, risk or a similar adversarial domain, ideally in payments, fintech or banking, including imbalanced classification and delayed or noisy labels.
  • Strong Coding Skills in Python and ability to use Python for automation, application deploymentSQL: Expert skills in CTEs, joins, and subqueries to manipulate complex datasets for modeling.
  • The ability to deploy your own models and set up the monitoring they need.
  • Familiarity with a modern stack: scikit-learn, BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks, and visualisation tools such as Looker, Tableau or Streamlit.
  • A problem-solving mindset that balances technical excellence with commercial impact. You're comfortable over-communicating and adapt quickly to changing priorities.

Nice to have
  • Experience with AWS services such as SageMaker, ECS and EMR.
  • Advanced knowledge of experimentation design and evaluation.
  • Graph analytics or graph ML for detecting fraud rings and mule networks.
  • Real-time or streaming ML with low-latency scoring.
  • Model explainability techniques such as SHAP, and experience with model risk governance.
  • Knowledge of cross-border payments or remittances, and the regulations around fraud and AML.
  • A “tenacious” attitude—you are willing to do things manually when necessary but seek to automate at every opportunity.

AI Literacy & Tools
As Zepz continues to build AI into how we work, we expect everyone to engage with it as a core part of their role. For this position we are looking for:
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and how it can be applied in your area of work — from accelerating analysis and insight generation, to improving how we design and deliver processes and communications.
  • Practical experience using AI tools in a professional context — whether to connect information, draft content, build frameworks, or create insights from data. We want people who actively use AI to increase productivity, not those who are waiting to be told to.
  • Strong AI literacy — an understanding of what AI assistants can and cannot do, how to prompt effectively, and how to critically evaluate AI-generated output before using it.
  • Awareness of the ethical considerations and responsible use of AI in the workplace, particularly in the context of sensitive data, customer experience, and compliance.
  • Prior experience using Claude (Anthropic) is a nice-to-have but not essential — what matters most is that you are genuinely engaged with AI as a tool, comfortable experimenting, and eager to share what works with your wider team

Our global team of 800+ people is spread across six continents. We aspire to hire the best mix of people from former Olympians to YouTube influencers and we speak over twenty languages. This incredible diversity isn't a bonus; it's the engine that lets us serve the world.

Ready to Apply? Let’s Go!

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

About the Role:

As a Product Marketing Manager, you will work directly under experienced Marketing leadership and alongside senior PMMs who set the strategic direction while giving you real ownership to build, ship, and see your work impact JumpCloud.

Responsibilties:

  • Build High-Impact Sales Plays & Enablement: Create practical pitch decks, competitive battlecards, demo scripts, and objection-handling guides that equip our global sales team to win more deals.

  • Craft Buyer-Centric Messaging & Collateral: Translate complex Identity and Access Management (IAM), directory services, and cloud security capabilities into clear, compelling marketing assets for technical buyers.

  • Deliver Actionable Competitive Intelligence: Research key competitors, map out JumpCloud’s differentiators, and turn market insights into takeaways the sales and marketing teams can use right away.

  • Turn Short Briefs into Finished Work Fast: Partner with Marketing leadership, senior PMMs, sales, and product teams to take well-defined project briefs and deliver polished assets on tight timelines.

  • Use AI to Move at High Velocity: Leverage modern AI productivity tools and workflows to speed up research, sharpen copy, and scale your output across GTM initiatives.

What We're Looking for:

  • 2–4 Years of B2B Experience: Background in B2B SaaS or tech across roles such as product marketing, sales enablement, content marketing, customer marketing, field/partner marketing, demand generation, or corporate communications—or customer-facing roles like Sales Engineer, SDR, or Customer Success Manager with standout writing skills.

  • Crisp, Persuasive Writing: Proven ability to take technical concepts and distill them into clear, engaging copy that resonates with business and technical buyers.

  • Rapid Learning Curve: Ability to quickly master a new product, buyer persona, and competitive landscape, even without a traditional PMM background.

  • Strong Listening & Execution: You listen closely, ask smart questions up front, and turn a concise brief into the right deliverable the first time.

  • High Bias for Action & Coachability: You turn work around quickly, welcome direct feedback without ego, iterate fast, and proactively look for the next task.

  • Reliability & Creative Problem-Solving: You hit your deadlines, flag blockers early when they arise, and show up with proposed solutions rather than just questions.

  • Bilingual Communication: Full professional fluency in English (for global GTM collaboration and asset creation) and Spanish.

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
This role is remote in the country of Mexico. You must be located in and authorized to work in Mexico to be considered for this role.

Language:

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud®?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.
One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.
JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at with the subject line "Scam Notice"

Join Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific and help deliver high-quality imaging services that support clinical trials around the world. As an Imaging Research Associate within our Medical Imaging team, you will play a critical role in coordinating site and operational activities from study startup through study closeout, ensuring the timely delivery of imaging data, site support, and study-related services. Working closely with Project Managers, clinical sites, sponsors, and cross-functional teams, you will help maintain data quality, support imaging quality control processes, and contribute to the successful execution of global clinical research programs.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package with flexible benefits.
  • Private medical insurance, plus life and accident coverage.
  • Company pension contribution to support your long-term financial wellbeing.
  • Mental health and wellbeing support, with resources designed to help you thrive both professionally and personally

What You'll Be Doing

  • Coordinate imaging site and operational activities throughout the study lifecycle, from startup through closeout.
  • Support site qualification activities by collecting, reviewing, and tracking required study documentation.
  • Schedule and coordinate site training, technical training, and onboarding activities.
  • Assist with the preparation, distribution, and maintenance of study materials and site communications.
  • Review, process, track, and monitor imaging and study-related data received from clinical sites.
  • Generate and manage site reports, patient reports, queries, and communications for sponsors and study teams.
  • Investigate, track, and support resolution of data discrepancies and logistical edit checks.
  • Monitor study systems and escalate issues related to databases, imaging platforms, and analysis systems.
  • Perform imaging quality control activities, including collection, review, tracking, and processing of imaging quality control data.
  • Coordinate crosscalibration phantom activities, scanner qualification processes, machine changes, and equivalency assessments.
  • Support image quality monitoring through data analysis, data entry, and documentation review.
  • Maintain imaging quality control tracking systems and study databases to ensure accurate and complete records.
  • Assist Project Managers with study startup planning, project administration, project tracking, and operational coordination.
  • Participate in project meetings, sponsor calls, training sessions, and internal study discussions.
  • Generate and distribute project tracking reports while monitoring study progress, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Identify trends, risks, and issues related to site performance and data quality and communicate recommendations to project leadership.
  • Support resolution of client and site issues while maintaining a high level of customer service and responsiveness.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, departmental standards, and process enhancements.

What We Look For

  • High school diploma required; Associate's degree or Bachelor's degree in Bioscience, Computer Science, Information Technology, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience within clinical research, healthcare, imaging operations, pharmaceutical services, or a related industry preferred.
  • Understanding of clinical trial processes, drug development, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), or regulated environments is advantageous.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and database systems.
  • Ability to navigate file systems, maintain accurate documentation, and manage electronic records.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively in English.
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
  • Customer-focused mindset with the ability to build productive relationships with sites, sponsors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.

At Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

raw.title: Embedded Threat Intelligence Analyst Team Lead
raw.excerpt: Position Summary We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Threat Intelligence Team Lead to support a client's global security and risk management functions.
raw.description:
Position Summary

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Threat Intelligence Team Lead to support a client's global security and risk management functions. Embedded within the client environment, you will identify, investigate, assess, and communicate threats and emerging risks impacting personnel, operations, assets, facilities, and brand reputation, while providing day-to-day leadership and oversight to a small team of Threat Intelligence Analysts.

In addition to the analytical responsibilities, as a Threat Intelligence Team Lead, you will oversee the team's day-to-day intelligence delivery, establish priorities, coordinate workloads, quality-assure analytical products, and provide coaching and mentorship to team members. You will serve as a key point of contact for client stakeholders, helping translate intelligence requirements into clear team priorities and ensuring the consistent delivery of timely, relevant, and high-quality intelligence.

You will work closely with stakeholders across corporate security, physical security, investigations, and business operations teams to deliver timely intelligence products, investigative findings, and operational support.

Working hours and arrangement: this is a fully remote role working hours are Monday to Friday, 8 am .- 5 pm, with occasional weekend coverage expected.

Essential Functions / Responsibilities

  • Monitor, collect, and analyze information from a variety of sources to identify threats, risks, and emerging trends impacting personnel, operations, assets, facilities, and brand reputation.
  • Conduct online investigations into threat actors, online communities, suspicious activity, and emerging risks, leveraging OSINT, social media, public records, and commercial intelligence platforms to develop investigative leads, conduct due diligence and attribution research, and produce actionable intelligence.
  • Produce and quality-assure timely intelligence products, investigative reports, alerts, and briefings, ensuring analytical accuracy, relevance, and consistency across team deliverables.
  • Triage and respond to requests for intelligence and investigative support, set team priorities, coordinate workloads, and delegate tasks to ensure timely delivery against client requirements.
  • Provide day-to-day leadership, direction, coaching, and mentorship to Threat Intelligence Analysts, supporting professional development and maintaining high analytical standards across the team.
  • Engage proactively with stakeholders across corporate security, physical security, investigations, and business operations to understand and refine intelligence requirements, translate requirements into team priorities, and enhance threat identification, risk mitigation, and security outcomes.
  • Support critical incident response efforts through rapid research, analysis, and dissemination of relevant information, providing direction to the team and serving as an escalation point for complex or time-sensitive matters.
  • Maintain intelligence records, analytical databases, and case management systems, and support the development and consistent application of team SOPs, investigative workflows, and analytical standards.
  • Identify opportunities to continuously improve the intelligence function, including processes, analytical methodologies, tools, AI capabilities, and emerging technologies that enhance team effectiveness and intelligence delivery.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Experience supporting security, intelligence, investigations, trust and safety, or risk management programs within technology companies, government agencies, or private-sector intelligence organizations.
  • Strong understanding of threat intelligence, investigative methodologies, threat actor research, intelligence collection and analysis practices, and online investigative techniques.
  • Strong proficiency in OSINT collection, social media analysis, public records research, and commercial investigative and intelligence platforms such as LexisNexis, Dataminr, Flashpoint, or similar technologies.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and editorial skills, with the ability to assess risk, manage ambiguity, produce actionable intelligence, and quality-assure analytical products for accuracy, relevance, sourcing, rigor, and clarity.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop intelligence professionals while fostering collaboration, accountability, and consistently high analytical standards.
  • Ability to prioritize and coordinate multiple intelligence requirements across a team, manage competing demands, and exercise sound judgment in dynamic or time-sensitive situations.
  • Strong written, verbal, and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate findings, understand client requirements, and translate those requirements into actionable intelligence priorities.
  • Experience utilizing AI and emerging technologies to enhance research, information analysis, investigative workflows, and operational efficiency, with an ability to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and a commitment to objectivity, professional ethics, analytical rigor, and continuous learning.
  • Ability to transform complex information into actionable intelligence that enables decision-makers to mitigate risk, enhance security operations, and support informed security and business decisions.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Security Studies, International Relations, Criminal Justice, Political Science, Intelligence Studies, Business Management, Journalism, or a related discipline; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in threat intelligence, intelligence analysis, investigations, OSINT, corporate security, trust and safety, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting investigative research, intelligence collection, threat analysis, and research into threat actors, online communities, or emerging security threats.
  • Proven ability to produce and review high-quality analytical reports, investigative findings, and intelligence products.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, or providing substantive analytical oversight to intelligence, investigative, or security professionals.
  • Experience managing stakeholder requirements and translating them into clear analytical, investigative, or operational priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in dynamic, time-sensitive environments while coordinating multiple priorities and exercising sound professional judgment.

Interview Process

  • Initial call with our Talent Acquisition team member
  • Timed written assessment (arranged at a time that suits you) to test writing and analytical capability
  • Panel interview with some of the team members and hiring managers at Sibylline
  • Meet and Greet with the client

Research indicates that certain groups are less likely to apply for a position unless they meet every single requirement. If you meet some of the requirements and can offer a unique perspective for this role, we strongly encourage you to apply—you might be the perfect fit we're looking for!

Sibylline is committed to the recruitment and selection of candidates without regard for sexual orientation, gender, ethnicity, age, political beliefs, culture, and lifestyle. We are committed to fostering a business culture that reflects these values and promotes equal opportunity.

Sibylline is a leading intelligence and strategic risk consultancy in the security sector. Since 2010, we have supported businesses, governments, and NGOs by providing high-quality risk analysis, due diligence, and consultancy services.

The firm provides an innovative, entrepreneurial, and fast-growing working environment, offering employees ever greater exposure to high-profile clients and challenges. Sibylline offers fantastic opportunities for career progression within a successful company, and we aim to help our employees build their own personal profiles as well-regarded analysts within the broader industry.

Key attributes of Sibylline employees are:

  • Self-motivated, and auto-improving individuals who can couple initiative and boldness with good judgment
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Clarity of thought and analytical flair
  • Strong, demonstrable interest in security and intelligence
  • The ability to work under pressure, demonstrate leadership when required, but also be able to collaborate effectively in teams
  • Excellent attention to detail
