About RSAC

RSAC is the premier series of global events and year‑round learning for the cybersecurity community. RSAC is where the security industry converges to discuss current and future concerns and gain access to experts, unbiased content, and ideas that help individuals and companies advance their cybersecurity posture and build stronger, smarter teams.

Both in‑person and online, RSAC brings the cybersecurity industry together and empowers the collective “we” to stand against cyberthreats around the world. RSAC is the ultimate marketplace for the latest technologies and hands‑on educational opportunities, helping industry professionals discover how to make their organisations more secure while showcasing the most enterprising, influential, and thought‑provoking thinkers and leaders in cybersecurity today.

We are now building a year-round membership platform where security practitioners and leaders gain knowledge, earn CPE credits, upskill through hands-on learning, and network with peers and experts.

This role leads the team building that platform. You will grow the product into a daily destination, add AI-native and agentic experiences, define the next generation of our mobile app, and support consumer and enterprise (team) memberships. Our users defend organizations for a living, so the bar for security, reliability and quality is exceptionally high.

What You’ll Do

Lead and grow the engineering organization

  • Lead front-end, back-end, full-stack and iOS engineers, our DevOps / SRE function, and the Quality Engineering team.

  • Hire, coach and develop engineers and engineering managers. Build a culture that values both delivery speed and quality.

  • Set clear goals, career paths and performance expectations, and give regular, candid feedback.

  • Partner with Product, Design, Content and Marketing as an equal member of the product leadership team.

Own delivery and engineering excellence

  • Run agile delivery practices that make commitments predictable and keep the team shipping frequently in small increments.

  • Establish engineering standards for code quality, architecture review, documentation and incident management.

  • Track and improve delivery metrics such as deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate and time to recovery.

Build secure, scalable platforms

  • Set the technical direction for our TypeScript / React web app, APIs and services on Azure, including Cosmos DB data design and performance.

  • Build security into the full lifecycle: secure design, threat modeling, identity and access, secrets management, dependency and supply-chain security, and vulnerability response.

  • Lead cloud engineering, infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation so every change ships safely and automatically.

  • Own reliability, observability and cost efficiency, with clear service-level objectives (SLOs).

Deliver AI-native and agentic experiences

  • Build AI-native features (for example, our AI assistant, content summaries, mind maps and personalized learning) and agentic workflows that act on members' behalf.

  • Set standards for safe and secure AI: evaluation, guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, data privacy, and cost and latency management.

Define the next-generation mobile experience

  • Shape and deliver the vision for RSAC's mobile app, including the switch from conference mode to year-round membership.

  • Lead native iOS development and drive a mobile strategy that balances speed, consistency across platforms and user experience.

Champion quality

  • Lead Quality Engineering, with test automation across web and mobile, quality built into CI/CD, and a shift-left testing culture.

  • Define release-readiness criteria and quality metrics and use them to make release decisions.

Support consumer and B2B growth

  • Build for individual members and for enterprise team memberships: account hierarchies, admin controls, SSO, entitlements and subscription billing.

What success looks like in your first year

  1. First 90 days: assess the team, architecture, security posture and delivery process. Agree on engineering goals and a 12-month technical roadmap with the CPO.

  1. By 6 months: predictable delivery with measured improvements in release frequency and quality. Automated test coverage and CI/CD in place across web and mobile.

  1. By 12 months: a secure, scalable platform supporting weekly member engagement, the first AI-native and agentic features in production, a next-generation mobile app launched, and the foundations for enterprise team memberships. An engineering culture known for both speed and quality.

Application Requirements

  • 10+ years managing software engineering teams, including leading managers and multi-discipline teams across web, mobile, back end, DevOps and QA.

  • Experience building web applications for professionals, in both direct-to-consumer and B2B settings, including subscriptions, entitlements and enterprise features such as SSO and team administration.

  • Hands-on technical depth in TypeScript / JavaScript and React, API and service design, and NoSQL data modeling (Azure Cosmos DB or similar).

  • Cloud engineering experience on Azure (or AWS / GCP with a clear path to Azure), including infrastructure as code, containers and serverless.

  • Proven DevOps and CI/CD practice: automated build, test and deploy pipelines, environment strategy, observability and incident response.

  • Security-first engineering: a track record of building security into apps and the tech stack, such as OWASP-aligned secure coding, threat modeling, identity and authentication (OAuth / OIDC), secrets management, software supply-chain security and secure SDLC practices.

  • Practical experience with AI-native applications: LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation, and an understanding of agentic architectures, including tool use, orchestration and their security risks.

  • Mobile app development leadership, ideally native iOS, with the product judgment to define a next-generation mobile experience.

  • Quality Engineering leadership: test strategy and automation for web and mobile, built into CI/CD.

  • Deep fluency in agile development and a record of predictable, high-quality delivery.

  • A coach and culture builder who has grown engineers and managers and built teams known for both speed and quality.

  • Clear communicator who can explain technical trade-offs to executives and non-technical partners.

Nice to have

  • Background in community, content or membership products (video, events, discussions, personalization).

  • Experience with online learning platforms or learning management systems (LMS): courses, labs, cohorts, progress tracking or certification and CPE credit workflows.

  • Experience building for a cybersecurity audience, or at a security product company.

  • Experience with Azure identity services (e.g., Azure AD B2C / Entra External ID) and password less authentication.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Location & Eligibility

Please be aware that although this is a remote position, to be considered for the vacancy you must have residency in one of the following states:

California, Colorado, Florida, Kansas, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington

Benefits

RSAC believes in investing in our people. We offer:

  • Salary range: $250,000 – $280,000

  • Employer‑subsidised medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401K retirement employer match

  • Home office equipment stipend and monthly technology stipend

  • Thirteen paid holidays per calendar year

  • Flexible personal time off

  • Annual employee bonus dependent on company and personal performance

  • Annual company‑wide offsite

Our Culture

We believe that our differences make us stronger, and we are committed to fostering a culture of respect, empathy, and understanding.

  • We are a fully remote team operating across the United States, giving our employees the flexibility to work from wherever they choose.

  • Our team is passionate and results‑oriented, striving to achieve excellence in everything we do.

  • We strongly believe in creating an inclusive environment that values diversity and encourages our team members to share their unique perspectives.

  • We recognise that by collaborating and working together, we can achieve our goals faster and more effectively.

Why RSAC?

The RSAC team takes great pride in helping shape the future of cybersecurity and being part of an expansive global community. We’re always looking for imaginative and visionary individuals who share our passion for providing cutting‑edge programs that equip cybersecurity practitioners worldwide with the intel and knowledge they need to thrive and safeguard organisations against cyberthreats.

Our Values

  • Adaptability: In our ever‑changing world, we innovate through determination, creativity, and resourcefulness.

  • Community: We bring people together and build trust by embracing the unique thoughts and perspectives of others with kindness and respect.

  • Excellence: Because we are where the world talks security, we have the highest expectations of ourselves and our partners.

Equal Opportunity Statement

raw.title: AI Transformation Architect [IC4]
raw.excerpt: Who we are Our mission is to bring clarity and control to the world's most complex codebases.
raw.description:
Who we are

Our mission is to bring clarity and control to the world's most complex codebases. AI is accelerating code creation, but the infrastructure to understand, oversee, and evolve that code hasn't kept pace. Sourcegraph gives engineering organizations full visibility across their systems, precise context for their agents, and the ability to execute coordinated code changes at scale. As agentic development becomes the dominant engineering paradigm, we provide the context layer teams need to take control of their codebase.

With Code Search, Deep Search, MCP, and Agentic Batch Changes, we deliver on that mission today - giving engineering teams and their AI tools the cross-repo context to navigate massive codebases with confidence, and the ability to make changes across hundreds of repositories at once.

Companies like Stripe, Reddit, and Leidos rely on Sourcegraph to ship faster and with higher quality. We're backed by a16z, Sequoia, and Redpoint, and proud to operate as a globally distributed team that values high agency, direct communication, and customer love.

If you want to build the infrastructure that lets every engineering team - and every agent they deploy - operate on their codebase with confidence, join us.

Working hours

🌎 While we are an all-remote company and hire almost anywhere in the world, we do require successful candidates to be located in the United States.

Preferred location:

  • USA

Why this job is exciting

Every engineering organization has bought coding agents. Yet very few can confidently tell you that they’re making the impact they thought they would. They are falling short, not because the model isn’t good enough, but because the codebase is too complex and, outside of a few thousand people employed by OpenAI and Anthropic, nobody understands what good context looks like. Agents can’t access all the code they need, they burn tokens hunting for the right code, and fill the gaps by guessing. Organizations build internal harnesses and knowledge bases using techniques that are outdated before the product is even in use. You’ll be the person to show customers how to actually fix these problems.

Sourcegraph gives the largest, most sophisticated engineering organizations in the world full codebase context so their teams and their agents can understand, oversee, and change their codebase with confidence. As agent adoption grows, and agents write more code, having the right context matters more and more.

Being a brand new role, you’ll be building from scratch. You’ll define what the AI maturity curve looks like inside of enterprise organizations, turn that into a framework customers can use to assess themselves against, and lead engagements with customers where you’ll directly dig into their environment, build an action plan, and work with them to action it. Then you’ll measure again and show what changed and the results they’ve achieved.

You’ll spend your time in customer environments, in the room with VPs of Engineering and staff engineers, and in the product. You’ll also shape the broader market’s view on what good context looks like for agents, which is a question the whole industry is still figuring out. Your results will show up in how customers use the Sourcegraph platform and in the ways they are able to actually make agents work in enterprise codebases.

📅 Within one month, you will…

  • Build relationships across Sales, Field Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product
  • Learn our products, our value prop, and how our largest customers use Sourcegraph
  • Shadow customer calls and interview customers about where their agents succeed and fail today
  • Review our existing benchmark studies and draft a first point of view on the dimensions of context that matter most

📅 Within one quarter, you will…

  • Publish Sourcegraph’s first perspective on context maturity, grounded in what you’ve learned from customer conversations and our own data
  • Ship v1 of the maturity framework: the categories, the criteria that define each stage, and how evidence maps to a score
  • Partner with Marketing to launch a self-serve version
  • Equip Solutions Engineers to run a lightweight version of the assessment inside of trials
  • Run your first assessment with 1-2 select customers, and refine the framework based on what you find

📅 Within six months, you will…

  • Be a recognized voice on context and agent readiness, with a steady cadence of writing, talks, or research that engineering leaders reference
  • Publish findings from real assessments: what you’re seeing across enterprise codebases, where agents break, and what moves the needle
  • Own a repeatable paid engagement with a defined scope, deliverables, and readout
  • Deliver action plans that customers execute with you — activating workflows, integrations, and agentic use cases in their own environment
  • Re-measure your first customers and show movement up the curve
  • Feed what you learn back to EPD as a standing input on agent effectiveness in the enterprise

About you

You’re a consultant at heart, with technical chops and credibility. You can walk into a complex engineering organization, find what’s broken, and leave with a plan people act on. You’re equally comfortable telling a VP of Engineering their environment isn’t where they think it is as you are debating a staff engineer on why.

You build things that didn’t exist before: frameworks, practices, points of view. You can turn insight into action and you’re energized by a blank page as a starting point.

Finally, you’re in the middle of the AI shift yourself. You have deep experience and strong opinions on where agents work and where they don’t, and you share them publicly. You stay on top of AI development, use new models and harnesses as they’re released, and have a perspective on how every generation of these products changes the story.

Your skill-set:

  • 7+ years experience advising enterprise technology or engineering organizations
  • Systems or solutions architecture experience in large-scale software, the developer ecosystem, or SDLC environments
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and a point of view on how enterprises are adopting them
  • Experience creating structured, repeatable approaches to diagnosing problems, such as frameworks, assessments, playbooks, or methodologies others can use
  • Experience turning technical findings into an executive-ready business roadmap, then working hands-on with customers to deliver it

Nice to Have

  • You’ve run your own consulting practice or built a consultative services offering from scratch
  • Background in developer tooling, platform engineering, developer experience, or DevOps
  • A public voice - writing or speaking - you have a body of work people reference
  • Experience with consumption or usage-based products

Level

📊 This job is an IC4. You can read more about our job leveling philosophy in our Handbook.

Compensation

💸 We pay you an above-average salary because we want to hire the best people who are fully focused on helping Sourcegraph succeed, not worried about paying bills. As an open and transparent company that values competitive compensation, our compensation ranges are visible to every single Sourcegraph teammate.

Your salary is determined by your pay band for the IC4 job level. For determining pay bands, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources, along with your location zone, and target the high-end of the range to ensure we’re always paying above market regardless of where you live in the world. Both U.S. and international locations are divided into one of four zones, determined by the cost of labor index for each area. The salary for a successful candidate will be based on level, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and location zone. Please note that the salaries below may be adjusted in the future.

💰 The salary for this role is $200,000 USD.

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer equity (because when we succeed as a company, we want you to succeed, too) and generous perks & benefits.

Interview process

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role (you can read more about the types of interviews in our Handbook). It may look like a lot of steps, but rest assured that we move quickly and the steps are designed to help you get the information needed to determine if we’re the right fit for you… Interviewing is a two-way street, after all!

We expect the interview process to take about 4.25 hours in total.

👋 Introduction Stage - we have initial conversations to get to know you better…

  • Recruiter screen (30 min)
  • Hiring manager interview with Hiring Manager (45 min)

🧑‍💻 Team Interview Stage - we then delve into your experience in more depth and introduce you to members of the team, including cross-functional partners…

  • Technical deep dive with Field Engineering (45 min)
  • Conversation with Marketing (30 min)

🎉 Final Interview Stage - we move you to our final round, where you gain a better understanding of our business and values holistically…

  • Working session with Aimee, Sales, Customer success (45 min)
  • Values Interview (30 min)
  • CEO interview (30 min)

Please note - you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet, but didn’t get to meet during the interview process.

Learn more about us

You can learn more about what it is like to work at Sourcegraph by reading our handbook.

We are an ambitious team who are collectively working hard to build the most influential company in the world. You can read more about our culture, competitive compensation and benefits here.

Sourcegraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

Sourcegraph participates in E-Verify for U.S. Employees.

The AI interview is one part of our overall evaluation process, which also includes human review.

INTERESTED?

About Lyra

Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.
Lyra Health is looking for a seasoned Benefits professional to join our Global Benefits & Well-being team.
In this role, you will lead day-to-day functional support and provide assistance to the Director, Global Benefits and Well-being with benefit escalations, renewals and change management of benefit programs across EMEA, APAC, and LATAM.
This is an intermediate-level position that acts under general supervision and direction but requires significant autonomy and independent judgement. You will serve as a vital cross-functional partner, ensuring that our global benefits strategy is designed and executed with precision and compliance without sacrificing employee experience.
This is a fully remote role working from the UK or ROI, Monday to Friday.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide guidance and consistency while respecting local requirements; serve as a trusted benefits subject‑matter expert and escalation resource for complex or non‑standard issues.

  • Partner cross-functionally with various teams within the global People Team and across other departments at Lyra (Legal, Finance, etc.) to support the design, delivery and communication of effective benefits programs.

  • Record and monitor cost and utilization trends using market benchmarks and engagement data, applying analysis to identify risks and improvement opportunities.

  • Drive special projects, such as supporting wellness initiatives, upgrading HRIS benefit modules, or supporting benefits set up for new country market entries.

  • Support regulatory compliance by ensuring statutory filings are executed timely and that local labor law changes in international regions are surfaced to mitigate risk.

  • Optimize global workflows between Benefits, Payroll, and HRIS systems to increase efficiency, reduce manual data entry, and improve the accuracy of reporting to government agencies.

  • Support the annual insurance renewal cycle in collaboration with the Global Benefits Director, providing critical data analysis, benchmarking, and plan design comparisons.

  • Assist in resolving complex benefit escalations as the primary point of contact for HR Business Partners and Employee Relations, providing expert guidance and empathetic support for employees.

  • Ensure seamless administration and reporting of benefit funding, tax compliance, and data integrity across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Lead day-to-day functional support for international employee benefit programs across EMEA, APAC, and LATAM, ensuring operational excellence and cultural relevance throughout the employee lifecycle.

Experience Required: 10+ years

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a Cloud Systems Engineer to build, secure, automate, and operate cloud or enterprise infrastructure and platforms. The work focuses on availability, scalability, security, observability, automation, and dependable service operations. The successful candidate will apply practical expertise in the primary programming language and framework, APIs, SQL, testing, Git, and CI/CD, work with cross-functional teams, and contribute to reliable, maintainable solutions through the delivery lifecycle.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst to join the team and contribute to a key project within the Fixed Income markets.

In this role, you will work closely with Front Office stakeholders, particularly traders, as well as technical teams, to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions that meet business needs. You will be responsible for gathering, analysing, documenting and communicating business requirements, ensuring alignment between business stakeholders and software development teams.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Interest Rate Swaps (IRS), electronic pre-trade and post-trade flows, and Fixed Income markets, together with proven experience as a Business Analyst within Front Office development teams, ideally in a trading floor environment.

You will collaborate with teams across LATAM (Mexico, Brazil and Chile) and the UK, playing a key role in ensuring effective communication and successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with Front Office business users, particularly traders, to understand, gather and analyse business requirements.

  • Translate business needs into clear and structured functional requirements, user stories and use cases.

  • Collaborate with project teams to ensure business requirements are properly reflected in project planning, priorities and roadmaps.

  • Work closely with software development teams to communicate requirements, clarify business needs and ensure solutions are delivered as expected.

  • Facilitate communication between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring a shared understanding of project objectives and deliverables.

  • Apply industry best practices for requirements gathering, documentation and business analysis.

  • Establish and maintain Business Analysis governance processes.

  • Provide backup support as a local Subject Matter Expert (SME) to the existing Level 1 Trading Floor Support teams.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst within Financial Markets, preferably in Fixed Income.

  • At least 5 years of experience and expert-level product knowledge of Interest Rate Swaps (IRS).

  • Strong understanding of electronic pre-trade and post-trade workflows.

  • Solid knowledge of Fixed Income trading concepts and terminology, including:

    • Interest Rate Swaps (IRS).

    • Request for Quote (RFQ).

    • Bid/Ask pricing.

    • Client Tiering.

    • Trading Venues.

    • Swap valuation and pricing mechanisms.

  • Proven experience working as a hands-on Business Analyst within Front Office development teams, ideally in a trading floor environment.

  • Experience working in Agile environments, with strong expertise in writing user stories, use cases and functional specifications.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with Front Office traders and technical teams.

  • English level: C1 or above.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience as a Business Analyst in Fixed Income projects.

  • Experience working with Middle Office and Back Office stakeholders.

  • Experience supporting trading floor environments and interacting with Level 1 support teams.

What do we offer you?

  • B2B contract
  • 100% Remote
  • Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

If you have read this far and you are looking forward to joining this challenge, do not hesitate to apply... we would be delighted to meet you!

Job Description

Role Title: Project Manager

Department / Seat Name: PMO

Job Type: W2; Full-Time; Remote

Role Summary

The Project Manager (PM) plays a critical role in ensuring successful delivery of RSI Security’s cybersecurity and compliance engagements. The PM will lead the coordination, execution, and tracking of multiple client projects from kickoff through final deliverables, ensuring alignment across internal teams and client stakeholders. This role bridges Sales, Technical Operations, and the Client Experience team to drive execution and reinforce client trust throughout the engagement lifecycle.

Role Purpose

The Project Manager at RSI Security is responsible for orchestrating the seamless execution of client-facing cybersecurity and compliance engagements. This role exists to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the highest standards of quality, while fostering trust and transparency with clients and internal teams. By aligning cross-functional efforts and driving operational discipline, the Project Manager plays a vital role in preserving client satisfaction, optimizing resource utilization, and reinforcing RSI Security’s reputation for excellence.

Core Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution

  • Own end-to-end project delivery: scope, timeline, resource coordination, and risk mitigation
  • Facilitate project kickoffs, weekly status calls, and closeout activities
  • Monitor project performance using KPIs and internal dashboards
  • Ensure documentation, deliverables, and milestones are completed on time and to quality standards

Client Experience & Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during project execution
    Provide clear and proactive communication to manage expectations and enhance satisfaction
  • Identify upsell or cross-sell opportunities based on observed client needs

Internal Collaboration

  • Coordinate with assessors, consultants, and technical SMEs to ensure aligned project delivery
  • Work closely with the Sales and CX teams on pre-engagement planning and post-project review
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives and knowledge sharing

Compliance & Operational Rigor

raw.description:
About SANS

Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.

At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community.

Why SANS?

At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People.

  • Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats.
  • Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training.
  • Our People are grounded in a culture of fairness, honesty, customer focus, and a pragmatic approach.

What You’ll Achieve at SANS

We are seeking a Director of Software Engineering to join our Product Development team. This role plays a key part in providing senior technical and organizational leadership for SANS’ Cloud Platform Engineering organization — spanning platform core services (identity, product administration, and entitlements), DevOps tools and services, website engineering, and courseware & platform orchestration — while serving as the engineering executive for Project CORE, SANS’ enrollment and entitlement modernization program. This role leads individual contributors and engineering teams through their managers and leads; owns shared engineering platforms, standards, tooling, and vendor relationships; and drives the architecture, delivery, and cross-functional coordination required to modernize SANS’ enrollment, entitlement, and administrative systems. The Director partners closely with Product, Operations, Sales, Finance, and fellow engineering directors to translate business strategy into secure, scalable, and maintainable systems.

As a Director of Software Engineering, you will:

  • Lead, manage, and mentor individual contributors and engineering teams through managers and leads.
  • Own engineering standards and best practices — CI/CD, code quality, secure development — and facilitate architecture governance across teams.
  • Plan and balance engineering capacity against shifting business priorities, communicating trade-offs to stakeholders.
  • Lead strategic modernization programs end to end: architecture, cross-team commitments, delivery planning, and executive reporting.
  • Direct modernization of core product platforms — enrollment, entitlement, identity, and product services — including integration with enterprise systems and retirement of legacy tooling.
  • Measure engineering effectiveness and drive continuous improvement across teams.
  • Champion incident management discipline and publish regular engineering communications to stakeholders.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

Every SANS employee brings something unique. For this role, we’re looking for candidates with:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent industry experience.
  • At least 10 years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and 3+ years managing through engineering managers or leads.
  • Demonstrated success leading a large, multi-team modernization or systems-integration program from design through delivery.
  • Strong technical acumen with prior hands-on development experience and the ability to guide architectural decisions across services, integrations, and data flows.
  • Experience with modern AI development techniques and best practices.
  • Experience with enterprise business systems and integrations (e.g., Salesforce/Service Cloud, identity providers, payment/order management).
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and DevOps practices, including AWS, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure as code.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, software procurement, licensing, and budgets.
  • Experience with Agile, SDLC, and modern development standards and best practices.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level reporting and cross-functional coordination.
  • Unrestricted authorization to work in the USA; visa sponsorship is not available.

Preferred qualifications include:

  • Experience in education technology, training delivery platforms, or certification systems.
  • Experience facilitating architecture governance (architecture councils, RFC processes, engineering standards).
  • Familiarity with identity and access management platforms (PingIdentity, Entra ID) and entitlement modeling.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted development tooling and governing its safe, cost-effective adoption.
  • Interest in a security-first mindset and secure coding practices.
  • Ability and passion for developing both individuals and teams.

Benefits and Perks of Working at SANS

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation. The expected salary range for this position is $200,000 to $240,000 OTE (comprised of base salary and bonus), depending on geographic location, skills, and experience. At SANS, pay equity and transparency are priorities.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your total well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Financial Benefits: Competitive base salary, bonus opportunities, and a 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision plans; company-provided short term disability; optional long-term disability, supplemental life and AD&D insurance for employees and dependents; voluntary benefits including accident insurance and identity theft protection; fitness and wellness programs; and a company paid employee assistance program (EAP).
  • Time Off & Flexibility: Generous paid time off, including volunteer time.
  • Learning & Development: Access to professional development and SANS training opportunities.

Flexibility and Balance at SANS

We support our colleagues with the tools and flexibility they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. As a primarily remote work environment, we are committed to maintaining strong connections, collaboration, and a vibrant culture across virtual teams. While most roles operate remotely, some positions may require occasional in-person presence depending on role-specific or business needs.

SANS is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

SANS is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact SANS Human Resources.

SANS complies with all applicable state and local laws regarding the consideration of applicants with arrest or conviction records. For positions governed by federal and/or state banking regulations, SANS will adhere to relevant requirements when evaluating candidates with criminal histories.

Employment eligibility in the United States is required. SANS does not provide visa sponsorship for this position.

Salary: $200,000 - $240,000

Designing and building modern, scalable solutions from scratch - replacing outdated systems with new platforms built using best engineering practices.

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for an experienced Lead Technical Instructor to enable our customers on the combined Fivetran + dbt product suite. We are looking for someone with a passion for teaching and working with data to join our training team to setup Enterprise customers and partners for success with dbt to empower data developers to create and disseminate organizational knowledge.

This is a full-time remote position, with preference for someone in east coast time zones.

Technologies You’ll Use

Fivetran, dbt, Thought Industries, VEED

What You’ll Do

  • Advanced training delivery (25%)
    • Develop and deliver customized training programs for specific + technical client needs, including enterprise-level solutions and industry-specific applications through the private academy.
    • Create engaging, interactive learning experiences that encourage participation and foster a deeper understanding of advanced dbt Cloud functionalities.
  • Mentor and guide other instructors (25%)
    • Conduct regular feedback sessions with other instructors, both internal and subcontracting partners.
    • Share best practices and insights from personal experiences.
  • Oversee the continuous improvement of existing curriculum (25%)
    • Review and approve curriculum updates proposed by the team.
    • Organize periodic curriculum review sessions with the team.
  • Collaborate with product teams to align training with product releases (25%)
    • Facilitate joint sessions between the product and education teams.
    • Ensure the training calendar aligns with product release dates.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • You have 8+ years of experience teaching with some data analytics experience OR 8+ years of data analytics experience with some teaching
  • You have experience writing SQL in an analytics context
  • You love teaching and creating those lightbulb moments for learners
  • You create learning environments with high levels of engagement
  • You are laser-focused on learner and customer outcomes while adjusting instruction on the fly - our customers are coming to use our product from varied tooling and skillsets
  • You believe teaching is a craft that we can always get better at and actively seek out feedback
  • You communicate clearly and concisely with internal and external stakeholders
  • You thrive in an environment of cross-collaboration that moves quickly

Bonus Skills​

  • You have worked on customer education/training teams and know how training can drive outcomes for customers.
  • You have experience using dbt and/or teaching dbt - Fivetran.
  • You have experience writing analytics code (i.e., Python, R, etc.) in addition to SQL and working with databases
  • You have experience designing curricula with a focus on backwards design.

The Opportunity


As a Senior/Lead Incident Response Engineer at FICO, you will lead our defensive security operations with a strong focus on people, preparedness, and cross-team readiness. You will own how FICO detects, contains, and recovers from security incidents, and build the organizational readiness that makes that possible. You will be responsible for designing and running tabletop exercises that bring stakeholders from across the business together and keep them engaged from planning through execution. If you love building trust across teams and shaping how FICO prepares for security incidents, this role is for you.


What You’ll Contribute


  • Design and facilitate incident response tabletop exercises across security, IT, engineering, legal, and business teams, testing preparedness and surfacing gaps.
  • Own the full incident lifecycle: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
  • Build and maintain IR plans, playbooks, and runbooks for consistent, repeatable response.
  • Partner with threat intelligence, SOC, and engineering to turn IR and exercise findings into stronger detection and controls.
  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, during incidents and in reporting.
  • Support digital forensics investigations, apply the PICERL and NIST frameworks, and lead IR activities in cloud environments using SIEM, CSPM, and other cloud security tooling.
  • Bring an IR perspective to FICO’s cloud and AI security programs and use AI and automation in IR and tabletop exercise workflows.

raw.title: Director, Product Management (Debt Optimizer)
raw.excerpt: As Director of Product Management for Achieve Debt Optimizer*, you will own the company's next-generation consumer debt product end to end.
raw.description:
As Director of Product Management for Achieve Debt Optimizer*, you will own the company's next-generation consumer debt product end to end. Achieve Debt Optimizer*evaluates a consumer's whole debt picture and matches them to the right solution across Achieve and partner products, loan and non-loan alike. It is not a budgeting app and not a single-product lender.

This is a core product leadership role with two amplified mandates: building the partner ecosystem that powers the marketplace and taking the product to market. You will turn a validated zero-to-one concept into a scaled, monetized platform heading into 2027. Achieve Debt Optimizer* is a strategic initiative anchoring the company's long-term growth objective. It runs a decoupled front end and back end, and its roadmap evolves on transitioning from single product solutions into multi product bundles that include multiyear debt plans that transform consumers’ future and shape the way they think about debt. Many concepts are backed by user research that clearly point out that users are highly interested in comprehensive solutions.

What you'll own

1. Product strategy and execution

  • Lead the product from validated prototype to scaled platform: define requirements, sequence releases and make clear trade-offs across scope, speed and risk.
  • Define the decisioning experience: whole-portfolio debt evaluation, Fit Score and account-level ratings, Smart Move recommendations, bundling logic and liability drag.
  • Partner with design and research to run rapid concept tests and turn findings into product decisions.
  • Shape AI-enabled and agentic experiences, including the conversational navigator, so they lift conversion and consumer trust.

2. Partner integration and ecosystem

  • Build the partner strategy for loan and non-loan solutions and partnerships: partner with BD to identify, prioritize and onboard partners across refinance, auto and student lending, balance transfer, credit counseling and other external solutions.
  • Own the partner API and integration product: pre-qualification and pricing exchange, eligibility, offer return, attribution and reporting.
  • Define partner onboarding, certification and performance standards; manage the integration pipeline with Partner B2B and Engineering.
  • Design marketplace economics with Finance and Partnerships: revenue share, lead and funded-loan monetization, and partner-level reporting.
  • Evolve the platform toward partner and B2B packaging, including platform-as-a-service use cases.
  • Ensure every partner offer meets compliance, fair-lending and data-sharing requirements, in partnership with Legal and Compliance.

3. Go-to-market

  • Partner with Marketing on GTM for each release: positioning, target segments, pricing and packaging, launch plans and success criteria.
  • Partner with Marketing, Channel and MarTech to plan acquisition across paid, owned, partner and direct channels, and to optimize channel mix.
  • Integrate Debt Navigator into the unified prequalification platform across business units so it becomes a front door to the Achieve portfolio.
  • Build the measurement framework: funnel conversion, engagement and return visits, partner yield, revenue per user and unit economics.

4. Agentic strategy

  • Define product content and functionality so the product can be properly represented and show up in LLMs and agents
  • Develop the decision methodology on how the product, bundle and logic are exposed in a form agents can explain and trust.
  • Define MCP and API interfaces so agents use to query and act on the product.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in product management, with hands-on experience.
  • A track record of taking a zero-to-one consumer product to scale and owning its P&L or revenue outcomes.
  • Experience building marketplace or platform products with third-party partners: partner APIs, integrations, offer exchange and partner economics.
  • Hands-on go-to-market leadership: positioning, pricing and packaging, launch, and channel strategy with Marketing and Sales.
  • Consumer-facing experience and strong understanding in experimentation.
  • Strong analytical skills: funnel and unit-economics fluency, experiment design and data-driven prioritization.
  • Executive presence and the ability to align senior leaders, partners and cross-functional teams around a clear direction.

Preferred

  • Experience with lending marketplaces, loan-matching or offer-aggregation platforms.
  • Experience shipping AI-enabled or conversational products in a regulated setting.
  • Familiarity with credit data, tradelines, credit decisioning or credit prediction models.
  • Experience with B2B or platform-as-a-service packaging of a consumer product.

Who you'll work with

You'll work directly with senior executives to shape and pressure-test product direction. You'll also work cross functionally with Design, Research, Engineering, Marketing, BD and Legal & Compliance.

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for a leader who is hands-on that thrives in ambiguity, moves fast and wants to define a new category in consumer debt.

The Impact You'll Make

Your work will directly reshape how millions of people find financial freedom and think about debt. You'll define the experience that power the company's core growth engine. You'll measure success by how many people you empower to take control of their financial future—and by how much you help Achieve grow sustainably and responsibly.

Achieve well-being with:

  • Hybrid and remote work opportunities
  • 401 (k) with employer match
  • Medical, dental, and vision with HSA and FSA options
  • Competitive vacation and sick time off, as well as dedicated volunteer days
  • Access to wellness support through Employee Assistance Program, Talkspace, and fitness discounts
  • Up to $5,250 paid back to you on eligible education expenses
  • Pet care discounts for your furry family members
  • Financial support in times of hardship with our Achieve Care Fund
  • A safe place to connect and a commitment to diversity and inclusion through our six employee resource groups

Note: We will be unable to facilitate H1-B Visa transfer or sponsorship, along with STEM-OPT Visa.

Work from home/hybrid:

We are proudly offering hybrid options in the San Francisco, CA and Phoenix, AZ metro markets. Hiring remotely in selected locations throughout PST, MST, CST.

Salary Range: $210,000 to $240,000 salary + bonus + benefits.

This information represents the expected salary range for this role. Should we decide to make an offer for employment, we'll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.

Join Achieve, change the future.

At Achieve, we’re changing millions of lives.
From the single parent trying to catch up on bills to the entrepreneur needing a loan for the next phase of growth, you’ll get to be a part of their journey to a better financial future. We’re proud to have over 3,000 employees in mostly hybrid and 100% remote roles across the United States with hubs in Arizona, California, and Texas. We are strategically growing our teams with more remote, work-from-home opportunities every day to better serve our members. A career at Achieve is more than a job—it’s a place where you can make a true impact, have a sense of belonging, establish a fulfilling career, and put your well-being first.

Attention Agencies & Search Firms: We do not accept unsolicited candidate resumes or profiles. Please do not reach out to anyone within Achieve to market your services or candidates. All inquiries should be directed to Talent Acquisition only. We reserve the right to hire any candidates sent unsolicited and will not pay any fees without a contract signed by Achieve’s Talent Acquisition leader.

Achieve is a leading digital personal finance company. We help everyday people move from struggling to thriving by providing innovative, personalized financial solutions. By leveraging proprietary dataand analytics, our solutions are tailored for each step of our member's financial journey to include debt consolidation, personal loans, home equity loans, financial tools and education. Every day, we get to help our members move their finances forward with care, compassion, and empathetic touch. We put people first and treat them like humans, not account numbers.

raw.description:
Important: this position will work on the Weekend Shift team, with the following rotation schedules:

  1. Tuesday-to-Saturday (including Tue, Wed, Thur, Fri, and Sat), 9AM-to-5PM.
  2. Sunday-to-Thursday (including Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed, and Thur), 9AM-to-5PM.

This position will rotate through the above work schedules quarterly, i.e., work in one rotation schedule for 3 calendar months, and then move to the other rotation schedule for another 3 calendar months.

This is an exciting opportunity in our Data Science Production Engineering (DSPE) department at Natera (a global leader in precision medicine and genomics testing), to provide critical data analytics support for our lab production operations. As a Senior Data Analyst for Lab Production Support in our DSPE Extended-Hours Support (ExHS) team, you will work in the Weekend Shift team (following the above two rotation schedules). You will have the opportunity to apply innovative data analytics solutions, directly support the most cutting-edge medical diagnostics and genomics applications, and make real & immediate impact to patients and healthcare providers, by providing timely & accurate data analysis support to Natera's production laboratories, as well as for other key business needs.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Technical Execution and Infrastructure

  • Deliver timely data support to Lab Operations teams, unblock production issues, and improve patient results turnaround times.
  • Apply statistical techniques to analyze complex datasets, diagnose operational issues, and support data-driven decision-making.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis, identify trends, and work with stakeholders to interpret findings and drive continuous improvement.
  • Design and implement automated solutions for recurring data analysis and production support workflows, improving operational efficiency and scalability.
  • Extract, transform, and analyze data to generate actionable insights that support lab production operations and business decisions.
  • Document analytical processes, best practices, and insights to ensure consistency and knowledge transfer across teams.

Process Improvement

  • Develop and optimize solutions for efficient data retrieval and scalable performance on large and/or complex datasets.
  • Learn and acquire operational efficiencies on new technologies and solutions developed by other DSPE teams.
  • Train and coach junior team members on new technologies, procedures, and guidelines/best practices.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Lab Operations and Product teams to identify process issues, assist with root cause analysis, and provide product support.
  • Represent the Data Science Production Engineering (DSPE) team in stakeholder meetings.
  • Effectively and correctly escalate encountered issues to other DSPE teams.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Masters degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Operational Research, or other related fields.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant industry experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience working in a highly regulated environment (e.g., CLIA and/or FDA compliant settings).
  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, extraction, querying in production support roles.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Working knowledge of the business processes and requirements of diagnostic laboratories. Knowledge of molecular biology, genetics, genomics, and/or bioinformatics is a plus.
  • Proficient in data analysis and statistical techniques.
  • Proficient in Python and SQL development.
  • Working knowledge of Snowflake platform and cloud technologies.
  • Strong understanding of statistical concepts such as hypothesis testing, central limit theorem, time series analysis, anomaly detection, and regression modeling.
  • Good documentation practices and coding style.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience using version control systems such as GitHub or GitLab for managing code and collaboration.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Strong integrity.
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$113,600—$142,000 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Kimbrell Agency

Remote (Birmingham, AL area)

Employment Type: Contractor

Compensation $50,000 to $100,000 per year (plus commission)

If you're reading this and thinking, "Insurance? Really?" I get it. I've thought that too—and I still do. The truth is, I'm not passionate about insurance. I'm passionate about people. We don’t just build careers; we build people who, in turn, build businesses. The result? Success and fulfillment.

We look forward to discovering what success means to you and, if we find that this is the right fit, we are fully committed to providing you with the tools, training, and support to make it happen.

The Problem with Most Insurance Jobs:

Let’s be real—most agencies are desperate to hire anyone with a pulse, offer minimal support, and if you're lucky, they might invest in you six months down the line. We think that's unacceptable.

At The Kimbrell Agency, we do things differently. We invest heavily from the start to ensure you're the right fit for this career. That means we pour everything into your long-term success. No leader can give everything it takes to help an agent succeed when they’re bringing on anyone who applies. Unfortunately, most agencies make empty promises: "Be in business for yourself, but not by yourself," or "We offer hands-on support and training."

Here, we actually mean it. And we have a proven track record of success to back it up.

What We Offer:

A Proven Lead System: Say goodbye to cold calling. Our streamlined lead generation system puts you in front of qualified buyers who have requested coverage. You’ll call these clients, set appointments, and meet virtually to help them find the best insurance plan for their needs and budget. Some agents even start part-time and transition to full-time.

A Real Opportunity for Growth: This role is perfect for self-disciplined sales professionals who are ready to put in the work. If you need someone looking over your shoulder or a time clock to punch, this isn't the right fit. But if you're driven, gritty and ready to build something meaningful, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:

Present and sell insurance products to new and existing customers.

Reach out to potential clients who have requested coverage.

Handle customer inquiries and resolve complaints.

Participate in regular Zoom training sessions.

Who We're Looking For:

Previous experience in sales, customer service, or a related field is a plus.

Familiarity with CRM platforms is helpful.

You know how to build rapport and trust with clients.

You’re deadline-driven, detail-oriented, and dedicated to delivering results.

Integrity and a strong work ethic are a must.

We’re seeking individuals who are ambitious, coachable, passionate about helping others, and driven to achieve greatness. If you’re ready to take control of your future and create a career you can be proud of, we’d love to connect.

Why Choose Us?

True Agency Ownership: Here, you’ll have the chance to own your business—contractually protect what you build.

Game-Changing Lead Program: We provide the industry’s best leads, generated in-house and heavily subsidized to help you succeed.

Comprehensive Training & Support: From day one, we offer hands-on training, including daily coaching calls, weekly one-on-ones, and group sessions. You’ll have a system to follow at every step of the way.

Industry-Leading Compensation: Our compensation plan is designed to deliver real profit, with vested rights from day one.

Dedicated Conservation Team: Our team ensures your business stays protected from chargebacks, giving you one of the highest persistency rates in the industry.

World-Class Travel & Incentives: Have the ability to earn 3-4 fully-paid trips per year, all expenses covered.

Unlimited Earning Potential: This is a commission and bonus-based position, with no cap on how much you can earn. Your income potential is truly unlimited.

A Few More Details:

This role does require a Life and Health Insurance License, but don’t worry—we’ll help you obtain it through a streamlined online course that takes just 7-10 days.

Please note: Success in this role varies. Your level of success will depend on several factors, including the effort you put in, your ability to follow and implement our proven system, and the specific insurance needs in your geographic area. Not all agents achieve the same results, and earnings are based on individual performance.

Ready to Build Your Future with Us?

If you're ready to make a difference—not just in your own life, but in the lives of others—apply today. We can’t wait to see how you define success.

About Kimbrell Agency:

Kyle & Lisa Kimbrell are financial service industry veterans with over 50 years experience combined in sales, marketing and leadership. Since founding their Symmetry Financial Group business in July of 2016 their national agency has sold over 55,000 life, health, annuity, disability and retirement policies with over $85 million in sales. The Kimbrells attained Equity Partnership in only 24 months, which is the fastest in SFG history.

Who We Are

Our mission is to simplify the software delivery process so that DevOps and Platform Engineering teams can move fast, and deploy code effortlessly without the fear of breaking things.

The Akuity Platform enables teams to manage the development and deployment across hundreds – if not thousands – of Kubernetes clusters from a single control plane. Trusted by top companies around the globe, the Akuity Platform provides the only end-to-end GitOps platform for the enterprises.

Today, Argo CD is the third most popular project in the CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) and is used by 70% of companies who are using Kubernetes in production. The list of Argo CD users includes companies like Intuit, BlackRock, Tesla, Major League Baseball, Peloton, and many more.

Meet the Team

We are growing our North American sales team and seeking a technical, high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to help accelerate our expansion. You will join a small but impactful sales team and play a critical role in driving net-new business and growing existing accounts across the region.

We’re a team of self-starters with proven experience selling SaaS solutions in complex technical environments. You’ll develop territory plans, generate pipeline, and guide prospects through a consultative sales cycle, typically 6-8 months long.

Location: US & Canada - Remote - Pacific Standard Time, Mountain Standard Time, Central Standard Time

Who You’ll Do

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new and expansion opportunities across North America territory.
  • Generate new business opportunities through multichannel outbound campaigns.
  • Develop a territory plan, including target accounts and pipeline generation strategies.
  • Research accounts, identify key stakeholders, and develop relationships to drive opportunities.
  • Attend customer meetings and events, such as conferences and roadshows, approximately every other month.
  • Act as a customer advocate and liaison to Akuity’s engineering team for feature requests.
  • Leverage sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC to qualify, advance, and forecast opportunities accurately.
  • Map technical needs to business outcomes and clearly articulate ROI.
  • Manage all activities and pipeline in HubSpot.

Who You Are

  • Minimum 5 years in a B2B SaaS sales role.
  • Proven success consistently exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong technical orientation and ability to understand GitOps/DevOps, Kubernetes, and the cloud-native ecosystem.
  • Effective communicator with excellent listening, presentation, and writing skills.
  • Self-starter who thrives in a high-energy, collaborative environment.
  • Experience educating customers on product features, best practices, and adoption strategies.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Kubernetes, GitOps/DevOps, Argo CD, and/or open-source enterprise sales.
  • Experience selling from the bottom up within engineering organizations.

Comp

  • $280k+ OTE
    • No Cap on Commission
    • Two accelerator levels above 100% attainment
  • Equity Grant

Why Akuity?

At Akuity, we believe open-source software is the most impactful way to build lasting technology. We founded this company to advocate for Argo, share our expertise, and be a trusted partner to its users.

Our culture is grounded in humility, authenticity, and diversity. We value people from different backgrounds and paths in life. We trust our team members to take ownership, act responsibly, and support one another. If you are collaborative, curious, and dedicated to helping customers succeed, we’d love to meet you.

Job Description: Airline Customer Service Specialist

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Airline Customer Service Specialists to contribute their industry knowledge to an AI training project. You will create realistic airline customer service scenarios, evaluate AI-generated responses, and provide feedback to improve accuracy, professionalism, and customer experience. No prior AI experience is required.

Scope of Work

  • Create realistic written and verbal interactions based on common and complex airline customer service scenarios.
  • Simulate and document customer conversations involving flight bookings, cancellations, delays, rebookings, baggage inquiries, and travel disruptions.
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy, empathy, and professionalism.
  • Identify common customer pain points and provide detailed insights to support AI model improvement.
  • Prepare summaries of customer interactions, including escalation and resolution steps.
  • Explain airline procedures, operational protocols, and compliance requirements through text and voice inputs.
  • Collaborate remotely with project managers and AI developers to meet project requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Professional experience in airline or aviation customer service, preferably in a call center environment.
  • Knowledge of flight reservations, cancellations, delays, rebookings, and baggage-related concerns.
  • Experience handling customer complaints and resolving challenging situations professionally.
  • Fluency in spoken and written English, with strong verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to demonstrate empathy, active listening, and a customer-first approach.
  • Strong documentation and scenario-writing skills with attention to procedural accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with airline industry regulations and operational procedures.
  • Experience using airline CRM, reservation, or ticketing systems.
  • Experience with voice-based customer support or training activities.

raw.title: Associate Director, Growth Strategy
raw.excerpt: We are a global digital agency comprised of strategists, creatives, media experts, data scientists, and engineers driven by one common purpose — accelerate business growth through marketing and digital transformation.
raw.description:
We are a global digital agency comprised of strategists, creatives, media experts, data scientists, and engineers driven by one common purpose — accelerate business growth through marketing and digital transformation. Named a top 3% Google Premier Partner and recognized by Inc. 5000 and Adweek’s 75 Fastest Growing Companies, we’re constantly looking for “A” players to join our team.

The rapid growth is attributed to our strongest asset — our people. Our teams are highly collaborative and work closely with each client to set clear goals and objectives so that we can deliver exceptional results. Mindgruve is a place where every opinion is valued. Not only will you be empowered to contribute ideas, but you will also play a key role in the execution and driving success for brands across a variety of industries. Sound fun? Perfect — you’ll fit right in.

Mindgruve is seeking an Associate Director, Growth Strategy to help develop insight-driven brand and marketing strategies that accelerate customer acquisition, demand generation, and profitable business growth for leading brands.

This role focuses on connecting our clients' business strategies to their brand and marketing strategies. You'll leverage market research, competitive intelligence, consumer insights, and business performance data to identify growth opportunities and translate them into actionable marketing recommendations.

Working alongside senior strategy leadership and cross-functional teams, you'll help clients understand where growth opportunities exist, which audiences represent the greatest potential, how to differentiate their brands, and how marketing can drive measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, analytically minded, commercially focused, and passionate about understanding what drives consumer behavior and business growth.

We're looking for a strategist who can connect the dots between business objectives, market dynamics, consumer needs, and marketing opportunities—and turn those insights into clear, compelling strategies.

What You'll Do Here:

  • Business & Growth Strategy
    • Partner with senior strategy leaders to understand client business models, growth objectives, competitive positioning, and market challenges.
    • Translate business priorities into actionable brand, marketing, and demand generation strategies.
    • Identify opportunities to accelerate customer acquisition, increase market share, strengthen brand differentiation, and drive revenue growth.
    • Analyze business performance, market dynamics, and customer behavior to uncover growth opportunities.
    • Support the development of go-to-market strategies, audience priorities, value propositions, and integrated marketing plans.
    • Help establish clear marketing objectives and success metrics aligned with client business goals.
  • Market Research & Competitive Intelligence
    • Conduct market, industry, category, and competitive research to inform strategic recommendations.
    • Analyze competitors' positioning, messaging, customer acquisition strategies, marketing investments, and market presence.
    • Identify emerging trends, unmet customer needs, competitive gaps, and opportunities for differentiation.
    • Leverage quantitative and qualitative research to evaluate market opportunities and consumer demand.
    • Synthesize complex research findings into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
    • Develop competitive assessments, market opportunity analyses, and strategic planning presentations.
  • Consumer & Audience Insights
    • Analyze consumer behaviors, motivations, preferences, and purchase drivers to inform brand and marketing strategies.
    • Leverage audience research, customer data, search behavior, social intelligence, and market trends to identify high-value customer segments.
    • Develop audience profiles, customer personas, and purchase journey insights that support customer acquisition and demand generation.
    • Identify barriers to purchase, unmet needs, and opportunities to improve brand consideration and conversion.
    • Translate consumer insights into recommendations for brand positioning, messaging, audience targeting, and marketing activation.
    • Collaborate with data and analytics teams to incorporate customer intelligence and performance insights into strategic planning.
  • Brand & Marketing Strategy
    • Help connect client business strategy with differentiated brand positioning, messaging, and marketing priorities.
    • Support the development of brand value propositions, strategic messaging frameworks, and go-to-market recommendations.
    • Develop insight-driven strategic briefs that guide creative, media, social, and commerce teams.
    • Identify opportunities to improve brand awareness, consideration, customer acquisition, and conversion.
    • Collaborate with channel specialists to ensure marketing strategies align with business objectives and audience opportunities.
    • Help translate strategic recommendations into integrated marketing plans that balance brand building with demand generation and measurable performance.
  • Demand Generation & Marketing Effectiveness
    • Identify opportunities to generate demand, reach new audiences, improve conversion, and accelerate revenue growth.
    • Analyze customer acquisition opportunities across paid media, search, social, content, commerce, and other marketing channels.
    • Work with media and performance marketing teams to connect audience insights and growth objectives to channel strategies.
    • Support the development of marketing plans that align investment priorities with business opportunities.
    • Evaluate campaign and marketing performance to identify insights that inform future strategic recommendations.
    • Understand key business and marketing metrics, including customer acquisition cost, conversion rates, customer lifetime value, return on marketing investment, and revenue growth.
  • Strategic Planning & Client Collaboration
    • Support senior strategy leaders in developing client growth strategies, annual marketing plans, and strategic recommendations.
    • Independently manage research, competitive analysis, audience insights, and assigned strategic planning workstreams.
    • Develop clear, compelling presentations that connect business challenges, research findings, insights, and strategic recommendations.
    • Participate in client workshops, planning sessions, and strategic presentations.
    • Collaborate with Mindgruve's media, creative, social, commerce, and data teams to bring strategies to life.
    • Contribute to new business pitches by researching prospective clients, identifying market opportunities, and developing strategic insights.
    • Stay current on emerging consumer trends, competitive dynamics, marketing technologies, and AI-powered research tools.

We Need a Person With:

  • 6–9 years of experience in marketing strategy, growth strategy, brand planning, consumer insights, or related disciplines.
  • Experience at an integrated advertising agency, digital marketing agency, media agency, or marketing consultancy.
  • Demonstrated experience translating business objectives, market research, and consumer insights into actionable marketing strategies.
  • Strong understanding of customer acquisition, demand generation, brand positioning, and integrated marketing principles.
  • Experience conducting competitive research, market analysis, consumer research, and audience segmentation.
  • Ability to analyze business and marketing data, identify meaningful insights, and develop clear strategic recommendations.
  • Understanding of how brand strategy, creative, media, social, search, and commerce contribute to customer acquisition and business growth.
  • Strong strategic writing, storytelling, and presentation skills.
  • Proficiency in developing strategic presentations, research summaries, competitive analyses, and marketing recommendations.
  • Strong analytical thinking, intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and collaborate effectively with senior strategists and cross-functional teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • Identify meaningful market, competitive, and consumer insights that uncover new growth opportunities for clients.
  • Translate business objectives into clear, differentiated brand and marketing strategies.
  • Develop actionable recommendations that improve customer acquisition, demand generation, and marketing effectiveness.
  • Deliver high-quality research, strategic analysis, and presentations that strengthen client decision-making.
  • Become a trusted contributor to client strategy and integrated marketing planning.
  • Help Mindgruve deliver smarter marketing strategies that drive measurable business results.

Compensation:

Salary: $100,000 - $125,000 (Pay range is based on a market reference point and potential job offers may vary based on the skills, education, experience and geographic location of the individual candidate. The compensation range reflects base rate only.)

Compensation will be commensurate with experience. Additionally, for eligible full-time employees, we offer a competitive benefits package including medical insurance, dental insurance, and vision insurance; a flexible spending account; voluntary life and accident plans; and a 401(k) retirement plan with matching. We have six office locations in the US: San Diego, California, Los Angeles, California, Covington, Kentucky, Denver, Colorado, Nashville, Tennessee and Charleston, South Carolina. We're seeking local candidates (or those open to relocation) who are able to work collaboratively with us in one of our office's; however, based on business needs and unique job functions, some roles may be eligible for remote work. (Bonus points if you’re bilingual in Spanish and/or Portuguese.)

Mindgruve is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
