raw.description:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

We chose hard problems on purpose.

We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.

Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.

If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.

About the Role

The fintechs winning US founders aren't doing it with whitepapers. They're doing it on X and LinkedIn, through founders who post every day, creators who bring their audiences, and communities people actually want to join. The playbook is public. We want the person who runs it better, in Jeeves' voice, and turns it into US customers.
You'll own Jeeves' organic presence in the US. Post every day on X. Make our CEO and execs voices that founders and CFOs follow on LinkedIn. Build an owned community around the stablecoin moment. Bring in the creators our future customers already listen to. You'll be measured on pipeline and revenue, not followers.
This is hands-on. You post, reply and ship, with Marketing, Design and Sales behind you, not a big team on day one. If it works, you'll help decide what this team becomes.
No fintech or B2B background required (B2C is welcome). If you live on X and know how to build an audience, we want to talk.
Full-time · Remote (US, US hours) · Reports to Juan Da Gonzalez, Global Head of Marketing · Comp: TBD

What You'll Do

X, every day:

  • Post and engage daily on X in Jeeves' voice. This is the main stage.
  • Jump into the conversations founders and finance people are already having, before they're about us
  • Test formats fast, keep what works, kill what doesn't
  • Stay credible to CFOs while bringing consumer-level energy

LinkedIn for execs and finance buyers:

  • Write for and with our execs (especially Dileep and Juan Da) so they show up consistently and sound like themselves
  • Turn exec and CEO posts on LinkedIn into reach with CFOs, controllers and finance teams, the people who buy cards and treasury

Community that turns into customers:

  • Build and run an owned community for US founders and finance leaders, likely on Telegram or a private Slack, with the stablecoin angle at its center
  • Show up in the private founder and finance communities (Slack and WhatsApp groups) where operators actually talk
  • Use Reddit where it fits, and take the community offline with in-person moments
  • Talk directly with our top customers and prospects, and bring them in
  • Partner with Sales so community conversations become qualified pipeline, with clean hand-offs
  • Own the numbers: community-sourced pipeline, conversion and revenue, alongside reach and engagement

Creators and partners:

  • Find the creators and online voices our future customers already follow, and build real relationships with them
  • Stand up and run a creator/affiliate program tied to referred customers
  • Explore ambassador and early-career programs that build grassroots presence with our ICP
  • Double down on the partners who actually move sign-ups and spend

Launches and the content engine:

  • Turn launches (like our stablecoin products) and company moments (like a fundraise) into organic moments that paid amplifies
  • Keep organic and paid telling one story with Product Marketing and Design
  • Build a repeatable, AI-assisted content engine, with you as the editor on quality and accuracy
  • Study the best community playbooks in fintech and adapt what fits Jeeves

Minimum Requirements:

  • You live on X and have grown a visible audience or community yourself, in any space: B2B or B2C, startups, tech, fintech, ecommerce, culture or creators. Show us the account and how you grew it.
  • 6+ years in content, social, community or growth, including at least 2 years owning a brand's organic presence end to end
  • You've tied content or community to sign-ups, pipeline or revenue, with numbers you can walk us through
  • You've written for or built presence for founders or executives
  • A strong writer and editor, from a sharp single post to a longer piece, who knows which one the moment needs
  • A creator mindset: you build in public, talk to customers and ship daily without a big team
  • You use AI tools every day, with the taste to keep the output specific and on-brand
  • US-based, native English, working US hours

Nice to Have:

  • Grown a following with finance or operator audiences on LinkedIn
  • Built or ran a Telegram, Slack or Reddit community, or grew a large X following from scratch
  • Discord community experience
  • Experience at a fintech, payments, stablecoin, SaaS, DTC/ecommerce, consumer or creator-led brand (fintech is a plus, not required)
  • Ran a creator, affiliate or ambassador program tied to customer acquisition
  • Existing relationships with founder, operator or finance creators in the US
  • Spanish and/or Portuguese

What We Offer:

  • Compensation: TBD, calibrated to US market benchmarks for Head of Content & Community roles
  • Equity in a high-growth, well-funded global fintech
  • Fully remote within the United States
  • Health, dental and vision benefits
  • Build Jeeves' US community from the ground up, with a CEO who's active on X and wants to be part of it
  • A high-trust culture that values craftsmanship, autonomy and impact
Sound like you? Bring your X handle and show us what you've built.

Be a Part of our Team!

Join a working team that is dedicated to the mission of the work we do!
Teaching Strategies is an innovative edtech organization focused on connecting teachers, children, and families. As front runners in the early childhood education market, we build dynamic, top-quality digital products that integrate all of the essential elements of a high-quality solution: curriculum, assessment, professional development, and family engagement. We are building a team of results-oriented individuals who will thrive in a collaborative, work-hard/play-hard culture. We pride ourselves on the impact we have on the early childhood field through supporting teachers who are doing the most important work there is, teaching children to become creative, confident thinkers.

Position Overview
Teaching Strategies is looking for a highly talented, innovative, and creative Software Engineering Manager to join our technology team. Our platform continues to evolve rapidly, and we are looking for a leader who can help teams move quickly, build high-quality software, adopt new technologies, and scale engineering delivery across a growing SaaS platform supporting millions of users globally.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership with a highly collaborative, product-oriented mindset and thrives in iterative environments where speed, ownership, quality, and continuous improvement are critical. This is a leadership role focused on delivering high quality products by accelerating engineering effectiveness through modern automation, AI-assisted development, and agentic workflows.

Specific Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Lead and support engineering teams delivering scalable, high-quality SaaS products and platform services.
  • Drive fast, iterative, and customer-focused delivery through close collaboration with Product Managers.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, innovation, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Use AI-assisted development and agentic workflows to improve engineering velocity, product quality, operational efficiency, and team effectiveness.
  • Participate in planning, architecture, technical design, and implementation of new software solutions and platform capabilities.
  • Guide teams in building scalable, secure, and resilient systems that perform reliably under high traffic and operational load.
  • Mentor and grow engineers while helping teams adapt quickly to evolving business and technical priorities.
  • Collaborate with engineering leadership to improve development processes, delivery practices, and organizational effectiveness.
Qualifications:
  • Strong technical background with the ability to guide architecture, implementation, and engineering execution decisions.
  • Experience designing and building scalable systems that perform under load.
  • Experience leading teams in Agile and iterative product development environments.
  • Strong collaboration skills with Product Managers and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of AI-first and agentic development approaches to accelerate implementation, delivery, and operational workflows.
  • Excellent communication, organizational leadership, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, teamwork, and customer focus.
Why Teaching Strategies

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7 AM-5 PM Pacific Time

Long-term, full-time independent contractor role

You know how to find great people, even when they aren't looking for a job.

Do It Right Plumbers is bringing recruiting in-house. We're a growing residential home-services company in Orange County, California, looking for an experienced recruiter to own hiring across our local and remote teams.

This is not a high-volume recruiting role. We typically make 1-4 hires per month, and we'd rather make a few exceptional hires than fill seats quickly with the wrong people.

You'll recruit across plumbing and skilled trades, field sales, inside sales, customer service, dispatch, install and operations.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Full-cycle recruiting from sourcing through offer
  • Active candidate sourcing, not just reviewing applications

• Screening and interviewing candidates

• Managing assessments and follow-up

  • Building pipelines for hard-to-fill positions
  • Partnering directly with hiring managers

• Keeping our ATS organized and current

THIS ROLE REQUIRES MORE THAN LINKEDIN

Some of our most important hires are plumbing installers and field salespeople who may never have a polished LinkedIn profile. You need to know how to find talent through:

• Facebook and local Facebook groups

• Trade and industry communities

• Local job boards

• Competitor research

• Referral networks

• Social media

• Direct outreach

• LinkedIn Recruiter and Boolean search

  • Other creative sourcing channels you discover

You should be comfortable learning the Orange County market from another country and figuring out where great local talent actually spends their time.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience
  • Experience recruiting for U.S. companies or clients

• Strong outbound sourcing experience

  • Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, job boards and ATS platforms
  • Experience sourcing through Facebook, social communities or other nontraditional channels

• Excellent spoken and written English

  • Fast, resourceful and highly self-directed

Experience recruiting plumbing, HVAC, electrical, construction, skilled trades or salespeople is a major plus.

This is recruiting, not HR. You will not own employee relations, compliance or write-ups.

If great candidates aren't applying, we expect you to go find them.

Success here isn't measured by how many people you hire. It's measured by how many great people we still want working here months later.

Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a short recorded video interview.

Salary: $2,000-$2,500 USD/month + retention bonuses

raw.description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Who You Are :

HighLevel is seeking a Sr. FP&A Systems Analyst to join our Corporate FP&A team. This hands-on role will support the implementation, maintenance, and optimization of our financial planning system, Abacum, and help integrate financial and operational data to streamline reporting across the business.

You’ll play a key role in shaping how the Finance team operates by building efficient, automated processes that improve accuracy, visibility, and scalability. You will be driving forward the scaling of our financial processes, identifying opportunities to reduce manual effort, and empowering self-service reporting for management. The ideal candidate has experience working with modern FP&A or BI tools, enjoys solving data and system challenges, and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

You will report to the Senior Director, Corporate FP&A and partner closely with FP&A, Accounting, People, and Data teams.

What You Will Do :

  • Support configuration, maintenance, and enhancement of Abacum, including financial models, formulas, dimensions, mappings, and planning scenarios, ensuring the tool meets Finance’s planning, reporting, and forecasting needs.
  • Integrate financial and operational data from key systems (e.g., NetSuite, Snowflake, HRIS, CRM, billing systems) to ensure accurate and automated data flows into Abacum
  • Build and enhance reporting dashboards and planning templates within Abacum to support Finance and cross-functional teams with consistent, real-time insights
  • Effectively lead the intake, coordination, and execution of multiple projects or requests from cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with FP&A and Accounting teams to align data definitions, assumptions, and reporting structures across systems
  • Support the rollout of Abacum “spaces” and dashboards for business partners across the organization, ensuring data accuracy and ease of use
  • Perform data validation and reconciliations between source systems, financial models, and reporting outputs; investigate discrepancies and work with the appropriate teams to resolve them.
  • Test model and integration changes before rollout to confirm calculations, data accuracy, and downstream reporting.
  • Document key workflows, integrations, and system processes to ensure long-term scalability and repeatability
  • Identify and automate manual Finance workflows by leveraging system capabilities and integrations to reduce friction and improve efficiency
  • Partner with Finance leadership to evaluate new features, enhancements, or integrations that improve system performance and user experience
  • Provide training and support to FP&A and business users on system functionality, dashboards, and best practices

What You Bring :

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in FP&A, Finance Systems, or related roles within a SaaS or technology company
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining financial models in FP&A tools, including formulas, dimensions, and planning scenarios (Abacum preferred; Pigment, Adaptive, or Anaplan also relevant).
  • Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., Intacct, NetSuite) and data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake)
  • Basic understanding of system integrations, data flows, and financial planning processes (forecasting, budgeting, headcount planning, reporting)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Experience working with BI or reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI) is a plus
  • Ability to translate business needs into clear system requirements and collaborate effectively with technical teams
  • Strong organizational and communication skills; comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Curiosity, ownership mindset, and enthusiasm for improving financial systems and processes

The salary range for this position is $103000 - $125000 annually.

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions tohundreds of thousands of businessesand empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next New Business Account Executive.

About the job

This position is needed to sell into high value ISV, High Tech, AI Native and Enterprise companies. You will play a key role in further growing Twilio’s Communication Products business across Southern Europe. You will be responsible for sourcing new, high value customers as well as driving the sales process from internal leads to qualifying new prospects and handling deals to closure.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Be responsible for new customer acquisition and driving ACV for a specific set of accounts while maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Master creating pricing proposals, negotiating terms and managing the contract process. Ideally, you also have experience selling communications to a technical and business audience, building trust and mutual respect with technical customers and peers.
  • Are passionate about what you do and you are able to think outside of the box and have extraordinary interpersonal and communication skills to make complex contractual, technical, and financial details sound simple.
  • Able to balance challenging priorities and handle multiple projects/deals at the same time.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 8+ years of Enterprise Sales experience and a track record of personally selling and closing complex solutions to enterprise and software companies.
  • Strong experience identifying, mapping and prospecting enterprise accounts
  • Proven success in selling complex, technical solutions such as cloud communications platforms, APIs, and/or enterprise software
  • Experience in account management, developing and managing large enterprise clients, and a history of meeting or exceeding sales targets
  • Experience working with ISVs.
  • Background in working within a quota-driven environment with proven ability to close high-value deals (e.g., six to seven figures)
  • Expertise in solution-based selling or consultative selling
  • Strong negotiation and contract management skills, including handling complex deals with long sales cycles.
  • Prospecting and lead generation skills—ability to develop a pipeline through multiple channels, including direct sales, partnerships, and networking.
  • Ability to build and nurture relationships with C-level executives, decision-makers, cross-functional partners and key stakeholders in large enterprises
  • Strong presentation and negotiation skills
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic / environment.
  • Fluent in Hebrew

Desired:

  • Ideally, you also have experience selling both to a business and technical audience
  • Understanding of the CPaaS ecosystem and familiarity with:
    • Cloud communications (voice, SMS, chat, video, etc.).
    • APIs and integrations for communication services.
    • Telecommunications industry dynamics.
    • Knowledge of enterprise technology architecture and the technical needs of large organizations, including how CPaaS solutions integrate with existing systems.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in UK, Ireland or Spain.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

raw.description:
El Institute for War & Peace Reporting (IWPR) es una organización independiente sin fines de lucro que trabaja para empoderar a las voces locales en primera línea, promoviendo cambios positivos en contextos de conflicto, crisis o transición en todo el mundo. Desde hace más de 30 años, IWPR fomenta el acceso a información confiable y el debate público para contribuir a la construcción de sociedades más estables, justas e inclusivas.

El Institute for War and Peace Reporting (IWPR) busca contratar un/a consultor/a especializado/a en monetización de plataformas digitales, con énfasis en YouTube, para brindar asesoría a medios independientes que operan en entornos restrictivos de América Latina. La consultoría se centrará en fortalecer las capacidades de estos medios para desarrollar e implementar estrategias que les permitan generar y aumentar sus ingresos en dichas plataformas, de acuerdo con su contexto, sus recursos y sus prioridades editoriales.

El/la consultor/a prestará apoyo de asesoramiento continuo y personalizado a los medios de comunicación participantes para evaluar el potencial de monetización de sus canales digitales actuales, identificar oportunidades para generar y diversificar ingresos, y recomendar mejoras en las estrategias de contenido, la frecuencia de publicación y otras prácticas que puedan potenciar la monetización. A partir de estas evaluaciones, el consultor colaborará con cada medio para desarrollar y poner en práctica un plan de monetización a medida, destinado a aumentar los ingresos y reforzar la sostenibilidad financiera.

Asimismo, el/la consultor/a analizará el desempeño de los contenidos y ofrecerá recomendaciones prácticas para mejorar el alcance, la fidelización de la audiencia, la participación y el potencial de ingresos. Esta labor incluirá la definición de objetivos y el seguimiento de indicadores, el análisis de las métricas disponibles y el apoyo a la implementación de ajustes que contribuyan a la sostenibilidad financiera de cada medio.

La asesoría deberá considerar las políticas de monetización, los derechos de autor y las restricciones geográficas o de acceso a pagos que puedan afectar a los medios participantes. Las recomendaciones deberán adaptarse a estas condiciones y a las capacidades de cada equipo, respetando en todo momento su independencia editorial y cumpliendo estrictamente con los protocolos de seguridad establecidos por IWPR.

El/la consultor/a deberá mantener una coordinación permanente con IWPR durante toda la consultoría, documentar los avances y demostrar flexibilidad para trabajar de forma remota con equipos que pueden enfrentar limitaciones de conectividad o desenvolverse en contextos complejos.

Alcance de la consultoría:

  • Brindar asesoría remota y personalizada en monetización de plataformas digitales, con énfasis en YouTube, a equipos de medios independientes que operan en entornos restrictivos de América Latina.
  • Acompañar el diagnóstico, diseño e implementación de un plan de monetización adaptado al estado de los canales, el contexto, los recursos y las necesidades de cada medio.
  • Fortalecer las capacidades de los equipos para gestionar sus canales, optimizar sus contenidos e identificar y aprovechar opciones de monetización que contribuyan a su sostenibilidad económica.
  • Orientar la definición de objetivos, metas de ingresos, indicadores y herramientas de seguimiento que permitan evaluar los resultados y ajustar las estrategias de contenido y monetización.
  • Aplicar una metodología práctica y orientada a resultados, basada en el acompañamiento continuo, recomendaciones que los equipos puedan implementar con sus recursos y la documentación de avances y productos.
  • Garantizar el cumplimiento de los protocolos de seguridad y los requisitos de reporte establecidos por IWPR, respetando la independencia editorial de los medios participantes y considerando las políticas y restricciones aplicables a la monetización en cada plataforma.

Funciones:

  • Realizar un diagnóstico de los canales (particularmente Youtube) y las capacidades de cada medio, identificar oportunidades y obstáculos para la monetización y acordar un plan de trabajo con objetivos, cronograma e indicadores de seguimiento.
  • Asesorar sobre los requisitos de elegibilidad, las políticas y las opciones de monetización disponibles, considerando los derechos de autor y las restricciones geográficas o de acceso a pagos que puedan afectar a cada medio.
  • Acompañar la implementación de las iniciativas de monetización y analizar las métricas de alcance, retención, tiempo de visualización e ingresos disponibles para identificar mejoras y orientar ajustes.
  • Fortalecer las capacidades de los equipos para interpretar sus resultados y tomar decisiones que contribuyan a generar ingresos de manera sostenida, de acuerdo con sus recursos y prioridades editoriales.
  • Coordinar con IWPR, documentar avances y aplicar los protocolos de seguridad del proyecto, respetando la independencia editorial de los medios participantes.

Entregables:

Minutas de las reuniones con los medios, informes escritos sobre los avances logrados por cada equipo, las actividades planificadas y, cuando corresponda, recomendaciones estratégicas, utilizando la plantilla proporcionada por IWPR.

Requisitos mínimos:

  • Licenciatura en Periodismo, Comunicación, Marketing Digital, Administración de Empresas o áreas afines, o acreditación de al menos tres años de experiencia comprobada en monetización de plataformas digitales.
  • Experiencia mínima de tres años en el diseño e implementación de estrategias de monetización de plataformas digitales, especialmente YouTube, con resultados demostrables en la generación o el crecimiento de ingresos.
  • Conocimiento de las herramientas, los requisitos de elegibilidad y las políticas de monetización de YouTube, incluidos aspectos relacionados con derechos de autor, restricciones geográficas y acceso a pagos.
  • Experiencia en el análisis de métricas de desempeño e ingresos y en la optimización de canales y contenidos para mejorar el alcance, la retención de audiencias y los resultados de monetización.
  • Experiencia en la asesoría a equipos y en el diseño y la facilitación de talleres o mentorías, con capacidad para formular recomendaciones adaptadas a sus recursos.
  • Disponibilidad horaria flexible para coordinar reuniones, mentorías y talleres de forma remota con equipos en diferentes zonas horarias.
  • Dominio pleno de español e inglés.
  • Sensibilidad cultural y capacidad demostrada para adaptar el acompañamiento a diversos contextos y necesidades.
  • Ética profesional.
Salary: $40 to $80 per hour

  • Support the initial integration of cross-company communication, followed by the migration of users to AbbVie-managed devices, and subsequently assist with application transitions and the decommissioning of legacy environments
  • Serve as the primary liaison between the Identity team and both technical and business stakeholders, operating at both strategic and operational levels to develop, coordinate, and implement secure identity designs.
  • Provide advisory services to reduce risk and technical friction in these transactions. As a full-time employee, you will be a key contributor to AbbVie’s long-term strategy and culture.

raw.description:
About us:

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

The Role:

We’re looking for a Business Analyst in Mexico to support the ongoing operation, maintenance, and enhancement of a US-based client’s commerce platform. The role combines backlog management, functional analysis, technical investigation, production monitoring, and hands-on production support to ensure platform stability and business continuity throughout the client’s peak sales season. Working closely with Product Owners, Developers, QA Engineers, and business stakeholders, you’ll investigate reported issues, validate existing functionality, document requirements, monitor production performance, and coordinate issue resolution across multiple platform components.

Key Responsibilities:

Backlog Management & Issue Analysis

  • Review and analyze backlog items to determine whether previously reported issues are still occurring or have already been resolved
  • Investigate existing issues by reviewing reported scenarios, system behavior, and available production information
  • Create and document bugs when issues are confirmed, including detailed steps to reproduce, expected results, actual results, and supporting evidence
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Developers, and QA teams to clarify requirements, assess issue priority, and support backlog refinement

Functional Analysis & Documentation

  • Perform functional investigations and document system behavior, business rules, and existing functionality
  • Prepare and maintain functional documentation in Confluence, including Functional Descriptions, Spike investigations, and technical/functional findings
  • Research undocumented or unclear functionality to help Product Owners and development teams understand system behavior
  • Provide detailed analysis to support enhancements, bug fixes, and ongoing platform improvements

Production Monitoring & Operational Metrics

  • Monitor production dashboards to track platform health, operational indicators, and reported issues
  • Review dashboard metrics and identify anomalies, data inconsistencies, and potential production problems
  • Investigate issues identified through operational monitoring and coordinate the appropriate corrective actions
  • Maintain visibility into critical platform operations, particularly during peak sales periods

Production Support & Issue Resolution

  • Investigate and support the resolution of production issues reported through operational dashboards and business teams
  • Perform data corrections and operational fixes involving customer accounts, orders, and other platform records
  • Investigate and resolve issues involving order data and order processing, user accounts and duplicate user records, partner transmission and integration-related issues, and data inconsistencies and other operational exceptions
  • Use available platform tools and interfaces, including Backoffice, SAP Commerce, HAC (Hybris Administration Console), and the application UI, to investigate and perform authorized operational corrections
  • Execute manual operational procedures when necessary to restore expected system behavior and minimize business disruption
  • Validate corrections to ensure that affected records and business processes are functioning as expected

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Owners, Developers, QA Engineers, and Operations teams to investigate and resolve functional and production issues
  • Provide technical and functional context to development teams through clear documentation and reproducible scenarios
  • Support QA activities by validating reported issues and confirming expected system behavior
  • Communicate investigation findings, operational risks, and resolution status to relevant stakeholders

Peak Season Support

  • During the peak sales season, the role places increased emphasis on production monitoring, incident investigation, operational data corrections, and rapid issue resolution
  • Help maintain business continuity by monitoring production indicators, investigating customer-impacting issues, and performing operational corrections across the platform to minimize disruptions to users

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Production Support Analyst, or similar role on enterprise e-commerce platforms
  • Hands-on experience with SAP Commerce (Hybris), including Backoffice and HAC (Hybris Administration Console)
  • Experience investigating production issues and performing data corrections on orders, customer accounts, and other platform records
  • Strong ability to write clear bug reports, including steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual results, and supporting evidence
  • Experience documenting functional behavior, business rules, and findings in Confluence
  • Experience managing and refining backlogs in Jira
  • Experience monitoring production dashboards and operational reports to identify anomalies and data inconsistencies
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with Product Owners, Developers, QA, and business stakeholders
  • Excellent written and spoken English

Nice to have:

  • Experience supporting high-volume, seasonal, or peak-traffic commerce operations
  • Experience troubleshooting system integrations and data transmission issues
  • Familiarity with FlexibleSearch, SQL, or other data query tools
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams
  • Previous experience working with US-based clients or distributed teams

Location:

  • Remote, Mexico

Time Zone:

  • Must work overlapping hours with US Eastern Time

Employment Type:

  • Contract

Work authorization:

  • Candidates must be authorized to work in Mexico and currently located in Mexico.

You'll play a critical role in managing complex projects, liaising with cross-functional teams, and ensuring mission success in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Consult with clients to define project requirements, assess risks, and recommend data-driven solutions to complex challenges.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Active SECRET Clearance.
  • 5–10 years of relevant project management experience with a Bachelor's Degree; additional years of experience may substitute for the degree requirement.
  • Proven ability to initiate, supervise, and manage projects from inception through completion, including complex and mission-critical programs.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to conduct evaluations, develop recommendations, and implement process improvements.
  • Demonstrated experience providing strategic advice, technical guidance, and subject matter expertise to program and project teams.
  • Experience consulting with clients to define project requirements, conduct data analysis, and recommend solutions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare high-quality reports, briefings, and presentations for diverse audiences.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Desired:

  • Experience supporting high-visibility projects with complex deliverables and stakeholder requirements.
  • Ability to apply advanced project management principles, theories, and concepts, and contribute to the development of innovative strategies.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills, with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Knowledge of the sponsor's organization, mission, and key partners.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent project management credentials (preferred but not required).


-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$82,100-$172,400

Bounteous is a premier end-to-end digital transformation consultancy dedicated to partnering with ambitious brands to create digital solutions for today’s complex challenges and tomorrow’s opportunities. The ideal candidate brings strong financial services industry knowledge, a proven track record of commercial account ownership within technology consulting or digital transformation services, and the ability to build relationships with senior business and technology executives. raw.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
raw.excerpt: *Open to remote US and Canada The role As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you’ll partner with 15 to 20 of our largest customers.
raw.description:
*Open to remote US and Canada

The role

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you’ll partner with 15 to 20 of our largest customers. You’ll learn how their field operations really run and where TrueContext can make them better, then help them get there. You’ll be their strategic advisor and their most knowledgeable guide to the platform. Inside TrueContext, you’ll be their strongest voice.

Why this work matters

When a hospital's imaging system goes down, patients wait for answers. When a substation fails, a neighborhood loses power. When an inspection is missed in a building’s fire system, people are at risk. A skilled field engineer stands behind each of those moments. Their work keeps hospitals, cities and energy systems running, and most of it goes unseen.

TrueContext is the Field Intelligence platform built for those engineers. Leading companies in medical technology, utilities, energy and building systems use us to guide their teams through complex work and capture what happens at every asset. That knowledge then turns into better decisions. Each visit makes the next one faster, safer and smarter.

We’re early in a big shift. Customers have known us as the tool that digitized their forms, and we’re becoming the platform that makes field work intelligent. Our Customer Success team guides customers through that change, and it’s a chance to help define a category while it’s still taking shape.

What you’ll do

  • Understand the business behind the work. Learn each customer’s field workflows, assets and goals well enough to see opportunities they haven’t spotted yet.
  • Drive adoption that changes outcomes. Bring the right capabilities into the right workflows and expand to new teams and sites. Help customers move from capturing data to acting on it.
  • Build customer self-sufficiency. Turn admins and builders into confident power users who can carry the platform forward and keep it running when people change roles.
  • Make the impact visible. Agree on success with each customer using metrics they already track, such as first-time fix rate, compliance or time to invoice. Measure progress and share it with their leadership in regular business reviews.
  • Make every conversation useful. Bring something to each one: a fix, an idea, an insight from their own data.
  • Find what’s next. Spot the next workflow, team or site where we can help, and work with your Account Manager to turn it into growth.
  • Build relationships across the organization, from engineers in the field to the operations leaders setting priorities.
  • Be the customer’s voice inside TrueContext. Bring what you learn back to Product and Engineering and help shape what we build next.
  • Solve problems hands-on. Know the product well enough to configure it and fix issues yourself. Bring in Support, Solutions or Product when the problem calls for it.
  • Partner with your Account Manager. You build the value story all year and they lead the commercial conversation. Together you share one account plan and catch risk early.
  • Raise the bar for the team. Mentor other CSMs, shape our playbooks, and help build how Customer Success works as we grow.

What success looks like

Your customers use more of the platform, in more parts of their business, and can point to results in their own numbers. They see you as part of their team. Renewals and growth follow from that work. You’ll be assessed on the customer value you deliver, measured through feature adoption, product utilization, and gross and net revenue retention.

Why you’ll love it here

You’ll join a company of about 100 people at a turning point, where your work is visible and your input changes what we build. You’ll work with customers whose work matters, on a platform that’s adding AI and intelligence to some of the most demanding jobs in the field.

What you bring

  • 4 - 6+ years in customer success or account management at a B2B software company, including ownership of enterprise accounts and their renewals.
  • A track record of results your customers could measure, and of strong relationships with the executives who decide.
  • Comfort with technology. You learn a configurable platform quickly and solve problems hands-on.
  • Experience with a CRM such as Salesforce.
  • Clear writing and speaking, for field teams and executives alike.

Nice to have:

  • Prior experience in software for field service, inspection, safety and compliance, utilities, energy or industrial operations.
  • ChurnZero, Gainsight or Gong.

Location

Remote US or Canada, with a preference of working Eastern or Central time zone hours

Some extra benefits

  • Company-wide & team social events
  • Yearly wellness allowance
  • Great time off benefits (3 weeks of vacation + 2 True2ME days + 1 TrueCrewCares day)
  • ½ day FriYAYs (from Victoria Day until Labour Day)

Ready to make an impact? Apply today.

raw.excerpt: AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home.
raw.description:
AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home. We enable better outcomes for patients and the healthcare organizations who support them. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.

Job Details


The Pharmacy Technician Lead serves as the subject matter expert of their designated pharmacy team. They will work alongside the Pharmacy Supervisors and Managers to drive and support department efficiencies. In this role, the expectation is to lead by example and support company and department goals as well as demonstrate their ability to drive results and achieve a consistent standard of work from the team.


Responsibilities


  • High level of contribution in front line, day to day work as assigned by leadership
  • Provide training on department tasks to new hires, cross trainees and existing team members requiring additional support
  • Help coordinate the completion of cross training through communication and scheduling with designated trainees
  • Provide a high level of subject matter expertise to the department in supporting continuous improvement projects including training guides and SOP development
  • Support leadership in diagnosing and improving performance of team members
  • Embody AnewHealth’s Core Values in all communications and interactions.
  • Other duties as assigned.

The above essential functions are representative of major duties of positions in this job classification. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary based upon departmental needs. Other duties may be assigned similar to the above consistent with knowledge, skills and abilities required for the job. Not all of the duties may be assigned to a position.


Qualifications: These represent the desired qualifications of the ideal candidate. They are not meant to limit consideration for candidates who do not meet all of the standards listed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Education


  • High school diploma /GED required.
  • Certified Technician with their home state’s Board of Pharmacy.

Experience


  • Proven experience in departmental workflows and processes
  • Highly preferred: Prior experience with ExactCare operational workflow and processes in assigned department.

Skills & Abilities


  • Strong attention to detail
  • Demonstrates strong time management and organizational abilities
  • Excellent verbal and non-verbal communication
  • High level understanding of adjudicating claims and overcoming rejections
  • Ability to adapt to different training outcomes
  • Uses strategic planning to develop training schedule/program that adheres to departments goals and expectations
  • Demonstrates ability to multi-task and support various aspects within Operations

Physical/Mental Demands: This position is administrative in nature and will present physical demands requisite to a position requiring: hearing, seeing, sitting, standing, talking, and walking. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. May be necessary to work extended hours as needed.


Schedule: This is a full-time position with an expectation to work an average of 40 hours per week and be available outside of normal business hours to meet customer expectations on an ad-hoc basis. Schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed.

Supervisory: Yes

This is a remote position.

AnewHealth offers a comprehensive benefit package for full-time employees that includes medical/dental/vision, flexible spending, company-paid life insurance and short-term disability as well as voluntary benefits, 401(k), Paid Time Off and paid holidays. Medical, dental and vision coverage are effective 1st of the month following date of hire.

AnewHealth provides equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status, or other legally protected classification in the state in which a person is seeking employment. Applicants are encouraged to confidentially self-identify when applying. Local applicants are encouraged to apply. We maintain a drug-free work environment. Applicants must be eligible to work in this country.

raw.description:
Are you highly organised, detail-focused and looking for a varied operational role within a regulated environment? We're seeking an Part Time Operations Support professional to help drive operational efficiency, support key business processes and deliver outstanding service to internal and external stakeholders.

You will provide essential operational and administrative support across the business, helping to ensure processes run smoothly and efficiently. Working closely with operational, finance and broking teams, you'll support debtor management, resolve insurer queries, produce management information and maintain operational controls and governance standards.

Please note: This is a part time opportunity working 17.5 ours per week, with flexibility around how these hours are spread across Monday-Friday.

What will you do as an Operations Support here?

  • Provide day-to-day operational and administrative support across the business

  • Monitor and assist with aged debt, collections activity and debtor reporting

  • Investigate and resolve insurer and stakeholder queries in a timely manner

  • Produce operational reports and management information

  • Maintain accurate records, documentation and data integrity

  • Support governance, compliance and audit activities

  • Build strong working relationships with insurers, customers and internal teams

  • Assist with process improvements and business change initiatives

  • Escalate operational risks, issues and concerns where appropriate


What are we looking for in our next Operations Support?

  • Experience in an operational support, administration or coordination role

  • Confidence managing multiple priorities and meeting deadlines

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills

  • Good analytical and problem-solving ability

  • Experience producing reports and working with data

  • Insurance, financial services or another regulated industry

  • Insurance broking experience

  • Debtor management, collections or financial administration

  • Governance, compliance or operational controls experience

  • Knowledge of FCA regulations and Consumer Duty requirements

In return you will be welcomed and supported by our Ardonagh family joining an organisation that cares about you as a person and your wellbeing. Some of the other benefits are:

  • Holiday entitlement of 26 days plus bank holidays, increasing with length of service

  • 35 hour working week

  • Opportunity to progress your career across the entire Ardonagh family

  • Award-winning learning & development offering and support to obtain professional qualifications to enhance your knowledge and career prospects

  • Pension scheme for when you feel it’s time to retire

  • 24-hour Employee Assistance support for you and your family’s physical and mental wellbeing

  • Corporate perks such as discounted gym memberships, cinema tickets, shopping, Eyecare vouchers, cycle to work and much more

  • One day paid volunteering to give back to our communities

  • Ardonagh Community Trust (ACT) - raising funds for charity with donation matching in your local community

  • The Spotlight Awards, where we celebrate the best of the Ardonagh Group and all the bright talent across our business.

We offer genuine potential for both personal and professional development, come and be part of our story and help us shape our future. So, what are you waiting for? Apply today and one of our team will be in touch.

#AIB INDX2

Everywhen is an equal opportunities employer, with a growing and thriving diversity, equity and inclusion strategy; we are committed to a working environment that is free from discrimination, is inclusive, and empowers our people to bring their whole self to work and reach their full potential.

If your application is successful, we will conduct relevant employment checks prior to you commencing employment with us. These will include verifying your recent employment, address, credit history and a standard criminal record check.

As an Everywhen colleague, you will be expected to uphold our values, act professionally and respectfully towards others, and contribute to a workplace where everyone is treated with dignity and respect. We expect all colleagues to help maintain an environment free from bullying, harassment, victimisation and other inappropriate behaviours, supporting our commitment to an inclusive and high-performing culture.

description: Reddit is a community of communities.  It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet.

raw.title: Principal Engineer, Security
raw.excerpt: Reddit is a community of communities.  It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet.
raw.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Reddit’s Platforms & Infrastructure organization builds and operates the compute, storage, data, and platform services behind Reddit. This organization partners across the company to help protect Reddit’s users, products, and systems.

We’re looking for a Principal Engineer to provide technical leadership across Reddit’s engineering organization. You’ll work with teams throughout the business to understand how systems and products work, identify security risks, and build practical solutions that fit the needs of the company. This is a broad, hands-on role that combines software and systems engineering, architecture, consulting, and mentorship.

Security at Reddit is a collaborative effort. You’ll help teams make informed tradeoffs, document decisions, and build security into their work without creating unnecessary friction. You’ll also help the Security team grow its impact by sharing knowledge and developing future technical leaders.

What you’ll do:

  • Guide security architecture and technical direction across product, infrastructure, IT, and product engineering teams.
  • Design and deliver security systems and improvements, including work in areas such as access control, cloud and Kubernetes security, identity and access management, observability, and CI/CD.
  • Partner with teams on design reviews and threat modeling, helping them understand risks and choose appropriate mitigations.
  • Lead complex security projects, from planning and technical design through implementation, migration, and operations.
  • Provide practical security guidance on product features, service architecture, and engineering workflows.
  • Improve security processes, documentation, runbooks, dashboards, and incident response practices.
  • Help teams assess and communicate security risks, tradeoffs, and compliance needs.
  • Mentor engineers and security practitioners through reviews, pairing, training, and technical leadership.
  • Build connections across the organization so security work reflects how Reddit’s systems and business operate.

Who you might be:

  • An experienced security or software engineer who has led technical work across a large, complex organization.
  • Skilled at securing systems across multiple domains, such as cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, web applications, identity and access management, or CI/CD.
  • Comfortable writing and reviewing software, and able to understand systems deeply enough to offer useful, specific security guidance.
  • Experienced with architecture reviews, threat modeling, security design, and communicating decisions in clear technical documents.
  • Effective at leading complex projects that involve multiple teams, competing priorities, and real-world constraints.
  • Pragmatic and collaborative: you can explain risk, find workable paths forward, and make sound decisions within an organization’s risk tolerance.
  • A strong mentor who helps others develop security judgment and technical independence.
  • An excellent communicator who can build trust with engineers and cross-functional partners.

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit .

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

The base salary range for this position is:
$268,700—$401,100 USD

In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.

Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

description: Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency.

raw.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
raw.excerpt: Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency.
raw.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Tenstorrent is hiring a Senior Application Security Engineer to lead AppSec enablement, policy automation, software supply-chain integrity, and vulnerability triage across more than 3,100 GitHub and GitLab repositories. Reporting to the Head of Information Security, you will move our program from audit-only visibility to low-friction inline prevention, partnering with engineering teams, departmental AppSec champions, DevInfra, and our Open Source Program Office. You will scale your impact through tooling, policy-as-code, and AI, and serve as technical lead for Bug Bounty and external vulnerability triage.

This role is remote, based out of the United States or Canada.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

  • A hands-on AppSec builder who measures success in real risk reduction and developer velocity.
  • AI-native: you use Cursor, Claude Code, and MCP tools to triage findings at scale and write reusable security skills for the engineering org.
  • Broadly grounded in how web/API apps, microservices, containers, CI/CD pipelines, and AI agent systems work and fail.
  • A sharp triage lead who separates real exploitability from scanner noise and drives fixes to closure with engineering owners.

What We Need

  • Deep experience running ASPM and developer security tooling (such as Cycode, Snyk, Semgrep, or GitHub Advanced Security) across SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, and container scanning.
  • A track record moving large engineering orgs from report-only to PR/MR merge-blocking in GitHub Actions and GitLab CI without false-positive gridlock.
  • Programming skills (Python, TypeScript, or Go) and experience using AI tools and MCP servers to automate triage and reporting.
  • Ability to reproduce and guide fixes for vulnerabilities such as SSRF, BOLA, auth bypass, injection, and dependency compromises.
  • Experience with software supply-chain security (SBOMs, dependency hygiene, container registries) and leading Bug Bounty triage.

What You Will Learn

  • How to own enterprise-wide AppSec tooling across 3,100+ repositories alongside embedded champions in AI Software, Cloud, DevInfra, and RISC-V.
  • How to launch and run the technical triage engine for Tenstorrent's Bug Bounty Program.
  • How to build centralized security skills and guardrails so engineers and AI coding agents write secure code from the first commit.
  • How to mature automated SBOM exports and cryptographic release signing across our software ecosystem.

Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made.

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology. Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2). These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S. As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency. TraceGains, a business unit of Esko—a Veralto company headquartered in Belgium—connects people and information so teams can work smarter. As a global technology company, we provide networked innovation, quality, and compliance solutions to consumer brands that want to reduce supply chain risk, speed up business processes, and take control of data.

At TraceGains, we believe “we’re in this together,” and our goal is to provide the most innovative solutions in the industry. We are in the game to change the industry, and with the help of our ever-growing TraceGains Network, we have created the CPG industry’s first networked ingredients marketplace. We also know that innovation and ingenuity start with prioritizing a diverse workforce and a deeply inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions. Learn more about us here:

Reporting to the Senior Product Insights & Design Manager, the European Product & Compliance Lead will help TraceGains understand customer needs and regulatory requirements, and where our product teams should focus their efforts. It’s an opportunity to bring your food and beverage industry experience directly into product and commercial decisions, working with customers and colleagues to help address real challenges in the European market. This is a remote role based in the UK, Ireland, Germany or Switzerland, with flexibility to travel when required.


In this role, a typical day will look like:

  • Monitor European and UK regulations, retailer standards and cross-border requirements, and explain what they mean for customers and TraceGains.
  • Gather customer feedback, sales insight and market evidence to recommend product and commercial priorities for Europe.
  • Work with Product Managers to test assumptions, clarify customer problems and influence roadmap decisions.
  • Meet customers, run working groups and join site visits or industry events to understand and validate their needs.
  • Support Sales and Marketing as TraceGains’ European food safety, quality and regulatory expert, including customer conversations, webinars and content.
  • Track the competitive landscape and share relevant insights across the business.

Travel: This is a remote role ideally based out of the UK, Ireland, Germany or Switzerland. Travel across the region will be needed for industry events, customer meetings and site visits, with dates arranged flexibly around business and customer needs.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Willingness to support our sales teams at events and wider Product strategy team initiatives across TraceGains traveling or being away from home between 15–30 days per year.
  • Professional experience in the food and beverage supply chain, ideally in food safety, quality or regulatory work for a brand or manufacturer. Relevant retail or consulting experience will also be considered.
  • Working knowledge of UK and EU food safety, quality, regulatory or retailer requirements.
  • Experience working in or with an enterprise SaaS business, preferably B2B or B2B2C.
  • Experience using customer feedback, sales input, market evidence or business data to inform product priorities or go-to-market decisions.

TraceGains is proud to be part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods.

When you join Veralto’s global network of 17,000 associates, you enter a culture where purpose meets possibility—where your work has a real-world impact, and your career has room to grow. Together, we’re safeguarding the world’s most vital resources—and building meaningful careers along the way.


At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve.Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Account Director I, Public Sector (SLED) Strategic Accounts

This Account Director II role is responsible for developing and executing comprehensive sales strategies across an assigned portfolio of high value public sector accounts. This role focuses on building executive relationships, expanding strategic partnerships, identifying new business opportunities, protecting existing revenue, and driving sustainable account growth.

Success requires a consultative sales approach, strong business acumen, an understanding of public sector customer priorities, and the ability to coordinate internal resources to deliver complex technology solutions that support customer objectives.

The Main Responsibilities

Strategic Account Planning: Develop and execute comprehensive account strategies aligned with customer priorities, business objectives, technology roadmaps, and long term growth opportunities.

Executive Relationship Management: Establish and maintain trusted relationships with senior customer executives, key decision makers, and strategic stakeholders to strengthen partnerships and position Lumen as a trusted technology advisor.

Revenue Growth and Retention: Drive revenue growth through strategic account expansion, new solution adoption, competitive displacement, contract renewals, and identification of additional business opportunities.

Complex Opportunity Development: Identify, qualify, and advance large, complex sales opportunities through proactive customer engagement, strategic pursuit planning, and effective sales execution.

Cross Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales Engineering, Capture, Business Development, Customer Success, Marketing, Legal, and executive leadership to develop coordinated account strategies and deliver integrated customer solutions.

Public Sector Procurement: Demonstrate experience navigating complex public sector procurement processes, including competitive solicitations, RFPs, contract negotiations, and government purchasing requirements. Understand and leverage applicable procurement vehicles, including state contracts, cooperative purchasing agreements, and other established government purchasing frameworks.

Customer Advocacy: Serve as a strategic customer advocate, aligning Lumen capabilities with customer business challenges, modernization initiatives, and long term technology objectives.

Market and Competitive Intelligence: Maintain awareness of public sector market trends, customer funding priorities, competitive threats, emerging technologies, and industry developments to identify opportunities and strengthen account positioning.

Pipeline and Forecast Management: Maintain accurate sales forecasts, strategic account plans, and opportunity pipelines while consistently delivering against established sales and revenue objectives.

5+ years of enterprise or public sector technology sales experience.

Demonstrated success managing complex customer relationships and achieving sales and revenue objectives.

Experience developing and executing strategic account plans.

Strong understanding of consultative selling methodologies and complex sales cycles.

Demonstrated ability to build relationships with senior executives and key decision makers.

Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing large, complex State, Local Government, and Education (SLED) accounts.

Established relationships with senior public sector decision makers and executive stakeholders.

Demonstrated success developing and closing large, complex technology opportunities.

Experience coordinating multiple internal and external stakeholders throughout extended sales cycles.

Knowledge of networking, cloud, cybersecurity, managed services, and emerging technology solutions.

Strong understanding of the telecommunications industry's competitive landscape.

Experience using Salesforce for strategic account planning, opportunity management, and forecasting.

Demonstrated ability to independently manage priorities, develop strategic relationships, and deliver measurable business results.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Ability to travel regularly to engage customers, develop relationships, and support strategic sales activities.
