raw.excerpt: Overview DecisionPoint seeks a Data Product Delivery Manager to prioritize the data analysis and business intelligence product backlog supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Data Product Delivery Manager to prioritize the data analysis and business intelligence product backlog supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This SME-level position will work with Government mission owners, users, and technical teams to translate operational needs into clear product requirements, backlog priorities, and measurable acceptance criteria. The manager will coordinate requirements for data ingestion, governance, warehouse capabilities, dashboards, and self-service reporting. The Data Product Delivery Manager will connect mission priorities with technical delivery, helping teams understand the intended value, dependencies, and acceptance expectations for each data product. The role will collaborate with data engineers, database personnel, governance specialists, BI developers, testers, and program leadership throughout planning, development, validation, and release.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Data Product Delivery Manager will:

  • Maintain and prioritize the data analysis and BI product backlog in coordination with Government stakeholders.
  • Gather and clarify user needs, operational challenges, reporting requirements, and desired outcomes.
  • Translate mission needs into product features, user stories, business rules, and measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Refine backlog items so delivery teams understand scope, dependencies, data needs, and completion expectations.
  • Coordinate priorities for data ingestion, data governance, warehouse capabilities, dashboards, and self-service reporting.
  • Recommend sequencing based on mission value, urgency, technical readiness, dependencies, and available capacity.
  • Facilitate backlog refinement, planning discussions, product demonstrations, and stakeholder reviews.
  • Coordinate with governance personnel on ownership, definitions, authoritative sources, access decisions, and approved uses.
  • Work with data engineers and database teams to clarify ingestion, transformation, integration, and warehouse requirements.
  • Work with BI teams to define reporting behavior, calculations, filters, visualizations, and self-service capabilities.
  • Maintain traceability among user needs, backlog items, acceptance criteria, test results, and delivered functionality.
  • Support acceptance testing by clarifying expected outcomes, resolving requirements questions, and documenting stakeholder feedback.
  • Track dependencies, impediments, risks, scope changes, and decisions affecting product delivery.
  • Coordinate release readiness and communicate delivered capabilities, limitations, and outstanding issues.
  • Collect user feedback and assess whether delivered products meet mission needs.
  • Maintain product documentation, decision records, backlog status, and delivery briefings.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

The following must-have qualifications are drawn from the supplied position requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, data analytics, or a related field.
  • Ability to prioritize a data analysis and BI product backlog.
  • Ability to clarify user needs and define measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Ability to coordinate requirements for data ingestion, governance, warehouse capabilities, dashboards, and self-service reporting.

***Application Deadline: December 4th, 2026 12 pm EST***

Job Description:

Summary: The Senior Manager, Development provides day-to-day leadership and operational oversight for Farm Sanctuary’s Development team, ensuring fundraising priorities are translated into coordinated, effective execution. Reporting to the department leader, this role manages and develops team members, leads departmental planning and prioritization, strengthens systems and workflows, and directly executes key Development work that requires senior-level judgment, coordination, or follow-through. The Senior Manager serves as the primary leader for the team’s day-to-day management, accountability, and operational effectiveness, while partnering closely with the department leader on Development strategy, specialized staff growth, and broader revenue-generating priorities.

Responsibilities:

People Management & Team Development

  • Lead the day-to-day management of the Development team, establishing clear priorities, expectations, ownership, and accountability across individual roles and team initiatives.
  • Supervise, coach, and develop Development team members, including managers and senior-level staff, through regular feedback, performance management, goal setting, professional development, and ongoing support.
  • Build team capability and ownership by delegating effectively, strengthening decision-making at the appropriate level, and helping employees develop the judgment and skills needed to operate with greater autonomy.
  • Partner with the department leader and People & Culture on workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, role clarity, and other people-management needs.

Development Operations and Execution

  • Lead departmental planning and prioritization, translating Development strategy and annual goals into clear workplans, timelines, ownership, and measurable deliverables.
  • Oversee and directly support Development projects, workflows, and priority initiatives to ensure work moves effectively from planning through completion, including coordinating follow-up, documentation, approvals, calls, and other operational needs.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve departmental systems, processes, meeting rhythms, and workflows that strengthen coordination, efficiency, accountability, and visibility across the team.
  • Serve as a key operational point person for internal and external partners, taking direct ownership of work that requires senior-level judgment, coordination, or follow-through and does not appropriately sit within another team member’s portfolio.
  • Identify operational barriers, capacity constraints, competing priorities, and execution risks; resolve issues within the role’s authority, redistribute work when appropriate, and elevate strategic or resource decisions as needed.

Fundraising Campaign and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Provide operational leadership for Development-led fundraising campaigns and donor engagement initiatives, coordinating timelines, responsibilities, deliverables, and internal stakeholders to support effective execution.
  • Partner closely with Communications, Marketing, Programs, Finance, Technology, and other teams to coordinate Development initiatives, clarify dependencies and decision rights, and ensure fundraising work is integrated with broader organizational priorities.
  • Support effective use of Development data, reporting, and performance measures to monitor progress, identify opportunities for improvement, and inform departmental planning and resource allocation.

Departmental Leadership

  • Serve as a senior leader and thought partner to the department leader, contributing operational insight, team perspectives, and recommendations related to departmental priorities, capacity, systems, and organizational needs.
  • Represent Development in appropriate cross-functional projects and working groups and provide departmental leadership when delegated by the department leader.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of progressively responsible professional experience in nonprofit development, fundraising operations, advancement, project/program management, or a related field, including substantial experience leading teams and complex initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience supervising and developing employees, including managers or experienced professionals, and managing performance, accountability, and professional growth.
  • Strong understanding of nonprofit fundraising operations and donor engagement, with experience supporting multiple fundraising channels such as major gifts, annual giving, institutional giving, planned giving, direct response, campaigns, or donor stewardship.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into operational plans, establish priorities, manage multiple complex projects, and drive work through completion.
  • Strong systems and process orientation, with experience improving workflows, clarifying ownership, and creating structures that increase organizational effectiveness.
  • Strong judgment and decision-making skills, including the ability to determine when to act independently, involve stakeholders, or escalate issues.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and collaborate effectively across teams, functions, and levels of an organization.
  • Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, facilitation, and organizational skills.
  • Comfort working in a dynamic, mission-driven environment with competing priorities and evolving organizational needs.
  • Alignment with Farm Sanctuary’s values of compassion, understanding, integrity, transformation, and freedom.
  • Familiarity, commitment to, and experience with the practice of equity and social justice, and the principles embedded in Farm Sanctuary’s mission
  • To ensure optimal performance of our remote technology, internet connections are required for all remote positions and are not supplied by the organization.

Essential Physical Requirements:

  • Sedentary to light work. Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally with prolonged periods of sitting in a stationary position. Must be able to perform repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to communicate with others to exchange information by means of the spoken word via telephone, video conferencing and other forms of electronic communication utilizing computers and smartphones.
  • Worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal. Must be able to perceive the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction.
  • Position is subject to environmental conditions. Must be able to perform activities inside and outside when onsite with remaining work performed in a remote home office.

We embrace candidates from a range of backgrounds and experiences, regardless of whether they satisfy all the specified requirements. We encourage you to apply, even if you have an unconventional or non-traditional background.

Job Specifications:

  • Terms of employment: Regular, Full-time, exempt position
  • Reports to: Director, Donor Engagement and Strategic Marketing
  • Direct reports: Senior Specialist, Leadership Giving. Manager Direct Marketing.
  • Pay: $83,000-88,000
  • Location: Remote, U.S
  • Travel: Occasional regional travel required
  • Benefits: Competitive benefits package, including 13 paid holidays; generous paid time off; health, dental, vision, and life insurance; 403(b) plan; flexible spending accounts; long-term disability insurance; free access to the CALM meditation app; and access to the Nivati wellness platform

Farm Sanctuary is committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where all employees are respected, valued, and feel a sense of belonging. We work hard to provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type. We take our duty seriously to protect employees with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

We believe that our prioritization of diversity, equity, and inclusion is a strength and essential to achieving our mission. A diverse workforce brings many perspectives, ideas, and experiences, leading to more creative and effective solutions to our complex issues. By embracing diversity and creating an inclusive environment, we foster a culture of belonging where innovation and growth can thrive. We are dedicated to promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of our organization, including hiring and recruitment practices, employee development and training, and interactions with the communities we serve. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion are core components in fulfilling our mission of rescuing and protecting farmed animals from cruelty, and we are committed to creating a culture of respect, civility, and compassion for all.

raw.description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit . Come join us.

About the Role

AlphaSense is looking for a Principal, Life Sciences Solutions Marketing to lead our go-to-market strategy for the Life Sciences industry, spanning pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and the broader healthcare ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines deep industry expertise with strong commercial instincts. We're looking for someone who understands how life sciences organizations make critical decisions, from evaluating drug pipelines and clinical developments to identifying licensing opportunities and shaping commercial strategy.

You'll translate that expertise into differentiated positioning, compelling AI-powered workflows, and go-to-market strategies that help AlphaSense win in the market.

Working closely with leaders across Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success, you'll connect customer needs with our technology and commercial priorities. This role combines strategic ownership with direct customer engagement and hands-on execution.

Who You Are:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience, including direct experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry, combined with a background in solutions marketing, product marketing, go-to-market strategy, or management consulting.

  • Deep understanding of Life Sciences business processes and decision-making, including clinical development, business development and licensing, portfolio strategy, or commercial planning.

  • Proven experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies that contribute to pipeline generation, customer acquisition, and revenue growth.

  • Hands-on experience applying AI tools to research, market analysis, or complex business workflows.

  • Ability to engage credibly with senior industry executives and translate complex challenges into compelling business solutions.

  • Strong communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across Sales, Product, and Marketing.

  • Strong analytical and commercial judgment, with the ability to prioritize opportunities and make informed strategic decisions.

  • Ability to operate independently, influence without authority, and balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in pharmaceutical, medtech, or biotechnology strategy, business development, licensing, or commercial operations.

  • Background in life sciences consulting or enterprise technology serving pharmaceutical and biotechnology customers.

  • Experience with market intelligence, scientific research platforms, or enterprise AI solutions.

  • Experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles and strategic customer relationships.

What You'll Do:

Life Sciences Strategy & Go-to-Market

  • Own AlphaSense's Life Sciences solutions marketing strategy, identifying priority market segments, buyer personas, and growth opportunities across pharmaceutical, medtech, and biotechnology companies.

  • Develop differentiated industry positioning, messaging, and value propositions grounded in customer needs and market dynamics.

  • Partner with Sales and Demand Generation to shape integrated campaigns, strategic account plays, and programs that drive pipeline generation and revenue growth.

  • Engage directly with senior customers and prospects to uncover industry challenges, validate opportunities, and support strategic deals.

Solutions, Workflows & Product Innovation

  • Define and bring to market high-value Life Sciences workflows powered by AlphaSense's AI and research capabilities.

  • Develop compelling customer use cases spanning clinical trial monitoring, asset evaluation, business development and licensing, portfolio strategy, and commercial planning.

  • Translate complex research and analytical processes into practical demonstrations, solution narratives, and sales plays that help customers understand the value of AlphaSense.

  • Partner with Product Management to influence industry-specific capabilities, product priorities, and roadmap investments.

Industry Leadership & Commercial Impact

  • Serve as AlphaSense's Life Sciences subject matter expert, providing industry expertise and guidance to Sales, Customer Success, and internal stakeholders.

  • Represent AlphaSense at industry conferences, executive roundtables, webinars, and customer events, establishing credibility and thought leadership in AI-powered research.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional leadership to align industry initiatives with broader business priorities.

  • Measure the effectiveness of Life Sciences initiatives through pipeline contribution, sales adoption, customer engagement, and commercial outcomes.

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.

Base Compensation Range
$157,000—$216,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

raw.description:
About Figure

We’reFigure (Nasdaq: FIGR), and we’re building the future of capital markets with blockchain and AI. We make lending faster and cheaper for everyone by automating the origination process and using blockchain as the source of truth for loan ownership and connection to our capital marketplace.

It’s all one ecosystem that spans three lines of business:

  • Lending: HELOCs, cash-out refinance, DSCR loans, and crypto-backed loans for homeowners, investors, and small businesses. Through Kiavi, a Figure company, we also finance real estate investors with bridge, fix-and-flip, rental, and new construction loans.
  • Markets: On Figure Markets, people can lend and earn with Prime and $YLDS, an SEC-registered, interest-bearing security that settles like cash. OPEN is our blockchain infrastructure for issuing, distributing, and trading equities.
  • Partnerships: Banks, credit unions, fintechs, home improvement companies, and other lenders and brokers originate loans on our platform. DART records loan ownership on blockchain, and Figure Connect connects originators with institutional loan buyers.

See all of our products on figure.com.

Here’s where we are today:

  • $35B+ in equity unlocked for homeowners on Figure’s platform
  • 382K+ households served
  • 800+ B2B partners, including banks, credit unions, and fintechs
  • AAA-rated HELOC securitizations from S&P, KBRA, and Moody’s
  • $23B+ funded for real estate investors through Kiavi since 2013
  • Recognized by CNBC (World’s Top Fintech Companies 2026), Fortune (Crypto 100, 2026), and Inc. (2026 Inc. 5000)

If you want to help build the next era of lending, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager, Integrations and New Verticals to join our growing team! As Senior Product Manager, Integrations and New Verticals, you’ll own the third-party integrations that power Figure’s mortgage and lending products and drive the product roadmap for a set of emerging HELOC growth channels. Integrations run through every step of our HELOC funnel and loan origination system (LOS): property and public record data, collateral valuation, credit, income and identity verification, document generation and eSign, notarization, and recording. Each one shapes how quickly a borrower gets an offer, how confidently we underwrite, and how smoothly a loan officer or partner gets a loan to funding. You’ll own the full lifecycle of these integrations, from improving the vendors we have and onboarding new ones to holding vendors accountable to the quality and SLAs our borrowers and partners depend on. You’ll build the monitoring that makes integration health visible across the company and use funnel, conversion, and quality data to decide where the next investment goes. This is a hands-on role: you write the requirements, run the vendor calls, and stay close to the details. You’ll also own the core product roadmap for new HELOC growth channels like SMB brokers, select fintech partnerships, and home improvement and solar contractors, early, high-upside channels where the product and partner workflow are still being defined.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for all third-party integrations across Figure’s mortgage and lending products, including data integrations, integrations that feed credit and underwriting workflows, and the vendor services behind each stage of the HELOC funnel (property data, valuation, credit, income and identity verification, document generation, notarization, recording, and debt payoff)
  • Drive a prioritized roadmap of improvements to existing vendor integrations, measured by funnel conversion, borrower and loan officer engagement, underwriting quality, and LOS usability
  • Evaluate, select, and onboard new vendors that improve HELOC and LOS functionality or unlock new capabilities, from due diligence through contracting, build, QA, and launch, with Engineering, Credit, Compliance, Legal, and Operations
  • Navigate the trade-offs that make or break an integration, including data quality and coverage, latency, cost, security, compliance, redundancy, and cross-team dependencies
  • Build and maintain dashboards that monitor integration health and vendor performance against contracted quality and SLA commitments, surface issues early, and drive resolution
  • Hold vendors accountable when they breach SLAs or fall short of borrower and partner needs, and own escalations, remediation plans, and renewal and replacement decisions with Legal and Finance
  • Own the core product roadmap for emerging HELOC verticals and GTM channels (SMB brokers, select fintech partnerships, and home improvement and solar contractors), defining the partner workflow, product experience, and integration surface each needs to scale
  • Synthesize feedback from borrowers, loan officers, partners, Operations, and Support into clear priorities: what problem to solve, for whom, and why it matters
  • Drive feature development end to end: write requirements, partner with Engineering, GTM, Design, and other cross-functional stakeholders, launch, analyze results, and iterate

What We Look For

  • 7+ years of experience as a Product Manager
  • Fintech, lending, or mortgage experience (preferred)
  • Experience shipping and owning third-party integrations, such as vendor APIs, data providers, embedded partner services, or platform integrations
  • Strong understanding of APIs, data contracts, and failure modes, enough to hold peer-level conversations with Engineering and vendor technical teams
  • Track record of managing vendor relationships with commercial rigor: evaluating options, negotiating scope and SLAs, measuring performance, and making renewal or replacement calls
  • Experience defining monitoring, KPIs, and SLA frameworks for operational systems, and using that data to drive prioritization and accountability
  • Active use of AI tools in your own work, with a point of view on how automation, insights, and agents should show up in integration and verification workflows
  • Proven ability to operate with speed and ownership in fast-moving environments, driving clarity and execution without heavy process
  • Energized by external-facing work with vendors and channel partners
  • Strong analytical and structured thinking, with comfort evaluating trade-offs across cost, quality, speed, and compliance
  • Highly collaborative and low-ego, working seamlessly with Engineering, Design, Data, Credit, Compliance, Operations, GTM, and executive stakeholders to turn ideas into an end product
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and excitement about defining the product and partner model for new channels at the intersection of mortgage lending and fintech
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures
  • Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes
  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team

Salary

  • Base Compensation Range: $154,000 - $190,000/yr
  • 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly
  • Company equity in the form of RSUs

This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans
  • Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits
  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance
  • 11 observed holidays and PTO plan
  • Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave
  • Continuing education reimbursement

Depending on your residential location certain laws might regulate the way Figure manages applicant data. California Residents, please review our California Employee and General Workforce Privacy Notice for further information. By submitting your application, you are agreeing and acknowledging that you have read and understand the above notice.

Figure will not sponsor work visas for this position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

At Broadvoice, we believe that exceptional customer experience is the cornerstone of business success. Our AI-powered contact center and communications solutions are designed to help mid-market businesses simplify service, enhance satisfaction, and swiftly resolve issues.

Our holistic approach to CX sets us apart in the market. We don’t just provide software. We offer a proven CX framework backed by hands-on support. And our platform was built to be easy to deploy, intuitive to use, and scalable without chaos.

Every role in our company contributes to our mission of providing and creating exceptional experiences. Whether you’re in product, sales, support, marketing, or operations, your work directly impacts our customers and, by extension, their customers. Collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to excellence define our culture.

POSITION SUMMARY

Broadvoice is seeking a Technical Support Specialist with strong technical support experience to assist customers on our CCaaS and UCaaS platforms and services. In this technical, customer‑facing role, you will work directly with business clients via phone, chat, and email to resolve complex issues—particularly those related to call flow, SIP signaling, VoIP monitoring, call‑quality performance, and cross‑functional collaboration with Tier II and Advanced Troubleshooting teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a Broadvoice brand ambassador by demonstrating our core values and delivering exceptional customer support.
  • Provide high‑quality customer experience on technical support through phone, email, and chat.
  • Research, diagnose, and resolve technical issues involving SIP signaling, VoIP monitoring, and call logs in VoIP/SIP trunking for our UCaaS and CCaaS products.
  • Accurately document and track issues using internal ticketing systems.
  • Collaborate with Tier II and ATS teams on escalations, feature requests, and bug reports.
  • Contribute to the creation and improvement of customer support documentation.
  • Work closely with peers and leadership to resolve platform and service failures.
  • Continually expand technical knowledge through training, manuals, and hands‑on experience.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Passion in supporting customers through inbound call assistance.
  • Experience in customer-facing tech support or technical troubleshooting.
  • Recent call center background with high-volume inbound calls.
  • Strong customer service mindset and professionalism.
  • Fluent, clear, and confident English communication.
  • Familiarity with VoIP systems (preferred).
  • Effective time-management and multitasking abilities.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment.
  • Demonstrated longevity and stability in previous roles.
  • Flexible schedule and willingness to adapt to business needs.

WHY BROADVOICE

We're not just building communication tools, we're creating the future of connection. And we need people who want to build it with us.

Own Your Growth
No cookie-cutter career paths here. Sharpen your technical edge, step into leadership, or chart a course you haven't even mapped yet. You'll get real mentorship, real resources, and the autonomy to own your outcomes.

Work on Your Terms
Remote-first isn't a perk we bolted on, it's how we operate. We trust you to deliver, wherever you do your best work.

A Team Built Different
Diverse. Inclusive. Real. This is a culture that invests in people, not just performance metrics. You'll be surrounded by people who've got your back and push you to do better work.

Impact You Can Point To
Your ideas won't get lost in the shuffle. You'll have the backing of a product that competes well, and a direct hand in transforming Broadvoice into a CX powerhouse in the channel.

Are you ready to join a passionate and talented team to build the future of Broadvoice?

If you’re a strategic thinker, a collaborative, and have a talent for driving impactful results, we’d love to meet you! Apply now to become part of a forward-thinking company that’s growing and empowering its people across all roles and departments.

ABOUT LIFEGUIDES

“More Casual Than Therapy, More Qualified Than a Friend”

More than a brand, we are a MOVEMENT. Our mission is to grow a community for sharing life experience and empathy, which impacts 1B lives in 15 years.

OUR PROMISE TO YOU

At LifeGuides, we believe it’s our responsibility to provide our Guides with the same level of compassion and care that we provide to our clients and their employees.

First and foremost, you will be surrounded by people who share common values:

C – put Community above self

L – lead with Love

E – Elevate humanity

A – Accountable to excellence through trust

R – build Resilience as we grow.

We will support you from the time you're onboarded and through continuous training.

Although experimentation and change are constant at LifeGuides, we will seek your input to strengthen our Guide Community and better support our members. We ask you to be patient and embrace change as it comes.

We will provide a fun, team-oriented, judgment-free environment where we can all learn from and support one another.

  • You are an example and inspiration to people who are on their own journey through the full spectrum of life, from challenges to thriving.

  • Join a growing movement, creating greater connection & caring in our society.

About Us

Casechek helps hospitals and health systems manage the vendor-managed surgical supply chain. Our platform connects clinical, supply chain, and financial workflows to improve visibility, automate transactions, and give hospitals greater control over implant spend.

We’re a highly collaborative team of self-motivated people who also thrive working independently. We believe great ideas aren’t created in isolation, so we work closely with our healthcare customers to understand their needs and deliver the best possible experience.

  • Hybrid by design: We’re based in Chicago’s Fulton Market, with team members working both remotely and in person.
  • Driven by the mission: We’re passionate about using new technology to solve some of healthcare’s messiest problems.
  • Curious and diverse: We value diverse perspectives, curiosity, and a love of learning. Our team includes plenty of advanced degrees and even a few professional musicians.
  • In it for the long haul: Transforming the implant supply chain is a marathon, not a sprint. We support each other’s long-term growth and invest in building transferable skills.

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Market Development Representative (MDR) to build relationships with healthcare decision-makers and generate qualified sales opportunities. As part of our marketing team, you'll work closely with sales to turn prospect outreach and marketing campaigns into pipeline.

We want someone who enjoys prospecting and is interested in building a professional network and presence in the healthcare industry. Your primary responsibility is generating pipeline; your network and market knowledge will help you do it.

What You'll Do

Create Conversations & Generate Pipeline

Partner with Marketing & Sales to Drive Growth

  • Follow up on account-based campaigns, webinars, and industry events.
  • Test outreach messages and share what works with the marketing team.
  • Bring prospect feedback and market insights into campaign planning.
  • Track outreach, meetings, and opportunity conversion in Salesforce.

Build Your Network & Market Presence

  • Develop relationships with healthcare supply chain, perioperative, and finance leaders.
  • Build a professional LinkedIn presence by sharing relevant industry news and joining discussions.
  • Use industry events and existing relationships to connect with new prospects.
  • Help increase Casechek's visibility with priority accounts.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience prospecting, engaging decision-makers, and generating qualified opportunities.
  • Strong writing, listening, and communication skills.

  • Interest in using LinkedIn to develop professional relationships.
  • Ability to learn complex products and understand customers' business challenges.
  • Experience with Salesforce or another CRM and sales engagement tools.
  • A track record of taking ownership of goals and following through.

Preferred Experience

  • Account-based marketing, social selling, or professional community building.
  • Creating business-related content or developing an industry network.

  • Brand-New Pro-Level Laptop – Equipped with top-tier tools and technology to set you up for success from day one.

This opportunity resides with All-Domain Operations (ADO), a business group within HII’s Mission Technologies division. All-Domain Operations comprises multi-domain operations, platforms and logistics, and intelligence operations.

HII designs, develops, integrates and manages the sensors, systems and other assets necessary to support integrated ISR operations and accelerated decision-making. With data fusion and mission management capabilities for the Department of Defense, the combatant commands and the intelligence community, HII advances the mission around the globe.

Leadership at HII – Mission Technologies
HII’s Leadership Capability Framework defines the standard of excellence expected of all leaders across Mission Technologies. Leaders are accountable for modeling these capabilities and building them within their teams:

  • Know & Grow Your People – Develop talent, empower teams, and build an inclusive environment.
  • Build Relationships – Strengthen trust, collaboration, and cross-functional partnerships.
  • Take Ownership – Drive accountability, execution excellence, and results.
  • Customer First – Anticipate mission needs and deliver value to our partners.
  • Shape the Future – Inspire innovation and align work with strategic priorities.
  • Act with Urgency – Make informed decisions and move with purpose.

These capabilities define how leaders inspire teams, deliver results, and shape the future of Mission Technologies.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Program Manager at the Director level to lead a complex, multi‑site global program focused on material acquisition, fielding, operations, and sustainment for mission-critical systems supporting the Intelligence Community (IC). This high‑impact role oversees a portfolio valued at approximately $100M annually, requiring deep expertise in large‑scale program management, operational deployment, and cross-functional leadership.

The Director will drive program strategy, execution, and performance across distributed operations, ensuring that cost, schedule, and mission delivery commitments are met in support of national security objectives.

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Lead all aspects of a major global acquisition and fielding program, from planning through deployment and sustainment.
  • Manage program performance across cost, schedule, technical requirements, and risk.
  • Direct day‑to‑day execution of multi-disciplinary teams including engineering, logistics, operations, and supply chain.
  • Oversee international and domestic fielding activities and ensure readiness for operational deployment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with Intelligence Community customers, mission partners, and subcontractors.
  • Develop and manage program budgets, forecasts, and financial performance for a $100M annual program.
  • Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, quality standards, and security requirements.
  • Identify and drive opportunities for program expansion, modernization, and improved mission effectiveness.
  • Lead proposal development, support capture efforts, and contribute to long-term business strategy.

  • PMP certification.
  • 15+ years of experience leading large, complex programs within defense or intelligence environments.
  • Direct experience managing programs valued at $100M or more annually.
  • Experience supporting the Intelligence Community, DoD, USSOCOM, or similar organizations.
  • Proven ability to lead large, geographically dispersed teams in execution of acquisition, fielding, and operational programs.
  • Strong financial management skills including forecasting, budget development, and performance tracking.
  • Ability to travel globally as mission requirements dictate.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen.

Preferred: Bonus Points For...

  • Master's degree in engineering, science, mathematics, or related technical discipline.
  • Defense Acquisition University Level III (or equivalent) certification.
  • Experience in satellite communications, EW, ISR, or special operations systems.
  • Demonstrated success in leading multi-phase development and production efforts.
  • Experience with international deployment and sustainment operations.

Our team of more than 7,000 professionals worldwide delivers all-domain expertise and advanced technologies in service of mission partners across the globe. Mission Technologies is leading the next evolution of national defense – the data evolution - by accelerating a breadth of national security solutions for government and commercial customers. Our capabilities range from C5ISR, AI and Big Data, cyber operations and synthetic training environments to fleet sustainment, environmental remediation and the largest family of unmanned underwater vehicles in every class. The Senior Colleague Relations Advisor acts as the named Colleague Relations (CR) person for their respective business area. They are responsible for providing commercial people advice to colleagues across the group in accordance with Company policies, with full autonomy and limited direction.

Key Responsibilities

ER Case Management

  • Manage a varied ER caseload of the most complex and higher-level cases, offering clear, practical and legally compliant advice and support to Operations / Senior Leadership teams.

  • Manage end-to-end Employment Tribunal and Settlement matters, liaising with external legal stakeholders when appropriate and applying commercial thinking to problems and solutions, ensuring PortmanDentex obtains best value for money.

  • Act as the point of contact for Area Managers with organisational change, supporting with the business case for any change and leading on relevant people processes, including restructures, TUPE processes and employee consultation.

  • Coach and build capability in line managers, promoting early and informal resolution of people issues.

Policy & Training Development

  • Define and develop people policies, ensuring alignment with employment legislation, regulatory frameworks (CQC) and internal governance.

  • Contribute to legislative updates and the continuous improvement of Colleague Relations policies, guidelines and template letters.

  • Lead in the development of training on key CR topics, contributing to the enhancement of People managers.

  • Deliver training on key CR topics to SLT for the respective area.

  • Manage the Colleague Relations intranet page (Bridge), ensuring all policies and supporting documentation are accessible, up to date and in line with changes in employment legislation.

Stakeholder Engagement

Leadership

Analytics & Reporting

Key Performance Indicators

  • Case resolution time

  • Complex ER case management.

  • Good judgement and subject matter expertise.

raw.excerpt: About us NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend.
raw.description:
About us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

About the Role

NinjaOne provides a unified IT management platform that simplifies IT operations, endpoint management, and security. We are looking for a Staff Network Architect, Cloud and Datacenter to own the enterprise network architecture across our Austin datacenter, AWS, and our production and corporate environments. You will design, build, and run the enterprise network behind our Austin datacenter and AWS environments, which support our QA, Development, and Sales teams, and set the network standards that other teams build on.

You will combine architectural vision with hands-on engineering: designing secure, scalable, highly available networks across datacenter and AWS, connecting them through hybrid and WAN architectures, and automating how they are deployed and operated. You will work closely with Datacenter Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure as Code and Build and Release, Security, QA, Development, and Sales. Expect roughly half your time on the Austin datacenter and half on cloud and platform work across the organization.

Must-have: hands-on AWS network architecture experience, including hybrid connectivity between AWS and a physical datacenter.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, *IL, KS, MA, MD, ME, NJ, NC, NY, OH, OR, TN, TX, VA, and WA. We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL, if you prefer a hybrid option. Candidates in the Austin area are preferred.

We hire the best software engineers, but experience in our stack can’t hurt: NinjaOne is built on Java, Kotlin, C++, Golang and Postgres; supporting millions of user endpoints and running as a scalable cloud service in AWS. Knowing large-scale datastore bottlenecks, asynchronous application design and client-server architecture will help you.

What You’ll be Doing

  • Architecture and design: Own the network architecture for the Austin datacenter, AWS, and our production and corporate environments: design diagrams, IP addressing and CIDR/IPAM standards, routing designs, and design standards, and lead architecture reviews and vendor evaluations.
  • Design and scale core network boundaries by establishing robust CIDR allocation strategies, IPAM (IP Address Management) frameworks, and non-overlapping subnets across all corporate domains.
  • Cloud network design lead: As we move to infrastructure as code, serve as lead network designer for our cloud environments. Build and maintain a complete map of the network, from VPCs and front ends to subnets and CIDR blocks.
  • VPN replacement: Define the strategy for replacing our VPN, covering both the Austin datacenter and all users accessing AWS, and run the project end to end.
  • AWS networking: Design VPCs, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, and multi-account topologies; build hybrid connectivity with Direct Connect, site-to-site VPN, and BGP; secure it with Network Firewall, PrivateLink, and Route 53 Resolver.
  • Datacenter networking: Design, deploy, and troubleshoot leaf-spine, VXLAN/EVPN, BGP, OSPF, VRF, and MLAG environments, and take part in cabinet builds, cabling validation, and network cutovers.
  • Hybrid cloud: Build WAN and routing fabrics that connect on-premises, private cloud, and public cloud, with predictable failover paths.
  • Security and resilience: Implement segmentation, firewall policy, and least-privilege connectivity with Security; support IPv4/IPv6, incident response, root-cause analysis, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Automation and IaC: Automate provisioning, validation, and drift detection using Python, Ansible, Terraform, and CloudFormation, and fit network changes into version control and CI/CD.
  • Monitoring and reliability: Improve telemetry, alerting, and runbooks; lead troubleshooting of complex issues across datacenter, firewall, and cloud networking.
  • Leadership and influence: Act as the senior technical authority for networking, mentor engineers, work with vendors, carriers, and cloud providers, and communicate risks and decisions to leadership. Drive projects forward across SRE, Platform Engineering, and engineering teams, influencing and aligning teams beyond your own to adopt network standards and make changes.
  • Other duties as needed

About You

  • 15+ years in network engineering, datacenter networking, cloud networking, or infrastructure architecture.
  • Proven record of owning a network architecture end to end and leading major network transformations, from design through delivery.
  • Demonstrated hands-on AWS network architecture: VPC, Transit Gateway, VPC peering, security groups and NACLs, Direct Connect, site-to-site VPN, and hybrid connectivity to physical datacenters.
  • Deep knowledge of TCP/IP, Layer 2/3, VLANs, VRFs, BGP, OSPF, LACP, and high-availability design, with hands-on enterprise switching and routing experience.
  • Practical experience with segmentation, firewall integration, routing policy, and IP address management.
  • Network automation and infrastructure-as-code experience with Python, Ansible, Terraform, CloudFormation, or comparable tools.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across datacenter, AWS, firewalls, and hybrid connectivity, and the ability to write clear architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
  • Ability to influence and align engineering teams you do not manage, and to communicate risks and decisions to senior leadership and vendors.
  • Able to travel to the Austin datacenter as needed, with occasional after-hours maintenance or incident response.
  • Engineer strategic solutions (including advanced NAT/PAT and VRF segmentation) to resolve overlapping CIDR block challenges during multi-tenant cloud integrations.
  • Architect highly scalable, hierarchically structured CIDR blocks to maximize address efficiency and minimize routing table sizes via route summarization.
  • Architect and implement high-availability hybrid paths connecting enterprise datacenters (e.g., Element Critical) to major cloud providers like AWS and Azure.
  • Design robust WAN transit architectures leveraging AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, SD-WAN, and managed MPLS networks.

Nice to haves

  • AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty and/or Solutions Architect – Professional.
  • AWS Cloud WAN, Network Firewall, PrivateLink, and multi-account shared services design.
  • Experience leading a VPN or remote-access replacement.
  • Juniper, Cisco, or Arista platforms; Juniper Mist; VXLAN/EVPN fabrics; IPv6 design.
  • Familiarity with virtualization networking, enterprise storage, and bare-metal infrastructure; network telemetry and observability tools.

What You’ll Love 

We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community. 
We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote.
We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance.
We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.
We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO.
We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement.

Additional Information

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

*Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self-relocate.

raw.description:
CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision-making and improve patient outcomes.

At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives.

The Technical Project Manager plays a critical role in driving CareDx’s EMR Integration and Interoperability initiatives. This role serves as the central coordinator across technical, clinical, and client teams. Blending strong project management discipline with hands-on technical expertise, the associate ensures successful delivery, testing, and implementation of technical solutions to improve transplant centers and clinical teams work with CareDx products and services. This role reports to the Lead Project Manager.

Responsibilities:

Project Execution & Delivery

  • Own end-to-end project planning, execution, and delivery of technical integrations and support post-go-live stabilization.
  • Manage cross‐team communication to ensure alignment on timelines, dependencies, testing expectations, and rollout steps.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, including plans, status updates, SOPs, and client-facing deliverables.

Technical Problem Solving & Integration Support

  • Serve as a triage point for EMR Support, assessing incoming issues, identifying the appropriate path for resolution, and coordinating with the necessary internal teams.
  • Drive continuous improvement of EMR Support by identifying risks, recurring issues, and process gaps and bringing forward recommendations to improve workflows, troubleshooting, and issue resolution
  • Partner with internal engineering and interoperability teams and external client teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues using tools such as Redox, Mirth, Epic and Salesforce.
  • Analyze discrepancies (e.g., mismatched IDs, outdated packages, record‐level inconsistencies) and guide teams toward accurate resolution.

Systems & Workflow Expertise

  • Develop and maintain deep understanding of EMR integrations, clinical workflows, and lab ordering/result processes.
  • Guide clients and internal stakeholders on best practices for configuration, workflow design, and system behavior.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize builds, reduce variability, and improve scalability across implementations.

Stakeholder Communication & Client Engagement

  • Act as the primary client liaison during implementation, building strong relationships with clinical and technical stakeholders while facilitating workflow, integration, and technical discussions.
  • Communicate status, risks, and decisions clearly, translating complex concepts into actionable insights and providing visibility into release scope, changes, and timelines.
  • Support clients and internal stakeholders by providing visibility into what’s included in releases, what’s changing, and when updates will be available.

Testing, Validation & Quality Assurance

  • Oversee integration testing efforts, ensuring environments are properly configured.
  • Ensure teams understand what features, changes, or fixes are included in each build so QA/test activities start with the right expectations.
  • Identify gaps in process visibility (e.g., unclear version control, missing installation steps, outdated packages) and push for improvements.
  • Validate that environments are prepared for testing and that issues discovered in QA are documented and communicated appropriately.

Minimum Education, Experience, & Specialized Knowledge (Required): 

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in healthcare, technology, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in technical project management, EMR integration, or healthcare technology

raw.title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Infrastructure (Remote, USA)
raw.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the US or Canada (residents of Québec are not eligible for this position).

The Opportunity

About our platform

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

About the Infrastructure group

We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

How we work

Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.
  • Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.
  • Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.
  • Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.
  • Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.
  • Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves.
  • Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response.
  • Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage
  • Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production.
  • A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall.
  • The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on.
  • Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety.
  • You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability
  • Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Building self-service infrastructure for application teams
  • Running observability for a production platform at scale
  • Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure
  • You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA"

In the USA, the base compensation range for this role is $189,374 - $227,249. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

raw.title: Shopify Developer (Independent Contractor)
raw.excerpt: Love Wellness is looking for an independent Shopify developer to partner with our ecomm team.
raw.description:
Love Wellness is looking for an independent Shopify developer to partner with our ecomm team. You'll know our ecommerce stack inside out, build and launch what we ship on lovewellness.com, and lead QA and fixes. You'll work closely with our Senior Director of Ecommerce and the ecomm team.

We're a small, collaborative team, and you'll be our technical partner: when an idea comes up, you help shape how it gets built, not just build it.

In a typical month you might build a new landing page for a product launch, set up a promo that swaps offers across the site on a schedule, chase down why a subscription option isn't showing in the cart, and help us figure out whether a new idea is a quick win or a bigger build.

Scope of work:

1. Know our ecomm stack and help keep it healthy

  • Learn how our Shopify store, subscription and cart apps, email and SMS tools, testing tools, tracking and consent setup fit together
  • Spot when a change in one tool affects another, and flag app updates or conflicts before they reach customers
  • Help run a regular integration and tracking audit
  • Document how things work so knowledge is shared across the team

2. Build and launch

  • Build new sections, templates, product pages, collection pages and landing pages from Figma designs
  • Build promo experiences: sale themes, buy boxes, countdowns, and scheduled banner and offer swaps
  • Build cart and subscription features, like subscribe-and-save options and upsell and post-purchase modules
  • Make sections flexible and reusable so the team can move quickly together
  • Run launches end to end: preview, scheduled go-live, rollback plan, post-launch checks

3. Lead QA and fixes

  • Test every release across devices and browsers, subscription and one-time purchases, discounts and gifts, tracking and page speed
  • Build and maintain a QA checklist for our releases
  • Triage and fix site bugs, including ones our CX team hears about from customers, and fix the root cause, not just the symptom

4. Lead technical discovery

  • When the team has a new idea, scope how to build it, what it touches and how long it'll take
  • Dig into tricky issues, like apps conflicting or tags firing when they shouldn't, and come back with options and a recommendation
  • Bring your own ideas for improving site speed, UX and conversion

5. Keep tracking, consent and site health in good shape

  • Keep analytics and pixel events accurate as the site changes
  • Make sure tags respect customers' consent choices
  • Keep an eye on Core Web Vitals and accessibility

6. Keep our workflow clean

  • Manage the theme in GitHub, use preview themes for every change, and keep the changelog up to date for every release, so the team always knows what changed, when and why

What you bring:

  • 5+ years building Shopify themes in Liquid, JavaScript and CSS, including Online Store 2.0 sections, blocks and schema
  • Experience as the main developer for a DTC brand, owning work from scoping through launch
  • Hands-on work with Shopify subscriptions (selling plans and subscription apps) and the Cart AJAX API
  • Experience with cart, upsell and post-purchase apps
  • Working knowledge of tracking and consent: server-side tracking, GA4/GTM, and consent management platforms
  • A QA habit: you test your own work before anyone else sees it, and you write down what you tested
  • Shopify CLI and GitHub workflow; you never edit a live theme directly
  • Comfort with metafields and metaobjects, Shopify Flow, and app-embed troubleshooting
  • An understanding of ecommerce metrics like conversion rate, AOV and subscription retention, and how your work moves them
  • Curiosity about how systems connect: you like finding out why something broke, not just patching it
  • A collaborative style: you bring a point of view, flag risk early, and say when something will slip

Nice to have:

  • Email and SMS onsite forms and scripts
  • A/B testing tools
  • Shopify Functions or Checkout Extensibility
  • Cloudflare DNS
  • Core Web Vitals and accessibility work
  • Experience with health, beauty or wellness brands

Why work with us:

  • Real ownership of a site customers use every day, and a say in what we build and how
  • A small, collaborative team where people trust each other to make decisions
  • An ongoing engagement, not a one-off project
  • Fully remote, on your own schedule and your own setup

Engagement details:

  • Independent contract, estimated at 15–20 hours a week on average, with more hours around big launches like Black Friday, agreed in advance
  • Remote, with at least 4 hours of overlap with Eastern time

Ultimo is moving from legacy success to intentional growth.

  • Operate with autonomy and visibility

  • Create pipeline through outbound prospecting and market engagement
  • Identify, qualify, and progress opportunities through the sales cycle
  • Lead consultative sales conversations with operational, technical, and commercial stakeholders

How you'll operate

  • Fast decision-making and short lines to power
  • Genuine opportunity to influence how things are done
  • Clear expectations around pipeline generation and execution

Experience selling into operational, industrial, logistics, facilities, engineering, manufacturing, or asset-intensive environments is advantageous but not essential.

Sales capability, curiosity, and commercial drive matter most.

Interested?

If you're motivated by building pipeline, winning new customers, and operating with ownership in a growing SaaS business, we'd love to hear from you.

Ultimo's headquarters is based in the Netherlands with more than 2000 global customers, and is a leading Enterprise Asset Management software provider with a strong reputation for the completeness, flexibility, and configurability of its SaaS EAM solutions.

In the world of Ultimo, asset management processes and the software they require take centre stage.
