raw.excerpt: THE ROLE We are seeking skilled, English-speaking Freelance AV Quality Control Technicians for upcoming projects with one of the world’s largest streaming platforms.
raw.description:
THE ROLE

We are seeking skilled, English-speaking Freelance AV Quality Control Technicians for upcoming projects with one of the world’s largest streaming platforms. Operating at the level of a Master AV QC Technician, you will ensure promotional marketing creative – including trailers, teasers, TV spots, and social cutdowns (each up to ~3 minutes in duration), as well as finishing/localization-source files – meets strict client delivery specs and studio quality standards.

You’ll

  1. Execute multi-pass watch-downs (including frame-by-frame reviews in 4K) and discrete 5.1 and stereo listen-downs of AV assets and finishing files.

  2. Review and refine automated compliance reports.

  3. Inspect After Effects graphic collects and associated finishing files.

  4. Log and document all technical and creative issues clearly for the finishing team. Your focus is strictly on identification and reporting – you will not be responsible for fixing the files.

  5. This is a project-based freelance opportunity with a variable workload depending on release schedules and volume.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Native speaker of English.

  • Based in Australia (ideally East Coast) or the US / Canadian West Coast.

  • 3+ years of professional AV QC Technician experience.

  • A sharp eye for video-specific defects to the pixel level (e.g. dead pixels, camera or lens aberrations, watermarks and other finishing errors, etc.)

  • Proven experience performing frame-by-frame picture inspection at native resolution.

  • Strong judgment to separate real, verifiable defects from false positives.

  • Strong grasp of video and audio standards, including codecs, color space, frame rates, channel configuration, loudness (LKFS), true peak (dBTP), and AV sync verification.

  • Hands-on experience conducting discrete 5.1 surround listen-downs and channel mapping verification.

  • Demonstrated working experience in Premiere Pro and After Effects, including scopes and loudness metering in Premiere, and opening and inspecting collected After Effects projects (comps, fonts, plug-ins, linked media).

  • Availability evenings (US time zones) and mornings (Australian time zones) – especially Friday evening (US) / Saturday morning (Australia).

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Fast, modern PC with strong internet download speed with low latency.

  • An in-room discrete 5.1 speaker system (no headphones, virtual surround or soundbars) and a native color and pixel accurate 4K display, 55 inches minimum, with consumer image processing turned off.

  • All QC is performed on a remote server, which you access through the NICE DCV client. On the server, you’ll work in the following, provided tools:

  • QScan for automated ingest and report review

  • Premiere Pro for watch-downs, scopes, and loudness

  • After Effects for Graphic Collect review

TURNAROUND TIMES

Most projects (90%+) run on standard turnaround. A defined set of priority assets is due within 4 hours of receipt, and the remaining assets within 12 hours. Rush projects require every asset to be QC’d within 3 hours of receipt.

Work will often be sent to you around 3 pm Mountain Time, but where possible we will give you a heads up in advance, so you know it’s coming.

RATES

We pay a flat rate that varies depending on the asset type. These flat rates average out to between $44 per hour across a full title. We’ll share a detailed breakdown with you.

PAYMENTS

We settle invoices through Wise or by bank transfer at the end of the month following the month of the invoice.

WORK AT WORDBANK

Join a team that collaborates with incredible clients on global creative production that ignites your ambition, fuels your creativity, and pushes your drive to new heights. You’ll show up as your true self, work with great people, and put your smarts to work.

OUR IMPACT

Built for marketing and creative localization at scale, we help global streaming brands reach and inspire users wherever they are in the world. We partner with our clients to deliver locally impactful creative that drives seamless UX and meaningful engagement. It’s our frame of mind that sets us apart – rooted in operational excellence, elevated by human creativity, and guided by triple bottom line standards of people, planet and profit.

OUR PEOPLE

As a certified B Corp and Investors in People Gold employer (top 16%), we're as serious about our people and planet as we are about performance. Human creativity drives everything we do, so we do everything we can to empower our people. Wordbankers live, work, and play globally, bringing their perspectives to help drive meaningful outcomes, contribute measurable value, and create the difference.

​

THE WORDBANK WAY

  • Self-motivated: Talent-dense teams that drive remarkable results

  • Freedom & responsibility: Empowered decision-making and ownership

  • Candid feedback: Open, timely feedback with positive intent accelerates growth

  • Global-first mindset: Global operations across 118 countries that produce creativity at scale

  • Agile & adaptive: Confidence to embrace change, iterate quickly, and pivot with purpose

  • Data-driven excellence: Informed decision-making that drives continuous optimization

  • Out-of-the-box mindset: Curiosity, innovation and optimization

  • CX-focused: Customer experience that’s functional, easy, and enjoyable

  • Clear communication: Precise, simple, direct, and easy to understand

  • Intelligent failure: Risk-taking, learning from mistakes, and openness about failure

Equal Opportunity Employer

Wordbank is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. We welcome all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, age, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, or any other protected characteristic.

raw.description:
About Reproductive Freedom for All (Formerly NARAL Pro-Choice America)

For more than 55 years, Reproductive Freedom for All and its chapters have fought to protect and expand reproductive freedom —including access to abortion and contraception — for everybody. We are powered by our more than 4 million members from every state and congressional district in the country, representing the 8 in 10 Americans who believe every person should have the freedom to make the best decision for themselves about if, when, and how to raise a family.

Reproductive Freedom for All centers diversity, equity, inclusion, and justice in our organization and our work. Continuously learning from our history, we hold ourselves accountable to achieve reproductive freedom with equitable access for everybody. As the oldest and largest national membership organization primarily focused on advocating for abortion access, we organize and mobilize, galvanizing millions of people to take action to defend reproductive freedom, and shining a spotlight of accountability on bad actors who work to impose their ideological agenda on others. We also work to elect champions for reproductive freedom and advance state and federal legislation to safeguard it. For more information on Reproductive Freedom for All, please visit our website.

Job Details

Compensation: $19.61/hour
Start Date: January 25, 2027
End Date: April 23, 2027
Location: This position will be fully remote
Hours: Part-time; Between 20-30 hours per week, with flexible hours as needed

In this internship, you will:

  • Provide general administrative support to the Political Department, as needed;
  • Analyze state and federal laws and policies related to reproductive freedom;
  • Research elected officials' and candidates' records on reproductive freedom;
  • Other research projects as assigned;
  • Research and coordinate resources on candidates for elected office and key electoral races in the 2028 cycle;
  • Create campaign and race updates on candidates before staff and leadership attend campaign events;
  • Research and report regularly on polling and FEC fundraising data;
  • Create and maintain internal tracking documents to inform political strategy efforts;
  • Aid drafting endorsement rollout materials and assist in updating Reproductive Freedom for All’s endorsement and PAC websites;
  • Gain insight into the day-to-day operations of Reproductive Freedom for All’s political arm, including our endorsement process, PAC (Political Action Committee).

In this internship, you will learn:

  • Political and Policy Skills Development: Electoral strategy, political analysis, collaboration across the progressive movement, knowledge of political processes, preparing briefings/memos for key stakeholders, and policy analysis;
  • Communication Skills Development: Speaking, writing, interpersonal, teamwork, leadership, and listening;
  • General Professional Skills and/or Knowledge: Develop and strengthen skills in research, analysis, time management, teamwork, prioritizing work assignments, initiative, adaptability, and project completion

We're looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about advancing reproductive freedom;
  • Has a demonstrated commitment to contributing to a workplace environment in which diversity is valued and supported;
  • Demonstrates an alignment with our organization’s values;
  • Has strong writing and research skills;
  • Can summarize information in a concise manner;
  • Has prior knowledge/experience in political campaigns and/or issue advocacy, including past engagement in a volunteer capacity;
  • Is able to be flexible and adapt to changing priorities;
  • Can manage several ongoing projects at a time and appropriately prioritize tasks
  • Has a detail-oriented work style;
  • Can be entrusted with handling confidential information;
  • Is enthusiastic about electing pro-reproductive freedom candidates up and down the ballot in 2028;
  • Preference of junior or senior level undergraduate, graduate education in progress, or recent graduate.
Reproductive Freedom for All does not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, socioeconomic status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, genetic information, or political affiliation.
Candidates with backgrounds, identities, and experiences that are historically underrepresented in reproductive freedom non-profits are encouraged to apply.

Reproductive Freedom for All does not permit staff to work from a country outside of the United States.

Who we are

Prowess Consulting is a consulting firm that specializes in helping the largest enterprises in the technology industry define, manage, benchmark, and market their solutions and services. We take great pride in investing the time and effort to gain a deep understanding of our clients’ technologies, their customers, and the stories and strategies they need to tell to be successful in the market. Our team of technology and marketing experts is immersed in the technology trends that affect our clients’ businesses, so we can add value at every stage of engagement to help them succeed.

Who you are
We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically adept SharePoint Communications Specialist who has strong experience with SharePoint Online, M365 tools, Power Automate, and communications within large organizations to manage, publish to, and improve our clients’ internal communications and marketing sites and channels. This role requires strong problem-solving skills, the ability to learn quickly, and proficiency with Microsoft tools. The ideal candidate will handle daily publishing and support requests quickly and accurately, keep sites accessible and well organized, and help find smarter, more automated ways of working.

To be considered for this role, you must reside in one of the following states: California, Colorado, Georgia, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Virginia, or Washington.

This is a full-time role that can be worked remotely, however, collaboration with teammates centered in the Pacific time zone will be essential. No third-party agencies, please.

Key responsibilities

  • Monitor a shared support inbox daily; resolve access requests, process publishing requests from content owners, and troubleshoot or escalate technical issues.
  • Publish content to SharePoint communication sites and related channels (Teams, Viva Engage, Outlook, and employee advocacy tools), including content uploads, new sites and pages, and web part updates.
  • Manage site settings, layout, navigation, and permissions, including security and distribution groups in Entra ID and Microsoft 365 groups; run periodic access audits.
  • Maintain and build Power Automate flows that support publishing, intake, and site operations.
  • Produce weekly and monthly site analytics reports using SharePoint tools, run ad-hoc reports, and recommend actions to improve content visibility and engagement.
  • Make sure sites meet accessibility standards using tools such as Accessibility Insights for Web and respond to accessibility issues.
  • Provide light editorial and formatting support, and advise content owners on layout, formatting, and graphics.
  • Prioritize work by business urgency and meet defined service levels, including same-day turnaround for standard requests and publishing urgent executive announcements within minutes of receiving content.
  • File, track, and escalate bugs, performance, security, and compliance issues with the right support teams through to resolution.
  • Maintain site maps, process documentation, and user guides, and provide informal training on SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Copilot, and Power Automate.
  • Support strategic initiatives such as Copilot and SharePoint agents, improved findability and search, and pilots that use AI and automation to streamline communications workflows.

Required qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on SharePoint Online experience, including building and managing sites, pages, web parts, lists, libraries, and permissions.
  • Experience publishing and managing content across Microsoft 365 communication channels, such as Teams, Viva Engage, and Outlook.
  • Working knowledge of Power Automate, including maintaining and troubleshooting flows.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint usage analytics and reporting.
  • Understanding of web accessibility standards and how to apply them to site content.
  • Ability to learn new tools and processes quickly and apply them effectively.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Able to work independently, manage your own task list, and handle time-sensitive requests calmly.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to clearly and concisely communicate with clients via email, Teams chat, and video calls.

Nice to have

  • AI experience, such as writing and refining reusable prompts, building Copilot or SharePoint agents, and automating manual, prompt-based processes.
  • Experience managing identity and access groups in Entra ID or similar tools.
  • Experience supporting internal communications or marketing teams in a large enterprise.
  • Microsoft certifications (for example, MS-900 or PL-900).
  • Experience at a consulting or professional services firm.
Additional Details
  • The offered pay range for this position is $80,000 – 100,000 per year, depending on experience.

We are a Minority/Women-owned Business Enterprise (WMBE) in Washington, and we committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. raw.description:
Our Commercial Lines team is currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst in our Worcester, MA location. Position is eligible for Hybrid/Flex work arrangement or remote location. This is a full-time, exempt role.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Incumbents serving in the Business Analysis job family are responsible for the collection, development, analysis, documentation, and communication of business needs and requirements. Throughout an assignment, Business Analysts may act like a liaison while they interface and work collaboratively with technology and business organizations. Business Analysts usually assess the needs of the assignment by directly interacting with management, leadership, technology, the business and the customer. Business Analysts are also expected to use their working understanding of information systems, business operations, and processes to analyze requirements, develop specifications, story-boarding and prototyping to facilitate the design of integrated solutions. Their knowledge of business analysis, business processes and project methodologies is applied to all of their assignments. Incumbents in this job family must have a solid understanding of their business partners existing business processes, the key drivers and measures of success for the business, and the short and long-term direction of the business and technology. They assess the needs of a business partner through direct interaction, and look for opportunities to develop and grow the business through effective use of technology. They take a broad perspective to determine how solutions will impact existing work processes and systems, and how to manage the integration. Incumbents must be innovative in identifying, proposing and executing solutions, negotiating requirements across multiple partners or departments, and must have an understanding of project scope management and prototyping. Business Analysts should have a high-level understanding of the overall IT architecture in order to understand the issues and implications of proposed system and hardware solutions.

SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST PROJECT COMPLEXITY:

  • Performs work across multiple initiatives and processes. • Supports and/or leads highly complex business/technical processes or multiple products, requiring design or integration of technical solutions across multiple departments or lines of business. • Serves primarily as a subject matter expert and may lead projects of large scope and moderate to high complexity. • Works independently and leverages resources when needed. Has an understanding of and an ability to apply knowledge of multiple technical business systems.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

  • Providing technical expertise across business functions, understanding the relationship between the business and the data and technology that support the business or product. • Responsible for managing the collection, analysis, documentation and coordination of multiple business and/or technical requirements which may include, but is not limited to: • Facilitating planning sessions with multiple business partners to improve business processes or products Involves using and improving information systems. • Establishing relationships with one or more business partners by demonstrating expert knowledge of business processes/drivers and technical systems, being proactive, and managing the development and implementation of innovative solutions. • Providing technical coaching and mentoring to less experienced team members. • Proactively researches and applies Best Practices to technology solutions for areas of expertise. • Acts as a resource to less experienced personnel in the application and execution of Best Practices. • Recommending improvements to Best Practices procedures. • Working with business partners to define needs to align with business priorities and assess impact on other business processes. • Leading requirements gathering sessions to identify and articulate needs/requirements i.e. JAD sessions, story-boarding. • Advising business partners on options, technical limitations, risks and cost vs. benefits and ensuring a structured requirements process for the business is adhered to. • Leading the development, of structured requirements gathering through various techniques i.e. JAD and storyboarding for the design and implementation of solutions. • Overseeing the documentation of requirements. • Participating in the development of prototypes. • May be accountable for a portion of a project plan in collaboration with project managers, from requirements phases through design, testing, implementation and maintenance. • Acts as a resource to less experienced personnel in developing and executing test/use cases. • Defining when to employ automation and determining impact. • Identifies, recommends and may approve improvements when appropriate. • Participates, facilitates and leads project meetings/sessions. • May act as a resource in the design, development, and execution of complex reports and/or report requirements. • Identifies and recommends improvements when appropriate. • May analyze and provide production support for more complex or escalated issues. • Partners with technology development to provide a solution. • Seeks guidance from more experienced resources when needed. • May provide support through the warranty period.

WHAT YOU NEED TO APPLY:

TYPICAL EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Typically requires seven to ten years of relevant technical and business work experience. • Requires /in-depth knowledge of business operations, requirements processing, business modeling concepts, information systems and project life-cycle knowledge, and business process development. • Knowledge of Industry Business Analysis Best Practices preferred. • Bachelor’s degree in related field specialized training, certification or equivalent work experience.

CRITICAL COMPETENCIES:

  • Analytical Thinking: Applies analytical techniques, e.g., separating a complex whole into its parts or elements to resolve problems or issues. • Communication for Results: Expresses technical and business concepts, ideas, feelings, opinions, and conclusions, so that others understand or are persuaded to act. Creates an environment that encourages and values the opinions of others and promotes sharing of information and ideas. • Conceptual Thinking: Synthesizes facts, trends, inferences, and key issues and/or themes in complex situations Recognizes patterns and relationships between apparently unrelated entities or situations consulting: Uses professional or technical expertise to advise, intervene, and/or influence a customer or internal partner over whom there is no direct authority. • Information Seeking: Thoroughly investigates and researches multiple sources to expose details and complete information about resources, issues, and problems and so forth Involves in-depth research, asking probing questions and transcending surface issues. • Innovation: Motivated to improve organizational performance through the introduction of new ideas, methods, processes, products, services, and so forth develops new ways of looking at a situation. • Mentoring/Developing Others: Shares knowledge, skills or expertise with others; coaches others. Encourages and rewards learning, growth, etc., in others. Creates an environment where employee ownership of self-development is encouraged supports continual development of staff through assignments, coaching, and training. • Relationship Building: Understands the importance of developing and maintaining cooperative relationships with others at all levels of the organization by making others feel their concerns and contributions are important builds positive relationships with others to accomplish organizational goals. • Self-Management: Effectively plans and organizes their work to achieve desired outcomes Demonstrates flexibility in applying different approaches to changing work demands is confident of own abilities to meet challenges and can maintain performance under stress seeks improvement through learning, development and feedback. Business Function Knowledge: An understanding of business functions and the corresponding strategies, benefits, risks, and costs that impact the business. Example business functions include: IT, marketing, sales, finance, HR, and engineering. Business • Operations Analysis: Analyzes the business impact of markets, trends, issues, technologies, economies, and competition applies that analysis to business issues and challenges. • Business Requirements Analysis: Thorough familiarity and understanding of the intricacies of a customer's business, e.g. function, processes, and operations. Understands and can delineate technical design requirements for supporting information systems. Business Data Requirements Knowledge: Analyzes data requirements based on knowledge of client data needs, and defines the critical data components to be incorporated into information delivery vehicles. • Information Systems Knowledge: Maintains and applies specific knowledge of information systems elements (hardware, software, and network) and their application to business functions/processes.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Phorest is the number 1 salon software brand for premium independent salons in those markets, and our next goal is to become a platform upon which other companies can build applications for premium salons.

Our system touches every point of the salon experience, from the in-salon appointment calendar and CRM with a fully integrated marketing suite, to staff apps and payments. More recently we have expanded this to include EMR (electronic medical records) for MedSpa clinics.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a new Software Engineer (Backend) to join our Consultations Team. You will join a multidisciplinary group of technology, product, and design folks in building the future of the hair, beauty, and MedSpa industry. This team looks after the client and patient journey from enquiry, consultation, documentation, and care management. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who wants a new challenge, where you will grow your skills in a supportive, growth-mindset environment that will help us achieve our goals.

You will contribute to a high-scale, distributed system, working with event-driven architecture and modern cloud technologies like Docker and Serverless. Your work will impact millions of users globally. You will solve well-defined problems with the guidance of senior engineers and take on more complexity as you grow, in an environment where we continuously improve and learn. We work with feature flags and continuous delivery to get our work to production as fast as possible.

The type of person we want

  • Someone who works with our product designers and owners to turn user stories into shippable features, and contributes to breaking stories down into tasks.

  • Quality and high standards really matter to us. You will apply good coding techniques including maintainability, reuse, clean code and unit testing, with excellent attention to detail.

  • Someone who weighs trade-offs in design and performance, and escalates early when requirements or approach are unclear.

  • Never stops learning: curious, acts on feedback, picks up new tools and practices, and takes a pragmatic approach to solution design.

  • Someone who is open to code reviews and pairing, and who supports teammates in return.

  • Someone who takes initiative and is not afraid to ask questions, share ideas and voice an opinion.

Job Description - Digital Marketing Data Analyst Division / Department: MarketingReports to (position): Senior Digital Marketing LeaderLevel / Grade: TBDLocation: Remote (US)Employment Type: Full-timeWork Conditions: Remote professional office environmentTravel: TBDTelecommute: YesMinimum Educational Req: TBDYears of Experience: 5+ years The Digital Marketing Data Analyst will own the data and reporting infrastructure for digital marketing activities across all Career Certified brands, helping provide stakeholder visibility, identify insights and opportunities, and drive growth. This role is responsible for combining and analyzing data from more than 10 sources, including GA4, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Klaviyo, Meta, AdRoll, and other platforms, to provide insights and analysis at the brand, channel, and product levels. The Digital Marketing Data Analyst will have the authority to improve existing systems or guide the organization toward new systems that achieve maximum effectiveness. Job Responsibilities Measurement Infrastructure

Build and maintain dashboards in Power BI across all brands and channels. Own the attribution framework by evaluating the current approach, recommending improvements, implementing changes, and documenting methodologies and assumptions so stakeholders clearly understand the information being presented. Maintain data integrity across platform-native analytics, GA4, and the internal data warehouse; Identify and resolve data discrepancies before they affect business decisions.

Performance Analysis

Deliver regular performance analyses by brand, channel, product, and audience segment, with an emphasis on interpretation and recommendations rather than metrics summaries. Identify the drivers of return on ad spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), and conversion-rate trends. Surface optimization opportunities supported by data and evidence. Track cross-brand patterns to determine where similar audiences or channels are performing differently across brands and what those differences imply for marketing strategy.

Testing and Experimentation

Work with digital and marketing teams to make sure tests are designed correctly before they run — right sample sizes, clean test/control splits, and agreed success criteria — so when results come in, the team can act on them with confidence rather than second-guess whether the test was valid Own the analysis of test results and document findings in a format that informs future decisions, not just the immediate test.

Budget and Channel Intelligence

Build models to support budget allocation decisions across brands and channels; quantify trade-offs between volume and efficiency Monitor platform algorithm and policy changes (Google, Meta, Microsoft) that materially affect how we buy or measure; brief the team on implications

Cross-Functional Responsibilities

Partner with marketing and product teams to define channel-level key performance indicator frameworks for each brand’s funnel. Determine what will be measured, why it will be measured, and how each metric will connect to the company-wide KPI registry. Translate findings into clear, recommendation-led outputs for non-technical stakeholders. Present findings and recommendations regularly to Director- and Vice President-level stakeholders. Partner with data engineering to ensure tracking implementation is accurate and reliable.

Management Responsibilities This position does not have formal people-management responsibilities identified at this time. The Digital Marketing Data Analyst will provide cross-functional guidance related to reporting, measurement, attribution, testing, data integrity, and marketing analytics. Required Qualifications

Five or more years of experience in a data analyst or marketing analytics role, with demonstrated ownership of digital marketing reporting rather than solely contributing to a team’s output. Advanced SQL skills, including the ability to write complex queries against cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Redshift, or Snowflake. Demonstrated ability to write joins, common table expressions, and window functions independently. Experience using Python or R for data manipulation, basic statistical analysis, and the automation of reporting pipelines. Advanced experience with Power BI and Google Data Studio, including building and maintaining production-grade dashboards from the ground up. Experience designing data models rather than only connecting dashboards to pre-built datasets. Platform fluency in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and Microsoft/Bing Ads. Understanding of how each advertising platform defines its metrics, attribution windows, and reporting requirements. Practical knowledge of multi-touch attribution models, including how different models work, where each model may break down, and how to recommend or implement methodology changes. Working knowledge of GA4 and Google Tag Manager, including how upstream tracking decisions affect downstream data quality. Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, including determining appropriate test sizes, designing clean holdout groups, and interpreting results with appropriate statistical rigor. Ability to communicate complex analytical findings and recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to manage reporting and analysis across multiple brands, channels, products, and data sources simultaneously. Experience working across multiple brands, business units, or client accounts is preferred.

Supervisory Responsibility This position does not have direct supervisory responsibility identified at this time. Physical Requirements

Ability to perform work in a remote professional office environment. Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer. Ability to communicate effectively through video conferencing, telephone, email, and other digital communication platforms. Ability to perform repetitive computer-related tasks, including typing, reviewing data, and developing reports and dashboards. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Internal and External Interaction This position interacts internally with digital marketing, brand marketing, product, data engineering, finance, and senior leadership stakeholders, including Director- and Vice President-level leaders. The role may also interact with external advertising platforms, technology providers, consultants, and other third-party partners involved in marketing data, analytics, attribution, and reporting.

Overview

Liquibase delivers world-class enterprise solutions that automate and streamline database change governance. These solutions leverage the industry's open-source leader with over 100 million downloads. At Liquibase, we support a large number of customers, value creativity, and solve complex problems around data management. This is a company where you can expect opportunities to grow.

Liquibase is hiring a Technical Writer to join our Documentation team, partnering alongside our Technical Writer and Content Engineer. This is a versatile, high-impact role responsible for keeping developer documentation accurate, clear, and actionable. You will craft engaging learning materials across our docs and Liquibase University, test technical instructions directly in the command line, and help operationalize modern agentic AI workflows to scale content quality. If you are an adaptable writer with a keen editorial eye and an appetite for learning developer-centric tools, you will thrive here.

Who you are:

  • You surprise and delight customers by delivering meaningful value, consistently going beyond what's expected.
  • You're committed to excellence, holding high standards while embracing progress over perfection.
  • You bring a growth mindset and the courage to have difficult conversations when they matter.
  • You embrace change and uncertainty with energy and optimism, creating clarity where it doesn't yet exist.
  • You take ownership and follow through, proactively identifying what needs to happen and reliably seeing it through.
  • You are innovative. You see every challenge as an opportunity. You would rather create the future than wait for it.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Author, edit, and maintain high-quality documentation, user guides, release notes, and reference material for Liquibase core features, extensions, and integrations.
  • Partner with Documentation, Marketing, Support, and Customer Success teams to develop interactive coursework and training materials.
  • Hands-on testing of technical documentation and examples in the product, verifying that installation steps, flags, and workflows function exactly as published.
  • Review, triage, and process inbound feedback, prioritizing fixes and updating content to address customer friction.
  • Help train and evaluate agentic AI tools, enforcing editorial rule sets, evaluating AI-generated drafts, and providing feedback to optimize internal automation prompts.
  • Apply core documentation best practices and topic-based authoring principles to maintain modular, searchable, and easily navigable docs.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Support, and Security teams to capture upcoming feature changes and technical specifications early in the development cycle.
  • Contribute to docs-as-code workflows using Git for version control, review pull requests, and manage content in structured markup languages (Markdown, YAML, XML, HTML).

Must Haves:

  • Bachelor’s degree in English, Technical Communication, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated editorial experience: exceptional developmental editing, copyediting, and proofreading skills with acute attention to clarity and structure.
  • An authentic eagerness to learn and experiment with developer tooling, technical applications, and emerging documentation tech.
  • Critical thinking skills to evaluate technical content from an end-user perspective and explain why an edit is necessary.
  • Strong multitasking skills with the agility to manage ad-hoc user feedback alongside ongoing content initiatives.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience working with version control platforms such as Git, GitHub, GitLab, or Azure DevOps in a docs-as-code environment.
  • Comfort working in the terminal/CLI (running commands, reviewing terminal outputs, verifying CLI options).
  • Experience experimenting with or prompting agentic AI platforms (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) for content generation, editing, or rule enforcement.
  • Experience developing training curricula, tutorials, or online coursework (e.g., LMS/University platforms).
  • Familiarity with topic-based authoring principles or structured formats like DITA.
  • Hands-on exposure to markup and data-interchange formats such as Markdown, YAML, XML, HTML, and JSON.
  • Experience authoring or reviewing REST API documentation.

Perks of life at Liquibase:

  • Remote First culture, potential for company-wide in-person gatherings
  • Home office allowance for remote workers
  • Meaningful equity
  • Comprehensive health, vision, and dental benefits - country dependent
  • Generous paid time off and paid holidays
  • 401k match program (US only)
  • No punks, no jerks culture
  • Growth opportunities and ability to move up within the company

We take pride in:

  • A transparent and collaborative team environment. We value multiple perspectives and fresh thinking.
  • Our entrepreneurial culture. We provide every employee the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.
  • Providing the opportunity to work with new technologies and learn from experienced professionals.
  • How organizations, large and small, use DevOps to drive developer agility and accelerate software delivery.

Company Overview - We are Liquibase

A career at Liquibase means joining a quickly growing company on the front lines of the DevOps space. Our vision is to be the easiest, safest, and most powerful community-led database change management solution. As companies of all sizes continue to adopt an agile methodology and DevOps practices, there is a growing realization that the database needs to be considered as part of this innovation process.

At Liquibase, we foster a culture rooted in the open-source values of freedom, choice, transparency, and meritocracy. These are not just fashion labels here, but sincere convictions, and you’ll see that reflected in the way we operate daily. We’re caffeinated, collaborative & confident experts, eager to solve the most challenging database CI/CD problems for our customers.

Want to help the software world move faster? You’ve found the right place.

The Fraud Engineering organization builds the foundational and tactical software that enables Affirm to respond strategically to fraud - both in real time and after the transaction. Our mission is to support business growth while protecting Affirm, our buyers, and our merchants. We evaluate risk at critical decision points in the user journey, rapidly adapt to evolving fraud patterns, and equip operations teams with the tools needed to investigate and mitigate fraud at scale.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our fully remote team based in Europe. You’ll collaborate closely with stakeholders across North America - including teams in Product, Compliance, Machine Learning, Fraud Operations, Fraud Strategy, and other Fraud Engineering teams.

The Fraud Engineering organization builds the foundational and tactical software that enables Affirm to respond strategically to fraud - both in real time and after the transaction. Our mission is to support business growth while protecting Affirm, our customers, and our merchants. We evaluate risk at critical decision points in the user journey, rapidly adapt to evolving fraud patterns, and equip operations teams with the tools needed to investigate and mitigate fraud at scale.

The Fraud International Team (FIT) leads the engineering effort to extend Affirm's Fraud Decisioning System into markets beyond the US - Canada, the UK, Australia, and growing rapidly. We own real-time fraud decisioning for these markets, integrate region-specific risk vendors, and are building the platform that lets Affirm stand up fraud protection in a new country quickly and safely. As Affirm expands globally, FIT scales with it.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our fully remote team based in Europe. You'll collaborate closely with stakeholders across North America - including teams in Product, Compliance, Machine Learning, Fraud Operations, Fraud Strategy, and other Fraud Engineering teams.

What You'll Do

  • You will own and deliver quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.
  • You will design and implement real-time fraud decisioning services and APIs in Python or Kotlin, extending Affirm's Fraud Decisioning System to markets beyond the US.
  • You will build and evolve the platform and tooling that let Affirm launch fraud decisioning in a new country quickly—turning market-by-market setup (rules, models, and vendor configuration) into a repeatable, low-friction path so launches scale sub-linearly with the number of markets.
  • You will integrate region-specific fraud and risk vendors and help operationalize the machine learning and AI signals that power real-time decisioning, while using modern AI tooling to move faster as an engineer.
  • You will support peers and stakeholders across the product development lifecycle - collaborating with Product, Machine Learning, Analytics, and Fraud Strategy, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly weigh risks and trade-offs.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team's systems by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and contributing to keep-the-lights-on and on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership - setting and improving code review and design standards, mentoring teammates, and leading by example.

What We Look For

  • 5+ years of experience building backend systems at scale using Python or Kotlin.
  • Experience with distributed systems and infrastructure using AWS, MySQL/PostgreSQL, and Kubernetes.
  • Strong system design skills and a track record of delivering maintainable, extensible services.
  • Fluency with AI-driven engineering - every Affirm engineer builds with tools like Claude Code and most PRs are co-authored with AI, so directing and orchestrating AI and excelling in the reviewer's seat (setting intent, critically evaluating generated code, and owning its correctness, quality, and security) is a core expectation.
  • Proficiency in SQL and working with data-rich environments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and safe production deployments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in distributed teams.
  • A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with a focus on learning and team success.
  • Experience with Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, or Chronosphere (nice to have)
  • Background in fraud prevention, risk systems, or real-time decisioning (nice to have)
  • Experience building for multiple markets or regions - internationalization or localization (nice to have)
  • Experience working in the fintech sector or other highly regulated environments, with a strong understanding of risk, compliance, and operational constraints. (nice to have)

Total rewards

We believe the people building honest financial products at Affirm should share in its success. That's why our total rewards are designed to support your health, growth, financial well-being, and future.

In service of our mission, we reward employees through a combination of base pay, equity (from parent company), and comprehensive benefits.

Base Pay Grade- N

POL base pay range per year: 308,000 zł - 428,000 zł

Base pay ranges and placement within those ranges are determined based on several factors, including role, experience, and job-related skills.

In addition to base pay, all employees in this role are eligible to receive equity from the parent company each year. This means as Affirm’s parent company grows, employees have the opportunity to share in that growth financially.

Equity Grade - 4 (awarded in US Dollars)

Affirm Holdings, Inc. Equity Grade example

Equity grade: 4
New hire equity: $32,000-$48,000
Annual Refresh: $10,000
Reward equity: $0-$150,000

Affirm also provides flexible spending wallets to all employees for technology and wellbeing related needs, which are reimbursable up to 1390 zł per month.

In addition to your compensation, our comprehensive benefits are designed to support you and the people who matter most. Benefits include:

  • Competitive paid time off, paid public holidays, and additional paid Away Days to rest and recharge.
  • Comprehensive private healthcare through Lux Med's Platinum package.
  • A MultiSport card to support your health and well-being.
  • Learning and development programs to help you grow professionally.
  • Family healthcare support through Maven and parental leave support through Parentaly.
  • Mental well-being support through Lyra, including up to 12 confidential counseling or coaching sessions each year for you and your household members.
  • Financial well-being support through Northstar, with unlimited access to Certified.
  • Financial Advisors and planning tools at no cost to you.
  • Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection and inclusion.
  • Eligibility for creative tax benefits, subject to applicable law, role, and company policy.

Location - Remote Poland

The majority of our roles can be located anywhere in Poland.

**This job description is not a contractual document, and is not intended to have binding force.**

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

Overview

JOB TITLE: Web Designer & Technical Writer

GOVERNMENT AGENCY: DOJ ATR (Antitrust Division)

POSITION INFORMATION: Full-Time Position; Government contractor supporting DOJ ATR

LOCATION: Fully remote

POSITION TIMING: Position requires DOJ clearance; candidate can start once complete (4-6 weeks)

BENEFITS: Health, Dental and Vision, 401(k), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), 11 Paid Federal Holidays, PTO, education reimbursement

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are seeking a versatile Web Designer & Technical Writer who combines strong visual design skills with the ability to write, edit, and review technical content. This role will support digital communications by improving clarity, usability, and visual quality across announcements, websites, and other digital assets.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable working across design and content, and able to translate complex information into clear, accessible, and engaging materials.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Web Designer Responsibilities:

  • Design, re-design, code, test, implement, and maintain new web pages and sections of agency Internet and intranet websites.
  • Create prototypes (including graphic design, navigation, and layout options) of new web pages and site areas.
  • Collaborate with content providers (including attorneys, economists, senior management, administrative, and IT support staff) and key web team members on project goals, audiences, schedules, and other aspects of project planning and deliverables.
  • Establish layout, design, formatting and style guidelines for websites.
  • Review and track web metrics and analytics.
  • Research, evaluate, and report on new and emerging developments and trends in web design and web services.
  • Effectively communicate orally and in writing when presenting ideas and recommendations to a wide range of audiences, including senior management staff.
  • Train end users, web staff, and agency trainers, regarding various aspects of agency web services.
  • Ensure that new web pages and sections comply with:
    • Section 508 and 504 requirements for accessibility.
    • Best practices in usability and information architecture.
    • Federal and agency policies and requirements.
  • Implement, code, and test prototypes using technologies such as HTML, CSS, XHTML, dynamic HTML (JavaScript), ASP, JSP, and PHP in a multi-browser, multi-operating system, and multi-device environment.
  • Comply with best practices for “plain writing” when creating, organizing, and editing content.
  • Support and assist web content administrators, quality assurance analysts when requested.

Technical Writer Responsibilities:

  • Effectively communicate orally and in writing when presenting ideas and recommendations to a wide range of audiences, including technical, non-technical, junior, and senior staff.
  • Prepare and edit technical documentation including: User Manuals, Job Aids, “Help,” What’s New, FAQs, policies, procedures, guidance, and other technical information (in print and web media) as requested.
  • Prepare other written documentation including: organization charts, flow charts, brochures, newsletters, information sheets, and other documentation (in print and web media) as requested.
  • Comply with best practices for “plain writing” when creating, organizing, and editing content.
  • Support and assist government and contract staff including: web content analysts, web software developers, web quality assurance analysts, managers and other web support staff when requested.
  • Prepare multimedia training and guidance tutorials.

Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with Section 508 / accessibility compliance
  • Familiarity with web analytics and reporting (e.g., Google Analytics or similar tools)
  • Experience designing for government, enterprise, or regulated environments
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Ability to explain design and content decisions clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Comfort working independently in a fast-paced environment

SECURITY CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to obtain a US DOJ public trust clearance
  • For the purposes of obtaining a federal security clearance, all applicants must be a US Citizen

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

This position is fully remote. The employee will primarily work in a home office environment and must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods of time.

ITC Federal, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any application for employment on the basis of age, race, color, gender, national origin, religion, creed, disability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military status, disability, or sex including pregnancy and childbirth or related medical condition or on any other basis prohibited by law.

raw.description:
About CAST

CAST Software is the global leader in software intelligence, helping large enterprises understand, modernize, and secure their most critical applications. With a strong foundation in North America and a growing footprint in Financial Services, CAST is poised for growth, and we are looking for an expert digital marketer to build a digital lead-gen engine directly feeding new-business pipeline.

What is the role, and why now

CAST is focused on durable growth: expanding within existing accounts and acquiring new customers through direct sales and strategic partners.

We’re looking for a hands-on digital lead-generation expert to build and optimize the programs that turn market interest into qualified leads and new-business pipeline. You’ll own execution across multiple channels, working directly with the CMO, BDRs and Sales to make digital lead generation a measurable growth engine.

This is a global individual-contributor role with a primary focus on North America. You’ll have the opportunity to build the engine, test new approaches and see the direct impact of your work on business growth.

The three sales motions you’ll feed

Your digital programs will center on three high-value sale motions.

1. AI-Enabled SDLC.Enterprises are pushing AI agents into their software delivery lifecycle, but LLMs can’t “guess” their way through millions of lines of custom code. CAST supplies the deterministic map that gives AI agents the architectural context they need to change code safely and at speed.Buyers: CTOs, VPs of Engineering, platform and AI/transformation leaders.

2. Mainframe Modernization.Trillions of dollars of business logic still live in COBOL, PL/I, and JCL that few people fully understand. CAST turns that legacy estate into navigable architecture maps and evidence-based re-platform/re-factor/modernize decisions – preventing project wrong-turns and dead-ends.Buyers: CIOs, modernization program leads, enterprise architects; often co-sold withSystem Integrators and Cloud Service Providers

3. CIO Take Command.Every CIO faces the same question: “Which 100 of my 1,000 applications should we focus on?” CAST Highlight answers it in hours – an empirical, board-ready view of technical debt, cloud readiness, open-source risk, and resiliency across the whole portfolio, so leaders steer with facts instead of the loudest voice in the room.Buyers: CIOs, application owners, heads of architecture and digital transformation.

What you’ll do

Build and run the digital programs that generate qualified leads and create new-business pipeline for CAST’s sales team.

•Design and run campaigns across paid search, paid social, AI-platform advertising, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), outbound email to net-new prospects, webinars, and retargeting.

•Own webinar-led lead generation, including audience targeting, promotion, registration, coordination with presenters, and post-webinar follow-up.

•Optimize conversion by improving landing pages, gated content, forms, demo requests and other conversion-focused assets.

•Optimize lead nurturing and qualification using segmentation, marketing automation, lead scoring, and behavior-based follow-up.

•Work closely with BDRs and Sales on lead activation, timely follow-up, effective routing, and progression into new-business opportunities.

•Track and improve performance across qualified leads, cost per qualified lead, lead-to-opportunity conversion, and marketing-sourced pipeline. Use the results to improve channel effectiveness and return on investment.

Key measures of success

MQL-to-SQL conversions: The number of Marketing Qualified Leads generated by digital programs that convert to Sales Qualified Leads.

Marketing origin pipeline: The value of new-business pipeline originating from those programs.

What you bring

•At least five years of experience generating qualified leads through digital marketing for B2B software companies.

•A proven track record of personally building, executing and optimizing multi-channel lead-generation programs, with measurable results in qualified leads and new-business pipeline.

•Strong hands-on expertise in digital acquisition, outbound prospecting and marketing automation, including data enrichment, AI-powered personalization, campaign orchestration and CRM integration. Experience with tools such as Clay, FirstTouch, Instantly or similar tools is expected.

•Familiarity with software development, architecture or technology decision-maker personas, and how to engage them effectively, is a strong plus.

•Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical concepts clear and compelling.

•A self-starter who takes initiative, thrives in ambiguity and continuously tests, learns and improves.

What we offer

•Opportunity to build a digital lead-gen engine and directly contribute to new-business growth.

•Competitive base salary plus bonus. [$135,000 - $155,000 base plus 20% bonus]

•A category-defining technology solving real, hard problems for some of the largest organizations in the world, at the center of the enterprise AI shift.

How to apply

Send your resume and a few sentences on why this role appeals to you to [ / application link]. Tell us about a time you built something from scratch — we read every note.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status.

raw.description:
AtEZCORPwe are a growing team focused on creating and changing the pawn industry as we know it today. We believe that our platform enabled lending and e-commerce solutions will revolutionize our ability to attract, engage and service our customers across the United States, Mexico and Latin America.

Join us now for an opportunity to be a part of a team that wants to provide access to short-term cash for every person – everywhere!

The Company:

Founded in Austin in 1989, EZCORP has grown into a leading provider of pawn loans in the United States, Mexico and Latin America. We are dedicated to satisfying the short-term cash needs of consumers who are both cash and credit constrained and providing an industry-leading customer experience.

What’s in it for you:

Ground Floor opportunity with EZCORP, a company with a start-up, purpose-driven mentality where innovative and agile problem solving are part of our DNA along with competitive compensation and benefits.

Address:

Guatemala

The Product Owner will support the delivery of digital products that improve customer engagement, loyalty participation, retail execution, and omnichannel store experiences across EZCORP’s pawn store network and digital platforms.

This role will work closely with Product Managers, engineering, UX/UI, marketing, analytics, store operations, compliance, and business stakeholders to translate retail and loyalty strategy into user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and sprint-ready backlog items.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Loyalty Program & Customer Engagement Execution

  • Support delivery of loyalty, rewards, promotions, customer engagement, and retention capabilities across digital and store channels.
  • Translate loyalty program requirements into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, and customer workflows.
  • Partner with marketing, analytics, and operations teams to support rewards enrollment, points earning and redemption, promotional campaigns, targeted offers, and customer lifecycle engagement.
  • Help improve loyalty participation, repeat visits, customer retention, and known-customer transaction visibility.

Retail Experience & Store Operations Support

  • Support digital products that improve the customer experience across EZCORP’s pawn store network, including web, mobile, in-store, and associate-assisted workflows.
  • Define omnichannel retail journeys that connect store operations, customer identity, inventory visibility, payments, layaway, extensions, and digital engagement tools.
  • Collaborate with store operations teams to ensure product features are practical, usable, and aligned with real store workflows.
  • Support enhancements that reduce operational friction for store teams and improve customer service speed, consistency, and satisfaction.

Backlog Ownership & Agile Delivery

  • Own and manage the product backlog for assigned retail experience, loyalty, CRM, and customer engagement initiatives.
  • Convert strategy, stakeholder inputs, business needs, and customer feedback into clear, prioritized, and sprint-ready backlog items.
  • Write detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, functional requirements, workflows, and edge-case scenarios for engineering and QA teams.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, demos, retrospectives, and release planning.

Customer Identity, CRM & Promotions

  • Support capabilities related to customer profiles, known-customer identification, CRM integrations, marketing automation, rewards history, and customer communication preferences.
  • Define workflows for promotional offers, campaign eligibility, customer segmentation, notification triggers, and redemption experiences.
  • Support integrations with loyalty platforms, CRM systems, POS, marketing technologies, analytics tools, and customer communication platforms.

Data, Metrics & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor product performance using customer engagement, loyalty participation, repeat transaction, retention, campaign performance, and store adoption metrics.
  • Use analytics, customer feedback, store feedback, and operational data to identify backlog improvements and product optimization opportunities.
  • Support A/B testing, campaign analysis, funnel review, and post-release measurement for loyalty and customer engagement features.

UAT, Quality & Release Readiness

  • Support user acceptance testing by defining test scenarios, validating delivered functionality, and confirming alignment with acceptance criteria.
  • Work with QA and engineering teams to validate customer-facing, store-facing, CRM, loyalty, promotions, payments, and operational workflows.
  • Track defects, requirement gaps, edge cases, enhancement requests, release readiness, and post-release issue triage.

AI-Enabled Engagement & Product Delivery

  • Use AI-enabled tools to improve product documentation, workflow analysis, user story creation, research, backlog refinement, and test scenario preparation.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, engineering, analytics, and data teams on AI-enabled capabilities such as personalization, customer segmentation, targeted promotions, recommendations, and predictive engagement insights.
  • Evaluate practical AI use cases that improve loyalty participation, customer retention, retail productivity, and customer service experiences.

Digital Commerce & Pawn Marketplace Support

  • Support retail-connected digital commerce workflows such as inventory discovery, product visibility, online browsing, store pickup, resale readiness, and customer engagement around pre-owned merchandise.
  • Assist with requirements involving pawn-related customer journeys such as loan engagement, online payments, renewals, extensions, redemption reminders, and store follow-up workflows.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or Digital Product professional.
  • Experience supporting loyalty programs, CRM platforms, retail technology, customer engagement products, marketing technology, or omnichannel digital products.
  • Strong experience working in Agile product development environments using Scrum or Kanban.
  • Proven ability to manage product backlogs, write user stories, define acceptance criteria, and support sprint delivery.
  • Experience supporting UAT, release validation, defect triage, and production readiness.
  • Ability to work closely with engineering, QA, UX/UI, analytics, marketing, operations, and business stakeholders.
  • Practical fluency with AI-enabled tools and AI-assisted workflows for documentation, research, analysis, and product delivery.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with loyalty platforms, rewards programs, customer retention tools, CRM, marketing automation, or personalization engines.
  • Background in retail, pawn, resale commerce, financial services, luxury resale, jewelry, or high-transaction customer environments.
  • Familiarity with POS systems, store operations, inventory management, payments, layaway, online payments, or browse-online/purchase-in-store workflows.
  • Exposure to customer segmentation, predictive analytics, targeted promotions, campaign measurement, or lifecycle marketing.
  • Experience working with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Figma, analytics platforms, CRM systems, or product management tools.
  • Experience supporting AI-enabled customer engagement, personalization, recommendations, or automation capabilities.

Preferred Certifications

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or equivalent Agile certification
  • Certified ScrumMaster, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or similar Agile certification
  • Product Owner, Business Analysis, Product Management, or customer engagement platform certification

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

Coinbase Credit Risk is hiring a Director to lead credit risk for our institutional financing and lending business. Reporting to the Head of Credit Risk, you will own counterparty underwriting for funds and the risk frameworks behind cross margin, portfolio margin, exchange lending, and extended settlement products. Our product surface is expanding fast and you will build the risk frameworks that govern it.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the credit risk framework across institutional financing products: cross margin, portfolio margin, exchange lending, trade finance, and OTC extended settlement.
  • Shape rating methodology, underwriting standards, and risk appetite for funds; set and defend counterparty limits.
  • Build risk frameworks for new products from first principles, embedding margin, collateral, and liquidation logic at the design stage rather than after launch.
  • Partner with Engineering to productionize those frameworks across the credit risk platform — counterparty data, ratings, limits, exposure monitoring, and automated controls.
  • Own risk-relevant contractual terms with Legal across master loan agreements, security interest and pledge structures, derivatives documentation, and prime brokerage agreements.
  • Drive stress testing and potential exposure analysis, and actively manage single-name, sector, and collateral concentrations across the portfolio.
  • Influence executives across Institutional Financing, Product, Legal, and Finance, making final risk decisions on complex exposures and developing the leaders on your team.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 12+ years in credit risk, counterparty risk, or securities financing at a global financial institution, with depth in secured lending, prime brokerage, and/or derivatives.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a credit underwriting framework — rating methodology, limit setting, and surveillance — for funds and corporate counterparties.
  • Track record of building risk frameworks from scratch for structurally complex products, not only operating established ones.
  • Fluency in collateral mechanics, LTV structuring, margin methodology, potential future exposure, and wrong-way risk.
  • Experience negotiating risk terms with Legal and counterparties, and partnering with Engineering to productionize risk systems.
  • Able to negotiate with and influence senior leaders, and to make and defend final decisions under ambiguity.
  • Strong interest in crypto and digital asset markets.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

raw.description:
Bridgeway is seeking an Account Manager to grow annual recurring revenue (ARR) across the existing funds administered by Bridgeway’s third-party administrator (TPA) partners. In this role, you will serve as the primary commercial point of contact for assigned TPA-administered funds, protecting recurring revenue and driving expansion through upsell and cross-sell opportunities across Bridgeway’s software, cost containment, and payments solutions. Working closely with the VP, TPA Partnerships, TPA Technical Account Managers (TAMs), Solutions Engineers, Business Analysts, and Product, you will flag needs to the TAMs and support the activation of signed funds.

This is a remote position with preference given to East Coast candidates.

Responsibilities:

  • Work with the VP, TPA Partnerships to secure each TPA’s approval to sell to its funds.
  • Build a fund-by-fund target list from each TPA’s existing book of funds and TAM signals, prioritized by claims-cost and remittance pain.
  • Grow ARR by identifying and pursuing upsell and cross-sell opportunities across software, cost containment, and payments solutions based on customer needs, product usage, and growth.
  • Run fund-level deals end to end, including discovery, demos, proposals, negotiation, and close.
  • Lead with value by running standardized impact analyses and packaged pricing.
  • Support the VP, TPA Partnerships’ joint account plans with each TPA, and develop and execute fund-level account plans with TPA TAMs that align Bridgeway solutions with customers’ business objectives.
  • Use a tiered engagement model, combining one-to-one outreach with one-to-many touchpoints such as webinars, email campaigns, and group business reviews, to cover the full book efficiently.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers at multiple levels, reaching trustees and fund executives beyond the TPA’s day-to-day contacts while keeping each TPA confident in Bridgeway selling directly to its funds.
  • Monitor fund-level signals, such as claims-cost trends, remittance pain, and product usage, and flag needs and opportunities to TPA TAMs.
  • Manage fund-level orders and amendments under each TPA’s enterprise agreement, including pricing, terms, and conditions, in line with company policies and practices.
  • Keep each fund’s stakeholder map current, from TPA contacts to trustees and fund executives.
  • Hand off signed funds to implementation teams and the TPA TAM with scope and stakeholders, remain consulted through go-live, and track activation against schedule.
  • Partner with TPA TAMs, professional services, and support teams to resolve issues and ensure a positive customer experience.
  • Serve as an escalation point for commercial matters and coordinate internal resources to resolve customer concerns.
  • Educate customers on new product features, releases, and best practices to drive adoption and long-term value.
  • Advocate on customer needs internally by sharing feedback on product offerings, enhancements, and market trends with the product development team.
  • Meet or exceed quarterly and annual targets and KPIs, including ARR versus segment quota, bookings, expansion win rate, and the pod results.
  • Maintain accurate account data, pipeline, and forecasts by fund and product in the CRM, including contacts, renewal dates, opportunities, and activity notes, and report pipeline-to-quota, fund-level opportunities created, and unlicensed funds in active conversion to sales leadership across a high volume of smaller deals.
  • Leverage generative AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, sharpen account insights, and accelerate delivery of business outcomes.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS or payments sales, expansion selling, or account management, ideally managing accounts sold through or alongside channel partners such as third-party administrators.
  • Proven ability to negotiate pricing and contract terms, and to identify and develop expansion opportunities using consultative selling techniques.
  • Experience working within partner or channel models, including enterprise agreements with order-level purchasing and shared ownership with direct sellers.
  • Solid understanding of SaaS products and how they address customer pain points; familiarity with Taft-Hartley funds, third-party administrators (TPAs), or the benefits administration industry preferred.
  • Ability to turn impact analyses and claims or payments data into business cases a board of trustees can approve.
  • Experience using a CRM to manage pipeline and forecasts across a high volume of smaller deals.
  • Strong organization and prioritization skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels and collaborate effectively.
  • Experience using generative AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to improve productivity and deliver high-quality outcomes.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Bridgeway is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
