Account Director, Hospitality
Location: USA Remote | Job Type: Full-Time | Team: Account Management

About Azira

Azira is a location intelligence platform built for today’s data-driven teams, transforming mobile location signals into high-confidence, privacy-first insights. Our technology helps marketing, operations, and data leaders make smarter decisions, optimize performance, and drive measurable growth. From hotel brands and destination marketers to retailers, media agencies, and real estate teams, we deliver trusted, validated insights rooted in real-world behavior, connecting the dots between where people go and how businesses can better reach, serve, and grow their audiences.

Why This Role Matters

The Account Director, Hospitality owns and grows a portfolio of strategic hospitality accounts across North America, including hotel chains, brands, management companies, and the agency partners that buy media and insights on their behalf. This role is the senior client lead, responsible for relationship management, media strategy alignment, execution oversight, and revenue growth. As a trusted advisor to hospitality marketers, you’ll translate goals such as bookings, occupancy, and brand awareness into effective media programs while coordinating internal teams to deliver high-quality outcomes. You’ll own the growth of this vertical across existing clients and new logos brought in by the sales team.

What You’ll Do

  • Own senior relationships with hotel chains, brands, management companies, and their agency partners, serving as the primary strategic partner and leading executive conversations, QBRs, and long-term planning.
  • Drive account growth by identifying and closing upsell, cross-sell, renewal, and expansion opportunities, including growth across a brand’s flags, regions, and properties, while maintaining accurate forecasts and account plans.
  • Lead media strategy alignment in partnership with media teams to ensure campaigns meet hospitality client objectives, KPIs, budgets, and performance goals, including seasonal and need-period demand.
  • Translate location and campaign data into insights hotel marketers can use, such as visitation trends, feeder markets, and competitive set performance, and proactively identify optimization and growth opportunities.
  • Oversee flawless campaign execution from planning through delivery across brand-level and property-level programs, ensuring timelines, quality, billing accuracy, and contract compliance.
  • Champion cross-functional collaboration across Sales, Ad Ops, Data, Product, and Creative to shape hospitality-relevant solutions, remove friction, and resolve escalations quickly.
  • Represent Azira at hospitality industry events, conferences, and client meetings.
  • Advocate for clients internally while balancing business priorities and operational efficiency.
  • Mentor junior members of the AM and Ad Ops teams, fostering Azira’s collaborative, high-performance culture.

What You’ll Bring

  • Significant experience (ideally 5–8+ years) in strategic account management or client services, with a meaningful portion of that time in the hospitality vertical (required).
  • Deep understanding of how media is bought on behalf of hotels and their flags, whether brand-direct or through agency partners (required).
  • Deep expertise in programmatic advertising, ad platforms (DSPs, SSPs), and audience segmentation strategies, with the ability to translate platform capabilities into measurable client outcomes.
  • Proven ability to manage senior client relationships at hotel brands, management companies, or hospitality-focused agencies.
  • Experience driving revenue growth and account expansion, ideally by growing partnerships across multiple brands or properties within a hotel portfolio.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven solutions clear and practical for hotel marketers.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, or a related field preferred.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Competitive base salary (annual): $100,000–$120,000, plus a competitive commission plan
  • Full medical, dental, vision, and PTO benefits
  • Flexible remote work environment (US-based; ~10–20% travel)
  • Opportunity to shape core products at a fast-growing company
  • Collaborative, low-ego culture with high trust and high impact

How to Apply

Sound like a fit? Apply here!

At Azira, we don’t hire for the box—we hire for the spark. We’re building boldly. Join us.

The Role

Veeva Systems is looking for a Practice Manager, Project Management to join our Randomization & Trial Supply Management (RTSM) team. As an RTSM Practice Manager, you will lead a professional services team focused on customer success in implementation and support of RTSM studies.

    • Establish and ensure adherence to RTSM Processes

    • Operational excellence in leading Services including resource management

raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPointCorp seeks Help Desk Specialists to provide non-technical application and user support for the Defense Casualty Information Processing System (DCIPS) Future. You will help authorized users navigate the application, follow documented business workflows, and use available self-service and training resources to help customers towards a resolution within the system.

The role combines initial contact and procedure-based Tier 1/2 assistance. The goal is first-contact resolution when an approved answer or procedure is available. You will use knowledge articles, job aids and training videos rather than being expected to serve as a casualty-management subject matter expert or technical administrator.

You will report to the dedicated Help Desk Lead. Questions requiring specialist judgment, including niche Baseline 1.0 functionality, will be routed to the designated Business Analyst and Senior Advisor teams under the program’s Tier 3/4 escalation model.

Fully remote. The DCIPS Future support service window is 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, excluding holidays. Individual schedules are assigned to support that coverage.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Receive support requests through approved channels. Record the user’s question, business impact, affected function and relevant facts; categorize and prioritize tickets using approved procedures.
  • Guide users through documented application tasks and common issues using the current approved knowledge base, self-service resources, job aids and training videos. Explain steps clearly and verify whether the guidance resolved the request.
  • Collect sufficient evidence for escalation without gathering unnecessary personal or sensitive data. Document the steps attempted and route questions beyond approved guidance or assigned authority to the responsible SME or technical team.
  • Maintain Total Contact Ownership: follow assigned tickets through escalation, keep users informed, coordinate next steps, confirm outcomes and document closure even when another team performs the resolution.
  • Follow approved identity-verification and access-request procedures. Route provisioning, permission changes and technical administration to authorized personnel unless specifically trained and authorized for a defined action.
  • Notify the lead promptly of suspected outages, security concerns, recurring problems or tickets at risk of missing service goals. Do not improvise technical fixes or bypass controls.
  • Identify missing or unclear guidance and recommend knowledge or training improvements. Keep ticket records and handover notes accurate so the team can measure workload, service quality and recurring issues.
  • Protect sensitive casualty, personal and mission information. Complete application training and participate in readiness exercises and refresher training as the application changes.

Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • Active secret clearance required.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, patient customer service, sound judgment and careful documentation.
  • Ability to learn a business application, follow approved procedures, locate relevant guidance and explain it to users with varying levels of familiarity.
  • Ability to organize competing requests, recognize when to escalate and follow through reliably.
  • Working familiarity with common office applications and willingness to learn the approved ticketing and knowledge-management tools. Prior help desk experience is not required.
  • Passion and commitment to serving our country’s war-fighters and their families.

Optional qualifications

  • Customer service, application support or service-desk experience; familiarity with ticketing, knowledge articles and ITIL-aligned incident and request handling.
  • Federal or defense mission experience and familiarity with handling sensitive information.
  • ITIL Foundation or HDI Customer Service Representative certification may strengthen service-management and customer-support skills. These are optional additions, not established certification requirements for this position.

Active Secret clearance or higher, with individual eligibility and access requirements validated by the Facility Security Officer. Complete applicable security, privacy and role-specific training before performing assigned duties. Account access and privileged actions require separate authorization.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in 55 countries, including Nigeria, United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, India, France, Netherlands.

Pay: $500,000–$1,500,000/yr

Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Robotics & Embodied AI Research

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

We're hiring a Robotics Researcher to drive frontier research in embodied AI, robot learning, and physical AI systems.

This is a hands-on research role focused on advancing vision-language-action (VLA) models, generalist robot policies, world models, and emerging approaches to embodied intelligence. You'll design and execute end-to-end robotics experiments, leveraging real-world data, simulation, and human-in-the-loop systems to evaluate and improve robot performance.

You'll independently explore promising research directions and collaborate with leading AI and robotics teams to translate experimental findings into scalable solutions.

What You'll Do

  1. Lead frontier robotics research across VLA models, generalist policies, world models, and emerging embodied AI approaches.
  2. Design end-to-end experimentation systems spanning teleoperation, data collection, simulation, policy deployment, and real-world evaluation.
  3. Develop high-fidelity simulations using real-world data to evaluate robot policies and validate performance in physical environments.
  4. Leverage flow, our human-in-the-loop annotation platform, to structure and scale robotics datasets from egocentric video, teleoperation demonstrations, and multimodal sensor data.
  5. Investigate model limitations, failure modes, and sim-to-real gaps to develop improved datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation methodologies.
  6. Rapidly prototype and validate novel approaches to robot learning, policy optimization, and embodied intelligence.
  7. Independently identify high-impact research opportunities and lead projects from initial exploration through experimentation and scalable implementation.

What We're Looking For

  1. Strong background in robotics, embodied AI, robot learning, computer vision, or applied machine learning research.
  2. Hands-on experience developing, training, or evaluating robot learning models, including VLA models, imitation learning, or generalist policies.
  3. Proficiency in Python and experience with robotics or ML frameworks such as PyTorch, ROS, or simulation environments.
  4. Experience designing robotics experiments involving real-world data collection, simulation, policy evaluation, or hardware deployment.
  5. Understanding of robot learning methodologies, multimodal perception, and sim-to-real transfer challenges.
  6. Ability to analyze model behavior, identify failure modes, and translate research findings into measurable performance improvements.
  7. Strong research ownership, experimental judgment, and ability to independently execute complex technical projects.
  8. Strong technical communication and collaboration skills across research and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Experience with world models, reinforcement learning, imitation learning, or diffusion-based robot policies.
  2. Hands-on experience with teleoperation, robotics hardware, sensor integration, or real-world policy deployment.
  3. Familiarity with robotics simulators such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, or comparable environments.
  4. Experience building multimodal robotics datasets from egocentric video, robot trajectories, or sensor data.
  5. Prior experience at a leading robotics or frontier AI research lab.
  6. Contributions to robotics research publications, open-source frameworks, or benchmark development.

Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $200,000 –$320,000 USD. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. The company provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

About G2

G2 Capital Advisors () is a multi-product, sector-focused investment bank and financial advisory firm. Founded on the belief that middle-market advisory firms can do more, G2 partners with clients to navigate opportunities for growth, address operational or financial challenges, and execute complex capital markets transactions. What sets us apart? We’re not your typical investment bank or restructuring advisory firm. Our team brings together a balanced mix of operational insight, executive leadership, investment acumen, and financial advisory expertise. This diverse experience allows us to deliver tailored solutions that align with our clients’ strategic and financial goals, ensuring a well-rounded and impactful partnership. At G2, we thrive on collaboration, innovation and impact. We seek entrepreneurial, driven and intellectually curious individuals to join us in delivering exceptional outcomes for our clients.

Location: Flexible, with preference for Boston, New York, Chicago, Los Angeles, or Dallas

Overview

The Managing Director is an executive position responsible for expanding and growing G2’s Buy-Side Advisory practice within your industry vertical (Consumer & Retail, Transportation & Logistics, Technology & Business Services, Industrials & Manufacturing, Healthcare, or Financial Services). G2’s Buy-Side Advisory practice partners with clients to develop and execute tailored M&A strategies, serving as an extension of their teams and leveraging deep industry and operational insights to identify and engage acquisition targets aligned with their strategic objectives. Through this approach, we help clients execute transactions that accelerate growth and create shareholder value. In this seat, you will have access to a dedicated Buy Side team to support execution, access to private equity sponsors covered by G2’s Sponsor Coverage team, and the full G2 platform, including Sell-Side, Capital Markets, and Restructuring, to bring to your clients.

Responsibilities include:

Sourcing and Origination - 40%

  • Source and originate Buy-Side mandates from private equity sponsors (add on programs for portfolio companies) and strategic acquirers in your sector, alongside G2’s Sponsor Coverage team.
  • Bring G2’s full platform to your relationships, including Sell-Side, Capital Markets, and Restructuring.
  • Use one’s track record of success and network, as well as G2’s transaction history and network, to maximize referrals and overall relevancy.
  • Deliver on ambitious sales goals to make a substantial contribution to overall firm growth.
  • Coordinate with Marketing to develop industry segment communications, including newsletters, marketing campaigns, etc.
  • Identify opportunities to promote both G2 and personal industry expertise through such activities as speaking engagements, article publication, panel/conference participation, and serving on boards.

Execution - 40%

  • Overall responsibility for each transaction and successful execution of one’s engagements.
  • Lead engagements within a small, collaborative team environment, as well as ensure all aspects of engagements are delivered with the highest quality standards.
  • Support acquisition target engagement through direct outreach in conjunction with your deal team
  • Ensure transaction success on one’s client engagements by appropriately identifying risks and developing strategies and plans to mitigate those risks on a proactive basis.
  • Manage all critical client and stakeholder communications to an effective outcome while maintaining the highest level of professionalism.
  • Apply your M&A expertise and senior executive experience to advise sponsor deal teams, portfolio company leaders, and corporate clients in your sector.

Organization Development - 20%

  • Provide input on the strategic direction of the group as well as professional development of the team.
  • Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain G2’s resources, building on their business development capabilities, deepening their M&A knowledge, and strengthening their understanding of your sector and industry trends.
  • Partner with G2’s Industry and product teams to jointly originate and deliver cross platform mandates.

The ideal candidate will have had meaningful prior experience in a senior management role with in-depth experience in Buy-Side strategy and execution. Prior experience providing senior-level advice and counsel to business owners, C-Suite executives, private equity sponsors, and investors will be critical in this role. The ideal candidate will use sponsor, industry, and G2 relationships to source, originate, and lead the execution of Buy-Side engagements. The right person understands that M&A and financial advisory transactions are as much emotion and personality driven as financial, and can provide the leadership necessary to help G2’s Buy-Side clients achieve their goals. They will deploy both strategic and transaction skills to get things done. Candidates in this role will be a hands-on leader with superior business development experience and an appetite to support and drive growth within a highly dynamic and entrepreneurial organization. They will also have room to broaden their platform by sourcing across the G2 platform.

Skills and Characteristics:

  • Established relationships across the private equity community and a track record of sourcing and originating Buy Side mandates from sponsors.
  • Senior executive, Corporate Development or Managing Director level experience in leading Buy-Side engagements within your sector of expertise.
  • Proven ability to manage complex business issues during all stages of the business lifecycle, including growth, downturn, and distress, and leading team members to successful outcomes during times of uncertainty.
  • 10+ years of executive-level experience within your sector, with significant transaction experience in Buy-Side advisory.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to facilitate critical conversations at all levels and with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven track record of success building high-performance teams and businesses in both local and remote team environments.
  • Strong sales and marketing experience with hands-on experience in business development, including tangible experience and results in direct sales.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen (P&L responsibility, M&A experience, financial analysis, business analysis)
  • Extensive professional network and ability to leverage your professional reputation and historical career footprint.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced and diverse environment and can manage multiple work streams.
  • Professional experience within your industry verticals and in non-advisory roles is a plus.
  • Strong educational background

What we value

While our team members come from a wide range of backgrounds, we are united by shared core principles. Explore our values here.

Total annual earnings typically range from $1,000,000-$3,000,000, depending on sourcing, origination & execution performance.

Job Description:

GDIT is seeking an Oracle EBS Functional Tester for our Healthcare General Ledger Accounting System (HIGLAS) program at the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services. GDIT is looking for business subject matter expert who understands the CMS – HIGLAS system and provide functional expertise/support to the project.


This initiative entails HIGLAS interfacing all the Medicare Claims data with an external system, while keeping the current state of interface with the Shared Services. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of Medicare Claim processing, HIGLAS business processes and major extensions in the Oracle EBS to support the HIGLAS business processes. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing and owning test cases/requirements for HIGLAS EBS Application.


The Oracle EBS Functional Tester will work on Test Planning, Preparing, Execution, and Close-out. Must be well versed in all aspects of testing (e.g., analysis, planning, performance, automation, user acceptance) and able to speak to the needs for each. The tester must have broad expertise in the field’s concepts, practices, and procedures, and expertly performs a variety of complex tasks with minimal guidance.

Job Responsibilities

  • Review the documentation on all HIGLAS X12 interfaces (HIPAA compliant interfaces) on the Benefits lien of business to understand the logistics of the project.
  • Closely work with functional and development team to understand the test requirements upfront in the project.
  • Ability to understand the existing integration and translating them into interface testing needs.
  • Participate in work group sessions, design review sessions to ensure all the requirements are translated into test scripts and cases.
  • Document the test scripts and scenarios to test the end-to-end solution of the HIGLAS integration with an external Claims Processing system.
  • Execute the end-to-end testing of the integration and ensure all defects are logged and followed up for timely resolution.
  • Capture the evidence of end-to-end testing as per CMMI level IV standards.
  • Work with the customer (CMS) and end users to ensure comments on test cases, test results, UAT test plans, etc. are addressed timely.
  • Closely work with end users in view of User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to communicate timelines and oversee the testing progress by proving timely support.
  • In addition to new integration, also support HIGLAS enhancements to be implemented in the EBS application (financial modules – AR, AP, GL, PO, Projects) from a testing point of view, and provide test support for Production defects and other projects in HIGLAS.
  • Quickly adapt to the HIGLAS terminology and customizations done in the EBS application.
  • Perform web, API, functional, regression, load, and end-to-end testing – automated and manual as needed.
  • Write and modify SQL queries to perform database validations as an additional level of check from a testing point of view.

REQUIRED SKILLS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science and 5+ years related experience or the equivalent or a MS degree and 3+ years of testing experience.
  • 5+ years of experience testing Oracle E-Business Suite based applications.
  • Understanding of the data flow for Oracle financial modules – AR, AP, GL
  • Understanding of Middleware Tool (WebSphere)
  • Understanding of the Scheduler tool (AutoSys)
  • 3+ years of experience working with HP ALM.
  • Experience building configurable & parametrized test automation scripts.
  • Experience testing/automating Web forms, Java forms, Web Service, backend services and ETL.
  • Experience working in an Agile environment.

DESIRED SKILLS:

  • Experience working with middleware tools, example: WebSphere
  • Experience working with Scheduler tools, example: AutoSys
  • Experience working in an agile team and ability to adapt to changes in scope and prioritization.
  • Experience in a Federal environment
  • HIGLAS, UFMS or NIH knowledge is preferred

LOCATION: Remote


CLEARANCE:

Ability to obtain a Public Trust: candidate must have lived in the United States at least three (3) out of the last five (5) years and pass a public trust background investigation.


WHAT GDIT CAN OFFER YOU:

  • 401K with company match
  • Comprehensive health and wellness packages
  • Internal mobility team dedicated to helping you own your career
  • Professional growth opportunities including paid education and certifications
  • Cutting-edge technology you can learn from

raw.description:
WHAT'S THE ROLE

Great safety leadership goes beyond compliance. It shapes how people lead, how teams operate and how a business grows.

As Director, Health, Safety & Environment, you’ll lead the HSE function supporting our Remote and Hospitality Services (RHS/ABS)business, working closely with senior operational leaders and HSE professionals to strengthen safety performance across the organization.

For an experienced HSE leader who understands operations and knows how to build credibility from the frontline to senior leadership, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

This is an opportunity to influence both strategy and execution. You’ll help ensure our HSE systems evolve with the business, build greater consistency across operations and continue advancing a culture where preventing injuries and protecting our people and environment are part of how we work.

  • Lead and develop the HSE team supporting RHS/ABS, building capability, accountability and a high-performance culture.
  • Partner with senior operational leaders to embed HSE strategy, systems and expectations into day-to-day operations.
  • Strengthen HSE performance by using trends, data and incident learnings to identify risks and drive sustained improvement.
  • Provide leadership and direction on incident management, root-cause analysis and preventative actions.
  • Guide the implementation and continuous improvement of Dexterra Group HSE programs, policies and management systems.
  • Support HSE certification programs, including COR and ISO, and maintain compliance with applicable health, safety and environmental requirements.
  • Collaborate across Dexterra’s HSE organization to drive consistency while ensuring programs work effectively within the business.
  • Keep leaders informed of emerging HSE issues, regulatory requirements and industry trends.
  • Support business development and sales initiatives where HSE expertise can strengthen our client solutions.
  • Help ensure our HSE approach, resources and capabilities can scale with the continued growth of the business.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You’re an experienced HSE leader who can connect strong safety practices with the realities of running a complex operation.

  • 5–10+ years of progressive HSE experience, ideally within a large, operationally complex organization.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, with the ability to coach and develop strong HSE professionals.
  • A CRSP, CHSC or international equivalent designation.
  • Strong knowledge of HSE management systems, regulatory compliance, incident management and continuous improvement.
  • The ability to influence senior leaders and build trusted relationships across operations.
  • Experience with COR, ISO or environmental auditing is an asset.
  • Relevant post-secondary education in occupational health and safety, science, engineering, environment, public health or a related discipline is preferred.
  • A valid driver’s licence and flexibility to travel to operational locations.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • Be part of an industry that's more important than ever!
  • Award winning safety culture.
  • Be part of a growing organization with a strong focus on innovation and operational excellence.
  • Supportive team environment with room to grow together.
  • Fully Remote work model.
  • Certified as a Great Place to Work 2025-2026!

Dexterra Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veterans’ status, Indigenous status, or any other legally protected factors. Special needs accommodation is available upon request at all stages of the selection process.

We thank all applicants for their interest and will contact those candidates selected for interview.

Note, we are not accepting candidates from recruitment agencies.

WHO ARE WE?

Dexterra Group (TSX: DXT) is a leading provider of support services and infrastructure support solutions across Canada and the United States. Through our diverse businesses, we deliver facilities management, food services, remote workforce accommodations, forestry services, and other operational solutions that help organizations operate safely, efficiently, and sustainably.

For more than 80 years, Dexterra has supported clients across a wide range of industries and environments, from commercial and institutional facilities to remote worksites and natural resource operations. We are committed to delivering exceptional service while creating meaningful opportunities for our people, clients, and communities.

That’s something we’re truly proud of, Work That Matters, People Who Care.
